-- Half extent of box b along the unit world axis (lx, ly, lz).
local function extent(b, lx, ly, lz)
	return b.hx * abs(b.r11 * lx + b.r21 * ly + b.r31 * lz)
		+ b.hy * abs(b.r12 * lx + b.r22 * ly + b.r32 * lz)
		+ b.hz * abs(b.r13 * lx + b.r23 * ly + b.r33 * lz)
end
collide.extent = extent

-- The pair's reference normal: of the six face axes of A and B, the one
-- along which they overlap least (separating-axis test), pointing from B
-- toward A. Corners that end up inside the other box use it, rather than
-- the nearest face of that box alone: identical kubbs side by side have
-- corners lying exactly on each other's side planes, and the nearest-face
-- rule then pushes sideways.
local refX, refY, refZ, refK
local REF_COS = math.cos(math.rad(25)) -- a corner's own normal further off than this uses the reference
-- Returns the least overlap (negative = the gap along that axis).
local function referenceAxis(A, B)
	local dx, dy, dz = A.x - B.x, A.y - B.y, A.z - B.z
	local a11, a12, a13, a21, a22, a23, a31, a32, a33 =
		A.r11, A.r12, A.r13, A.r21, A.r22, A.r23, A.r31, A.r32, A.r33
	local b11, b12, b13, b21, b22, b23, b31, b32, b33 =
		B.r11, B.r12, B.r13, B.r21, B.r22, B.r23, B.r31, B.r32, B.r33
	local ahx, ahy, ahz, bhx, bhy, bhz = A.hx, A.hy, A.hz, B.hx, B.hy, B.hz
	local best = math.huge
	for k = 1, 6 do
		local lx, ly, lz
		if k == 1 then lx, ly, lz = a11, a21, a31
		elseif k == 2 then lx, ly, lz = a12, a22, a32
		elseif k == 3 then lx, ly, lz = a13, a23, a33
		elseif k == 4 then lx, ly, lz = b11, b21, b31
		elseif k == 5 then lx, ly, lz = b12, b22, b32
		else lx, ly, lz = b13, b23, b33 end
		local d = dx * lx + dy * ly + dz * lz
		local e1 = a11 * lx + a21 * ly + a31 * lz
		local e2 = a12 * lx + a22 * ly + a32 * lz
		local e3 = a13 * lx + a23 * ly + a33 * lz
		if e1 < 0 then e1 = -e1 end
		if e2 < 0 then e2 = -e2 end
		if e3 < 0 then e3 = -e3 end
		local f1 = b11 * lx + b21 * ly + b31 * lz
		local f2 = b12 * lx + b22 * ly + b32 * lz
		local f3 = b13 * lx + b23 * ly + b33 * lz
		if f1 < 0 then f1 = -f1 end
		if f2 < 0 then f2 = -f2 end
		if f3 < 0 then f3 = -f3 end
		local ad = d
		if ad < 0 then ad = -ad end
		local o = (ahx * e1 + ahy * e2 + ahz * e3) + (bhx * f1 + bhy * f2 + bhz * f3) - ad
		if o < best then
			best = o
			if d < 0 then lx, ly, lz = -lx, -ly, -lz end
			refX, refY, refZ, refK = lx, ly, lz, k
		end
	end
	return best
end

-- Corners of box A against box B (contacts on A, normals out of B).
-- (sx, sy, sz) is the reference normal from B toward A.
local function cornersInto(A, B, margin, sx_, sy_, sz_)
	local hx, hy, hz = A.hx, A.hy, A.hz
	local ax, ay, az = A.r11 * hx, A.r21 * hx, A.r31 * hx
	local bx, by, bz = A.r12 * hy, A.r22 * hy, A.r32 * hy
	local cx, cy, cz = A.r13 * hz, A.r23 * hz, A.r33 * hz
	local Ax, Ay, Az = A.x, A.y, A.z
	local Bx, By, Bz = B.x, B.y, B.z
	-- skip corners clearly outside B's bounding sphere plus margin
	local reach = B.radius + margin
	local reach2 = reach * reach
	local r11, r12, r13, r21, r22, r23, r31, r32, r33
	local Bhx, Bhy, Bhz
	local plane
	local i = C.n
	for k = 1, 8 do
		local sx, sy, sz = SX[k], SY[k], SZ[k]
		local px = Ax + sx * ax + sy * bx + sz * cx
		local py = Ay + sx * ay + sy * by + sz * cy
		local pz = Az + sx * az + sy * bz + sz * cz
		local ddx, ddy, ddz = px - Bx, py - By, pz - Bz
		if ddx * ddx + ddy * ddy + ddz * ddz < reach2 then
			if not r11 then
				r11, r12, r13, r21, r22, r23, r31, r32, r33 =
					B.r11, B.r12, B.r13, B.r21, B.r22, B.r23, B.r31, B.r32, B.r33
				Bhx, Bhy, Bhz = B.hx, B.hy, B.hz
			end
			-- pointBox(B, p), written out
			local lx = r11 * ddx + r21 * ddy + r31 * ddz
			local ly = r12 * ddx + r22 * ddy + r32 * ddz
			local lz = r13 * ddx + r23 * ddy + r33 * ddz
			local qx = lx > Bhx and Bhx or (lx < -Bhx and -Bhx or lx)
			local qy = ly > Bhy and Bhy or (ly < -Bhy and -Bhy or ly)
			local qz = lz > Bhz and Bhz or (lz < -Bhz and -Bhz or lz)
			local ex, ey, ez = lx - qx, ly - qy, lz - qz
			local d2 = ex * ex + ey * ey + ez * ez
			local lnx, lny, lnz, d
			if d2 > 1e-14 then
				d = sqrt(d2)
				lnx, lny, lnz = ex / d, ey / d, ez / d
			else
				-- inside: the face of least penetration
				local alx, aly, alz = lx, ly, lz
				if alx < 0 then alx = -alx end
				if aly < 0 then aly = -aly end
				if alz < 0 then alz = -alz end
				local px_, py_, pz_ = Bhx - alx, Bhy - aly, Bhz - alz
				if px_ <= py_ and px_ <= pz_ then
					lnx, lny, lnz, d = (lx >= 0) and 1 or -1, 0, 0, -px_
				elseif py_ <= pz_ then
					lnx, lny, lnz, d = 0, (ly >= 0) and 1 or -1, 0, -py_
				else
					lnx, lny, lnz, d = 0, 0, (lz >= 0) and 1 or -1, -pz_
				end
			end
			-- (a corner at margin or further adds nothing; a far corner can
			-- still lie on the reference plane, the back foot of a box leaning
			-- on another, but its distance is then margin too)
			if d < margin then
				local nx = r11 * lnx + r12 * lny + r13 * lnz
				local ny = r21 * lnx + r22 * lny + r23 * lnz
				local nz = r31 * lnx + r32 * lny + r33 * lnz
				if d <= 0 or nx * sx_ + ny * sy_ + nz * sz_ < REF_COS then
					-- inside, or near an edge of B: use the reference normal and
					-- the distance to B's face plane along it (never more than
					-- the true distance, so still a close contact)
					if not plane then
						local e1 = r11 * sx_ + r21 * sy_ + r31 * sz_
						local e2 = r12 * sx_ + r22 * sy_ + r32 * sz_
						local e3 = r13 * sx_ + r23 * sy_ + r33 * sz_
						if e1 < 0 then e1 = -e1 end
						if e2 < 0 then e2 = -e2 end
						if e3 < 0 then e3 = -e3 end
						plane = Bx * sx_ + By * sy_ + Bz * sz_ + (Bhx * e1 + Bhy * e2 + Bhz * e3)
					end
					local dp = px * sx_ + py * sy_ + pz * sz_ - plane
					if d <= 0 and dp > 0 then dp = 0 end
					d = dp
					nx, ny, nz = sx_, sy_, sz_
				end
				if d < margin then
					i = i + 1
					cA[i], cB[i], cSlot[i] = A, B, 0
					cPx[i], cPy[i], cPz[i] = px, py, pz
					cNx[i], cNy[i], cNz[i] = nx, ny, nz
					cSep[i] = d
				end
			end
		end
	end
	C.n = i
end

-- Edge on edge (2026-11-16, the physics audit): two boxes can touch where
-- an edge of each crosses the other's, with no corner of either inside the
-- other. Two kinds, both met by the standard separating-axis test (Ericson,
-- Real-Time Collision Detection 4.4 and 5.1.9; ODE's dBoxBox):
--   - the nine edge axes (an edge direction of A crossed with one of B). If
--     one of them parts the boxes by `margin` there is nothing to add; if the
--     boxes overlap least along one (by EDGE_TOL less than along any face
--     axis), they meet edge on edge: one contact at the closest points of
--     the two edges that face each other, normal along that axis
--   - face on face with the faces crossed (a kubb lying across a lying kubb):
--     the incident face (of the other box, the one turned most against the
--     reference face) is clipped to the reference face, and each point where
--     one of its edges crosses a side of the reference face is a contact
-- Corners stay as they were, so a crossing within CLIP_TOL of a corner is
-- left to that corner. Boxes standing square to each other (every axis of A
-- within ALIGN of one of B's, a row of kubbs) have no edge axis that is not
-- also a face axis, so the nine are skipped for them.
local EDGE_TOL = 0.0005 -- m: an edge axis must overlap this much less than the best face axis
local CLIP_TOL = 0.001  -- m: crossings this close to a corner are the corner's
local ALIGN = 0.9995    -- cos of about 1.8 degrees
local ABX, ABY, ABZ = { 0, 0, 0 }, { 0, 0, 0 }, { 0, 0, 0 }

-- The incident face of box I clipped to face `rk` (1..3, an axis of box R)
-- of box R, the reference normal (nx, ny, nz) pointing out of that face
-- toward I: contacts on I where its edges cross the face's sides.
local function clipFace(I, R, rk, nx, ny, nz, margin)
	-- R's frame: U, V across the face (half sides hu, hv), the face plane
	local ux, uy, uz, vx, vy, vz, hu, hv, hw
	if rk == 1 then
		ux, uy, uz, vx, vy, vz = R.r12, R.r22, R.r32, R.r13, R.r23, R.r33
		hu, hv, hw = R.hy, R.hz, R.hx
	elseif rk == 2 then
		ux, uy, uz, vx, vy, vz = R.r11, R.r21, R.r31, R.r13, R.r23, R.r33
		hu, hv, hw = R.hx, R.hz, R.hy
	else
		ux, uy, uz, vx, vy, vz = R.r11, R.r21, R.r31, R.r12, R.r22, R.r32
		hu, hv, hw = R.hx, R.hy, R.hz
	end
	-- I's face turned most against the normal: its centre and two half edges
	local i11, i12, i13, i21, i22, i23, i31, i32, i33 =
		I.r11, I.r12, I.r13, I.r21, I.r22, I.r23, I.r31, I.r32, I.r33
	local d1 = i11 * nx + i21 * ny + i31 * nz
	local d2 = i12 * nx + i22 * ny + i32 * nz
	local d3 = i13 * nx + i23 * ny + i33 * nz
	local a1, a2, a3 = d1, d2, d3
	if a1 < 0 then a1 = -a1 end
	if a2 < 0 then a2 = -a2 end
	if a3 < 0 then a3 = -a3 end
	local fx, fy, fz, ex, ey, ez, gx, gy, gz
	if a1 >= a2 and a1 >= a3 then
		local s = (d1 > 0) and -I.hx or I.hx
		fx, fy, fz = i11 * s, i21 * s, i31 * s
		ex, ey, ez = i12 * I.hy, i22 * I.hy, i32 * I.hy
		gx, gy, gz = i13 * I.hz, i23 * I.hz, i33 * I.hz
	elseif a2 >= a3 then
		local s = (d2 > 0) and -I.hy or I.hy
		fx, fy, fz = i12 * s, i22 * s, i32 * s
		ex, ey, ez = i11 * I.hx, i21 * I.hx, i31 * I.hx
		gx, gy, gz = i13 * I.hz, i23 * I.hz, i33 * I.hz
	else
		local s = (d3 > 0) and -I.hz or I.hz
		fx, fy, fz = i13 * s, i23 * s, i33 * s
		ex, ey, ez = i11 * I.hx, i21 * I.hx, i31 * I.hx
		gx, gy, gz = i12 * I.hy, i22 * I.hy, i32 * I.hy
	end
	-- in R's frame (w: height above the face plane)
	local cx, cy, cz = I.x + fx - R.x, I.y + fy - R.y, I.z + fz - R.z
	local cu, cv = cx * ux + cy * uy + cz * uz, cx * vx + cy * vy + cz * vz
	local cw = cx * nx + cy * ny + cz * nz - hw
	local eu, ev, ew = ex * ux + ey * uy + ez * uz, ex * vx + ey * vy + ez * vz, ex * nx + ey * ny + ez * nz
	local gu, gv, gw = gx * ux + gy * uy + gz * uz, gx * vx + gy * vy + gz * vz, gx * nx + gy * ny + gz * nz
	-- the corners in order round the face: c + e + g, c - e + g, c - e - g, c + e - g
	local aew, agw = ew, gw
	if aew < 0 then aew = -aew end
	if agw < 0 then agw = -agw end
	if cw - aew - agw >= margin then return end -- the whole face is clear
	local aeu, agu, aev, agv = eu, gu, ev, gv
	if aeu < 0 then aeu = -aeu end
	if agu < 0 then agu = -agu end
	if aev < 0 then aev = -aev end
	if agv < 0 then agv = -agv end
	local au, av = cu, cv
	if au < 0 then au = -au end
	if av < 0 then av = -av end
	-- every corner within the face's sides: nothing crosses them
	if au + aeu + agu <= hu + CLIP_TOL and av + aev + agv <= hv + CLIP_TOL then return end
	local i = C.n
	for k = 1, 4 do
		local pu, pv, pw, qu, qv, qw
		if k == 1 then
			pu, pv, pw = cu + eu + gu, cv + ev + gv, cw + ew + gw
			qu, qv, qw = cu - eu + gu, cv - ev + gv, cw - ew + gw
		elseif k == 2 then
			pu, pv, pw = cu - eu + gu, cv - ev + gv, cw - ew + gw
			qu, qv, qw = cu - eu - gu, cv - ev - gv, cw - ew - gw
		elseif k == 3 then
			pu, pv, pw = cu - eu - gu, cv - ev - gv, cw - ew - gw
			qu, qv, qw = cu + eu - gu, cv + ev - gv, cw + ew - gw
		else
			pu, pv, pw = cu + eu - gu, cv + ev - gv, cw + ew - gw
			qu, qv, qw = cu + eu + gu, cv + ev + gv, cw + ew + gw
		end
		if pw < margin or qw < margin then
			-- the four sides: u = +hu, -hu, v = +hv, -hv. A crossing counts when
			-- one end is inside that side and the other outside, each by more
			-- than CLIP_TOL, and the point lies within the other two sides
			for side = 1, 4 do
				local ps, qs, h
				if side == 1 then ps, qs, h = pu, qu, hu
				elseif side == 2 then ps, qs, h = -pu, -qu, hu
				elseif side == 3 then ps, qs, h = pv, qv, hv
				else ps, qs, h = -pv, -qv, hv end
				local pin, qin = h - ps, h - qs -- > 0 inside
				if (pin > CLIP_TOL and qin < -CLIP_TOL) or (pin < -CLIP_TOL and qin > CLIP_TOL) then
					local t = pin / (pin - qin)
					local w = pw + t * (qw - pw)
					if w < margin then
						local u, v = pu + t * (qu - pu), pv + t * (qv - pv)
						local o, ho
						if side <= 2 then o, ho = v, hv else o, ho = u, hu end
						if o < 0 then o = -o end
						if o < ho - CLIP_TOL then
							local hn = hw + w
							i = i + 1
							cA[i], cB[i], cSlot[i] = I, R, 0
							cPx[i] = R.x + u * ux + v * vx + hn * nx
							cPy[i] = R.y + u * uy + v * vy + hn * ny
							cPz[i] = R.z + u * uz + v * vz + hn * nz
							cNx[i], cNy[i], cNz[i] = nx, ny, nz
							cSep[i] = w
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	C.n = i
end

function collide.boxBox(A, B, margin)
	-- separated along a face axis by margin or more: no corner of either box
	-- can come within margin of the other (every corner's distance is at
	-- least that gap), so there is nothing to add
	local best = referenceAxis(A, B)
	if best <= -margin then return end
	local nx, ny, nz, rk = refX, refY, refZ, refK
	-- the nine edge axes, unless the boxes stand square to each other
	local a11, a12, a13, a21, a22, a23, a31, a32, a33 =
		A.r11, A.r12, A.r13, A.r21, A.r22, A.r23, A.r31, A.r32, A.r33
	local b11, b12, b13, b21, b22, b23, b31, b32, b33 =
		B.r11, B.r12, B.r13, B.r21, B.r22, B.r23, B.r31, B.r32, B.r33
	local edge = false
	local exx, eyy, ezz, ei, ej
	local square = true
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local ax, ay, az
		if i == 1 then ax, ay, az = a11, a21, a31
		elseif i == 2 then ax, ay, az = a12, a22, a32
		else ax, ay, az = a13, a23, a33 end
		local c1 = ax * b11 + ay * b21 + az * b31
		local c2 = ax * b12 + ay * b22 + az * b32
		local c3 = ax * b13 + ay * b23 + az * b33
		if c1 < 0 then c1 = -c1 end
		if c2 < 0 then c2 = -c2 end
		if c3 < 0 then c3 = -c3 end
		if c1 < ALIGN and c2 < ALIGN and c3 < ALIGN then square = false break end
	end
	if not square then
		local dx, dy, dz = A.x - B.x, A.y - B.y, A.z - B.z
		local ahx, ahy, ahz, bhx, bhy, bhz = A.hx, A.hy, A.hz, B.hx, B.hy, B.hz
		local eBest = best - EDGE_TOL
		for i = 1, 3 do
			local ax, ay, az
			if i == 1 then ax, ay, az = a11, a21, a31
			elseif i == 2 then ax, ay, az = a12, a22, a32
			else ax, ay, az = a13, a23, a33 end
			for j = 1, 3 do
				local bx, by, bz
				if j == 1 then bx, by, bz = b11, b21, b31
				elseif j == 2 then bx, by, bz = b12, b22, b32
				else bx, by, bz = b13, b23, b33 end
				local lx, ly, lz = ay * bz - az * by, az * bx - ax * bz, ax * by - ay * bx
				local l2 = lx * lx + ly * ly + lz * lz
				if l2 > 1e-6 then
					-- the overlap along the axis left unnormalized (it is the true
					-- overlap times its length, at most 1): one no smaller than the
					-- best so far and not negative can be passed over without the
					-- square root
					local e1 = a11 * lx + a21 * ly + a31 * lz
					local e2 = a12 * lx + a22 * ly + a32 * lz
					local e3 = a13 * lx + a23 * ly + a33 * lz
					if e1 < 0 then e1 = -e1 end
					if e2 < 0 then e2 = -e2 end
					if e3 < 0 then e3 = -e3 end
					local f1 = b11 * lx + b21 * ly + b31 * lz
					local f2 = b12 * lx + b22 * ly + b32 * lz
					local f3 = b13 * lx + b23 * ly + b33 * lz
					if f1 < 0 then f1 = -f1 end
					if f2 < 0 then f2 = -f2 end
					if f3 < 0 then f3 = -f3 end
					local d = dx * lx + dy * ly + dz * lz
					local ad = d
					if ad < 0 then ad = -ad end
					local o = (ahx * e1 + ahy * e2 + ahz * e3) + (bhx * f1 + bhy * f2 + bhz * f3) - ad
					if o < 0 or o < eBest then
						local il = 1 / sqrt(l2)
						o = o * il
						if o <= -margin then return end -- parted along this edge axis
						if o < eBest then
							eBest = o
							if d < 0 then il = -il end
							exx, eyy, ezz, ei, ej = lx * il, ly * il, lz * il, i, j
							edge = true
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	cornersInto(A, B, margin, nx, ny, nz)
	cornersInto(B, A, margin, -nx, -ny, -nz)
	if edge then
		-- edge on edge: A's edge along its axis ei nearest B, B's along ej nearest A
		local lx, ly, lz = exx, eyy, ezz
		ABX[1], ABY[1], ABZ[1] = a11, a21, a31
		ABX[2], ABY[2], ABZ[2] = a12, a22, a32
		ABX[3], ABY[3], ABZ[3] = a13, a23, a33
		local pax, pay, paz = A.x, A.y, A.z
		local h1, h2, h3 = A.hx, A.hy, A.hz
		for k = 1, 3 do
			if k ~= ei then
				local ax, ay, az = ABX[k], ABY[k], ABZ[k]
				local h = (k == 1) and h1 or ((k == 2) and h2 or h3)
				if ax * lx + ay * ly + az * lz > 0 then h = -h end
				pax, pay, paz = pax + ax * h, pay + ay * h, paz + az * h
			end
		end
		local dax, day, daz = ABX[ei], ABY[ei], ABZ[ei]
		local ha = (ei == 1) and h1 or ((ei == 2) and h2 or h3)
		ABX[1], ABY[1], ABZ[1] = b11, b21, b31
		ABX[2], ABY[2], ABZ[2] = b12, b22, b32
		ABX[3], ABY[3], ABZ[3] = b13, b23, b33
		local pbx, pby, pbz = B.x, B.y, B.z
		h1, h2, h3 = B.hx, B.hy, B.hz
		for k = 1, 3 do
			if k ~= ej then
				local bx, by, bz = ABX[k], ABY[k], ABZ[k]
				local h = (k == 1) and h1 or ((k == 2) and h2 or h3)
				if bx * lx + by * ly + bz * lz < 0 then h = -h end
				pbx, pby, pbz = pbx + bx * h, pby + by * h, pbz + bz * h
			end
		end
		local dbx, dby, dbz = ABX[ej], ABY[ej], ABZ[ej]
		local hb = (ej == 1) and h1 or ((ej == 2) and h2 or h3)
		-- closest points of the two edges (Ericson 5.1.9; both unit directions)
		local rx, ry, rz = pax - pbx, pay - pby, paz - pbz
		local b = dax * dbx + day * dby + daz * dbz
		local c = dax * rx + day * ry + daz * rz
		local f = dbx * rx + dby * ry + dbz * rz
		local s = (b * f - c) / (1 - b * b)
		if s < -ha then s = -ha elseif s > ha then s = ha end
		local t = f + s * b
		if t < -hb then t = -hb elseif t > hb then t = hb end
		s = t * b - c
		if s < -ha then s = -ha elseif s > ha then s = ha end
		local px, py, pz = pax + dax * s, pay + day * s, paz + daz * s
		local sep = (px - pbx - dbx * t) * lx + (py - pby - dby * t) * ly + (pz - pbz - dbz * t) * lz
		if sep < margin then add(A, B, px, py, pz, lx, ly, lz, sep, 0) end
	elseif rk <= 3 then
		-- A's face is the reference: B's face meets it (normal from A toward B)
		clipFace(B, A, rk, -nx, -ny, -nz, margin)
	else
		clipFace(A, B, rk - 3, nx, ny, nz, margin)
	end
end

-- How a baton meets a kubb or the king: the box's edges and corners rounded
-- to this radius (m). The box is met as one of half sides less this, swept
-- by a ball of this radius, so a baton that catches an edge gets a normal
-- between the two faces instead of the top face's straight up (Tyler's play
-- test, 2026-11-15: a baton clipping a kubb's top edge pressed it down
-- instead of tipping it, and seemed to pass through it). Wood is never a
-- knife edge; boxes still meet the ground and each other square.
collide.tune = {
	batonRound = 0.01,
}
local ROUND = collide.tune
-- a stretch's end this close to the closest point (as a share of the
-- segment) adds no contact of its own
local CLIP_GAP <const> = 0.04

-- Sphere (center c, radius r) belonging to capsule A against box B
-- (pointBox written out), B's edges rounded by ROUND.batonRound (not for a
-- stake). The contact point is on the sphere, as before. The normal in B's
-- frame is left in SNX, SNY, SNZ (capsuleBox clips with it).
local SNX, SNY, SNZ = 0, 0, 0
local function sphereBox(A, B, cx, cy, cz, r, margin)
	local Bx, By, Bz = B.x, B.y, B.z
	local dx, dy, dz = cx - Bx, cy - By, cz - Bz
	local r11, r12, r13, r21, r22, r23, r31, r32, r33 =
		B.r11, B.r12, B.r13, B.r21, B.r22, B.r23, B.r31, B.r32, B.r33
	local lx = r11 * dx + r21 * dy + r31 * dz
	local ly = r12 * dx + r22 * dy + r32 * dz
	local lz = r13 * dx + r23 * dy + r33 * dz
	-- (a stake is a capsule too: it meets boxes square, so a wall of drilled
	-- kubbs against it is as measured)
	local br = ROUND.batonRound
	if A.static then br = 0 end
	local hx, hy, hz = B.hx - br, B.hy - br, B.hz - br
	local qx = lx > hx and hx or (lx < -hx and -hx or lx)
	local qy = ly > hy and hy or (ly < -hy and -hy or ly)
	local qz = lz > hz and hz or (lz < -hz and -hz or lz)
	local ex, ey, ez = lx - qx, ly - qy, lz - qz
	local d2 = ex * ex + ey * ey + ez * ez
	local lnx, lny, lnz, d
	if d2 > 1e-14 then
		d = sqrt(d2)
		lnx, lny, lnz = ex / d, ey / d, ez / d
	else
		local alx, aly, alz = lx, ly, lz
		if alx < 0 then alx = -alx end
		if aly < 0 then aly = -aly end
		if alz < 0 then alz = -alz end
		local px_, py_, pz_ = hx - alx, hy - aly, hz - alz
		if px_ <= py_ and px_ <= pz_ then
			lnx, lny, lnz, d = (lx >= 0) and 1 or -1, 0, 0, -px_
		elseif py_ <= pz_ then
			lnx, lny, lnz, d = 0, (ly >= 0) and 1 or -1, 0, -py_
		else
			lnx, lny, lnz, d = 0, 0, (lz >= 0) and 1 or -1, -pz_
		end
	end
	local sep = d - r - br
	SNX, SNY, SNZ = lnx, lny, lnz
	if sep < margin then
		local nx = r11 * lnx + r12 * lny + r13 * lnz
		local ny = r21 * lnx + r22 * lny + r23 * lnz
		local nz = r31 * lnx + r32 * lny + r33 * lnz
		local i = C.n + 1
		C.n = i
		cA[i], cB[i], cSlot[i] = A, B, 0
		cPx[i], cPy[i], cPz[i] = cx - nx * r, cy - ny * r, cz - nz * r
		cNx[i], cNy[i], cNz[i] = nx, ny, nz
		cSep[i] = sep
		return true
	end
	return false
end

-- Capsule A against box B: the closest points of the segment and the box,
-- then the stretch of the segment that lies along the same feature of the
-- box (its face or edge) is clipped to that feature's extent, and each end
-- of the stretch is a contact too (Physics fuzz, 2026-11-16: with one point
-- a baton lying along a kubb's face or edge turned about it and sank in,
-- up to 66 mm). A feature is the box's axes the normal does not lean
-- along: a face extends along two of them, an edge along one, a corner
-- along none, so for a corner the stretch is the whole segment and its ends
-- are the baton's end spheres, as before.
function collide.capsuleBox(A, B, margin)
	local hl, r = A.hl, A.r
	local ax, ay, az = A.r13 * hl, A.r23 * hl, A.r33 * hl
	local x1, y1, z1 = A.x - ax, A.y - ay, A.z - az
	local x2, y2, z2 = A.x + ax, A.y + ay, A.z + az
	-- the segment in B's local frame
	local r11, r12, r13, r21, r22, r23, r31, r32, r33 =
		B.r11, B.r12, B.r13, B.r21, B.r22, B.r23, B.r31, B.r32, B.r33
	local dx, dy, dz = x1 - B.x, y1 - B.y, z1 - B.z
	local p1x = r11 * dx + r21 * dy + r31 * dz
	local p1y = r12 * dx + r22 * dy + r32 * dz
	local p1z = r13 * dx + r23 * dy + r33 * dz
	dx, dy, dz = x2 - B.x, y2 - B.y, z2 - B.z
	local ux = r11 * dx + r21 * dy + r31 * dz - p1x
	local uy = r12 * dx + r22 * dy + r32 * dz - p1y
	local uz = r13 * dx + r23 * dy + r33 * dz - p1z
	local uu = ux * ux + uy * uy + uz * uz
	-- the box as sphereBox meets it: its half sides less the rounding
	local br = ROUND.batonRound
	if A.static then br = 0 end
	local hx, hy, hz = B.hx - br, B.hy - br, B.hz - br
	-- closest points by alternating projection (segment <-> box), starting
	-- from the segment point nearest the box center
	local t = -(p1x * ux + p1y * uy + p1z * uz) / uu
	if t < 0 then t = 0 elseif t > 1 then t = 1 end
	for _ = 1, 6 do
		local sx, sy, sz = p1x + ux * t, p1y + uy * t, p1z + uz * t
		local qx = sx > hx and hx or (sx < -hx and -hx or sx)
		local qy = sy > hy and hy or (sy < -hy and -hy or sy)
		local qz = sz > hz and hz or (sz < -hz and -hz or sz)
		local nt = ((qx - p1x) * ux + (qy - p1y) * uy + (qz - p1z) * uz) / uu
		if nt < 0 then nt = 0 elseif nt > 1 then nt = 1 end
		local dt_ = nt - t
		if dt_ < 1e-4 and dt_ > -1e-4 then t = nt break end
		t = nt
	end
	-- the projection creeps when the baton lies nearly parallel to the box,
	-- so an end can be nearer than where it stopped: take the nearest of
	-- the three (Codex on PR #139: an end 2.3 mm into the king's rounded
	-- edge, the projected point 5.9 mm clear)
	local sx, sy, sz = p1x + ux * t, p1y + uy * t, p1z + uz * t
	local qx = sx > hx and hx or (sx < -hx and -hx or sx)
	local qy = sy > hy and hy or (sy < -hy and -hy or sy)
	local qz = sz > hz and hz or (sz < -hz and -hz or sz)
	local best = (sx - qx) * (sx - qx) + (sy - qy) * (sy - qy) + (sz - qz) * (sz - qz)
	if t > 0 then
		qx = p1x > hx and hx or (p1x < -hx and -hx or p1x)
		qy = p1y > hy and hy or (p1y < -hy and -hy or p1y)
		qz = p1z > hz and hz or (p1z < -hz and -hz or p1z)
		local d2 = (p1x - qx) * (p1x - qx) + (p1y - qy) * (p1y - qy) + (p1z - qz) * (p1z - qz)
		if d2 < best then best, t = d2, 0 end
	end
	if t < 1 then
		sx, sy, sz = p1x + ux, p1y + uy, p1z + uz
		qx = sx > hx and hx or (sx < -hx and -hx or sx)
		qy = sy > hy and hy or (sy < -hy and -hy or sy)
		qz = sz > hz and hz or (sz < -hz and -hz or sz)
		if (sx - qx) * (sx - qx) + (sy - qy) * (sy - qy) + (sz - qz) * (sz - qz) < best then t = 1 end
	end
	-- the closest pair; nothing nearer than the margin, no contact at all
	if not sphereBox(A, B, x1 + 2 * ax * t, y1 + 2 * ay * t, z1 + 2 * az * t, r, margin) then
		return false
	end
	-- the stretch [lo, hi] of the segment within the feature's extent
	local lo, hi = 0, 1
	if SNX == 0 then
		local e = hx
		if ux > 1e-12 or ux < -1e-12 then
			local ta, tb = (-e - p1x) / ux, (e - p1x) / ux
			if ta > tb then ta, tb = tb, ta end
			if ta > lo then lo = ta end
			if tb < hi then hi = tb end
		end
	end
	if SNY == 0 then
		local e = hy
		if uy > 1e-12 or uy < -1e-12 then
			local ta, tb = (-e - p1y) / uy, (e - p1y) / uy
			if ta > tb then ta, tb = tb, ta end
			if ta > lo then lo = ta end
			if tb < hi then hi = tb end
		end
	end
	if SNZ == 0 then
		local e = hz
		if uz > 1e-12 or uz < -1e-12 then
			local ta, tb = (-e - p1z) / uz, (e - p1z) / uz
			if ta > tb then ta, tb = tb, ta end
			if ta > lo then lo = ta end
			if tb < hi then hi = tb end
		end
	end
	-- each end of the stretch that is not the closest point already
	if lo < t - CLIP_GAP then
		sphereBox(A, B, x1 + 2 * ax * lo, y1 + 2 * ay * lo, z1 + 2 * az * lo, r, margin)
	end
	if hi > t + CLIP_GAP then
		sphereBox(A, B, x1 + 2 * ax * hi, y1 + 2 * ay * hi, z1 + 2 * az * hi, r, margin)
	end
	return true
end

-- Capsule A against capsule B: closest points of two segments (Ericson,
-- Real-Time Collision Detection 5.1.9).
function collide.capsuleCapsule(A, B, margin)
	local ax, ay, az = A.r13 * A.hl, A.r23 * A.hl, A.r33 * A.hl
	local bx, by, bz = B.r13 * B.hl, B.r23 * B.hl, B.r33 * B.hl
	local p1x, p1y, p1z = A.x - ax, A.y - ay, A.z - az
	local p2x, p2y, p2z = B.x - bx, B.y - by, B.z - bz
	local d1x, d1y, d1z = 2 * ax, 2 * ay, 2 * az
	local d2x, d2y, d2z = 2 * bx, 2 * by, 2 * bz
	local rx, ry, rz = p1x - p2x, p1y - p2y, p1z - p2z
	local a = d1x * d1x + d1y * d1y + d1z * d1z
	local e = d2x * d2x + d2y * d2y + d2z * d2z
	local f = d2x * rx + d2y * ry + d2z * rz
	local c = d1x * rx + d1y * ry + d1z * rz
	local b = d1x * d2x + d1y * d2y + d1z * d2z
	local den = a * e - b * b
	local s = 0
	if den > 1e-12 then
		s = (b * f - c * e) / den
		if s < 0 then s = 0 elseif s > 1 then s = 1 end
	end
	local t = (b * s + f) / e
	if t < 0 then
		t = 0
		s = -c / a
		if s < 0 then s = 0 elseif s > 1 then s = 1 end
	elseif t > 1 then
		t = 1
		s = (b - c) / a
		if s < 0 then s = 0 elseif s > 1 then s = 1 end
	end
	local cax, cay, caz = p1x + d1x * s, p1y + d1y * s, p1z + d1z * s
	local cbx, cby, cbz = p2x + d2x * t, p2y + d2y * t, p2z + d2z * t
	local nx, ny, nz = cax - cbx, cay - cby, caz - cbz
	local d = sqrt(nx * nx + ny * ny + nz * nz)
	if d < 1e-9 then
		nx, ny, nz, d = 0, 0, 1, 0
	else
		nx, ny, nz = nx / d, ny / d, nz / d
	end
	local sep = d - A.r - B.r
	if sep < margin then
		add(A, B, cax - nx * A.r, cay - ny * A.r, caz - nz * A.r, nx, ny, nz, sep, 0)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

tw.collide = collide
core/debris:
-- What lies on the pitch within a turn that the rules engine does not keep:
-- the batons already thrown and the kubbs they knocked down. In Kubb a
-- toppled kubb and a thrown baton stay where they came to rest until the
-- turn is over; a later baton can hit them, be deflected by them, or push
-- them into a standing kubb. The engine is still the judge (it has the
-- toppled kubbs in a hand already); this module only carries their poses
-- from throw to throw so the next throw's physics world has them as bodies.
-- Pure Lua: no playdate.*. Not a per-frame path: once per throw.
--
-- It also carries the exact body pose (tilt, height, which face is down) of
-- every lying kubb the engine does keep on the pitch: during the inkast the
-- tossed kubbs lie where they landed (in bounds or out) until they are raised
-- or picked up for a rethrow, and the engine's
-- pose ({x, y, angle}) would lay them flat on a face. An exact pose is used
-- only while the engine's pose is the one it was recorded with.
--
-- Standing kubbs and the king get the same: a piece a throw moved without
-- toppling stands as the throw left it (leaning on a neighbour, tilted on an
-- edge, raised on a piece), not stood up straight. These poses outlast the
-- turn (the pieces stay on the pitch); the turn's debris does not, so a new
-- turn marks them to be settled (d.settle): core/match runs the world to rest
-- once before the next throw, in case what propped a leaning piece has gone.
--
--   local d = debris.new()
--   debris.begin(d, turn)                  -- a new turn clears everything
--   local list = debris.pieces(d, side)    -- tw.world pieces, view frame
--   debris.applyExact(d, pieces, side)     -- exact poses onto outcome.pieces
--   ... the throw ...
--   debris.carry(d, res, side)             -- struck debris moves
--   debris.add(d, id, kind, res, side)     -- a baton or newly downed kubb
--   debris.recordExact(d, g, res, side)
--
-- Poses are kept in the world frame (core/frame) and handed out in the
-- thrower's view frame, so Team B's turned view is the same pitch.
import "core/tw"
import "core/frame"
import "core/body"

local frame, kinds = tw.frame, tw.body.kinds

local debris = {}

debris.tune = {
	matchEps = 1e-6,   -- m; an exact pose applies while the engine's x, y are these
}

function debris.new()
	return { turn = nil, list = {}, exact = {} }
end

-- Clear everything (the hand-off: the pitch is the engine's again).
function debris.clear(d)
	d.list, d.exact = {}, {}
end

-- Start (or continue) turn `turn`: a different turn clears the debris and
-- the lying poses. Standing pieces stay as they are; the debris that may
-- have propped them is gone, so they are to be settled.
function debris.begin(d, turn)
	if d.turn ~= turn then
		local keep = {}
		for id, e in pairs(d.exact) do
			if e.standing then keep[id] = e end
		end
		d.list, d.exact = {}, keep
		d.turn = turn
		d.settle = next(keep) ~= nil or nil
	end
end

function debris.count(d) return #d.list end

-- A world-frame pose from a result body (view frame of `side`).
local function fromBody(side, rb)
	local x, y = frame.point(side, rb.x, rb.y)
	local qw, qx, qy, qz = frame.quat(side, rb.qw, rb.qx, rb.qy, rb.qz)
	return x, y, rb.z, qw, qx, qy, qz
end

local function setFrom(e, side, rb)
	e.x, e.y, e.z, e.qw, e.qx, e.qy, e.qz = fromBody(side, rb)
end

local function find(d, id)
	for i, e in ipairs(d.list) do
		if e.id == id then return e, i end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Add (or move) piece `id` of `kind` ("kubb" | "baton") at its rest pose in
-- `res` (tw.world result, view frame of `side`). Returns the entry, or nil
-- when the result has no such body.
function debris.add(d, id, kind, res, side)
	local rb = res.bodies[id]
	if not rb then return nil end
	local e = find(d, id)
	if not e then
		e = { id = id, kind = kind }
		d.list[#d.list + 1] = e
	end
	setFrom(e, side, rb)
	return e
end

-- Move every debris piece to where this throw left it (struck or not: a
-- body that never woke rests where it started).
function debris.carry(d, res, side)
	for _, e in ipairs(d.list) do
		local rb = res.bodies[e.id]
		if rb then setFrom(e, side, rb) end
	end
end

-- The debris as tw.world pieces (full poses, already down) in `side`'s view
-- frame: { id, kind, x, y, z, qw..qz, toppled = true, debris = true }.
function debris.pieces(d, side)
	local out = {}
	for i, e in ipairs(d.list) do
		local x, y = frame.point(side, e.x, e.y)
		local qw, qx, qy, qz = frame.quat(side, e.qw, e.qx, e.qy, e.qz)
		out[i] = { id = e.id, kind = e.kind, x = x, y = y, z = e.z, qw = qw, qx = qx, qy = qy, qz = qz,
			toppled = true, debris = true }
	end
	return out
end

-- Would a standing body fall with its prop taken away (body.wouldFall from
-- a result body)? The engine may call such a piece standing (a thrown kubb
-- within 45 degrees of upright in the inkast, core/outcome); it is stood up
-- straight, as it always was, not carried leaning past its tipping point.
local function pastTipping(rb)
	local k = kinds[rb.kind]
	if not k or not k.hz then return false end
	local qw, qx, qy, qz = rb.qw, rb.qx, rb.qy, rb.qz
	local up = math.abs(1 - 2 * (qx * qx + qy * qy))
	return k.hz * math.abs(2 * (qx * qz - qw * qy)) > k.hx * up or k.hz * math.abs(2 * (qy * qz + qw * qx)) > k.hy * up
end

-- Remember the exact body pose of every kubb the engine has on the pitch
-- (lying or standing) and of the king, where the engine pose is where its
-- body came to rest. A piece whose body ended elsewhere (a throw put back, a
-- kubb raised where it was) keeps the pose it had.
local function record(d, keep, id, p, res, side, eps)
	local rb = res.bodies[id]
	local e
	if rb and not (p.standing and pastTipping(rb)) then
		local x, y = frame.point(side, rb.x, rb.y)
		if (x - p.x) ^ 2 + (y - p.y) ^ 2 <= eps * eps then
			e = { ex = p.x, ey = p.y, standing = p.standing or nil }
			setFrom(e, side, rb)
		end
	end
	if not e then
		local old = d.exact[id]
		if old and (old.ex - p.x) ^ 2 + (old.ey - p.y) ^ 2 <= eps * eps
			and (old.standing or false) == (p.standing or false) then e = old end
	end
	keep[id] = e
end

function debris.recordExact(d, g, res, side)
	local eps = debris.tune.matchEps
	local keep = {}
	for _, k in ipairs(g:onPitch()) do record(d, keep, k.id, k.pose, res, side, eps) end
	if g.king and g.king.pose then record(d, keep, "king", g.king.pose, res, side, eps) end
	d.exact = keep
end

-- Put the exact poses onto outcome.pieces (view frame of `side`): each piece
-- whose engine pose is the recorded one (lying or standing as recorded) gets
-- the body's pose and z.
function debris.applyExact(d, pieces, side)
	local eps = debris.tune.matchEps
	for _, p in ipairs(pieces) do
		local e = d.exact[p.id]
		if e and p.pose and (e.standing and true or false) == not p.toppled
			and (e.ex - p.pose.x) ^ 2 + (e.ey - p.pose.y) ^ 2 <= eps * eps then
			p.x, p.y = frame.point(side, e.x, e.y)
			p.qw, p.qx, p.qy, p.qz = frame.quat(side, e.qw, e.qx, e.qy, e.qz)
			p.z = e.z
		end
	end
end

tw.debris = debris
core/drill:
-- Drilling a kubb (DESIGN.md "Kubbs (drilling)"). Pure Lua: no playdate.*.
--
-- The aim is a landing marker on the ground in the far half. The thrower
-- stands on the baseline straight behind it (no walk step). The game solves
-- a launch that lands a clean drill on the marker: a low loft chosen by the
-- distance (drill.solve), or the plan's arc (drill.solveAt, which
-- core/throwplan solves with), and the speed that carries the kubb there.
--
-- Play launches a drill with tw.plan.launch (core/throwplan), which judges
-- the swing against the plan and gives drill.body's numbers. drill.launch
-- is the older launch against a power band, kept for core/bench, the tools
-- and tests that throw a clean drill, and the throw scene until it
-- launches drills through the plan:
--   power      against a target band (the power the distance needs): in the
--              band the speed barely moves, outside it the kubb goes short or long
--   smoothness a clean flick keeps the nose down and the kubb dies near the
--              marker; a jerky one wobbles it and it runs on
--   tilt       pushes the line a little sideways, the way pull says (+1 right)
--   cut        spins the kubb about its long axis (+ clockwise from behind): it
--              holds the kubb's attitude to the touch; on the ground it moves
--              it a little either way (which corner strikes first decides)
--
-- All in one frame: x across, y away from the thrower (the throw scene's view
-- frame). world.launchDrill (core/world) makes the body from drill.body's
-- numbers.
import "core/tw"
import "core/flight"

local sqrt, sin, cos, atan, rad, abs, min, max =
	math.sqrt, math.sin, math.cos, math.atan, math.rad, math.abs, math.min, math.max

local drill = {}
local flight = tw.flight

drill.tune = {
	-- the marker (relative to the thrower's baseline)
	markerXMax = 3.0,       -- m either side of the middle: a little past the 2.5 m sidelines
	markerNear = 3.5,       -- m out: a little short of the middle line (4 m)
	markerFar = 8.6,        -- m out: a little past the far baseline (8 m)
	markerStartY = 5.5,     -- m out where the marker starts
	markerSpeed = 0.6,      -- m/s the d-pad moves the marker at first ...
	markerSpeedMax = 3.0,   -- ... rising to this while held
	markerAccel = 3.0,      -- m/s^2 between the two
	throwerXMax = 2.4,      -- m: the thrower stands on the baseline inside the stakes
	-- the solved launch
	loftNearDeg = 26,       -- loft for the nearest marker (guess; a low drill)
	loftFarDeg = 30,        -- loft for the farthest (higher, so a full swing reaches it)
	landZ = 0.07,           -- m: the kubb's center height when its lowest edge reaches the grass
	-- The run on (2026-11-16): a clean drill does not stop where it lands; it bounces,
	-- tumbles and rolls on (Jamie: "it is impossible to stop that much energy with just
	-- the ground and grass"). It is aimed short by the mean distance along the throw that
	-- a clean drill rests past where it lands, by the loft (slideLofts, a row each) and
	-- how far out it lands (slideR, a column each), in a line between them and the
	-- nearest outside them. A faster landing runs on farther until it digs in harder (on
	-- sand soonest). Measured again once an impact's friction was solved in the bounce
	-- (2026-11-16, tools/drillscatter.lua --only 5 --grounds 60: 3 lines x 60 grounds a
	-- cell, aimed with none, the mean rest along the throw past the aimed landing; the
	-- release attitude and spiral below).
	slideLofts = { 26, 37, 47, 57 },
	slideR = { 1.5, 3, 4.5, 6, 7.5 },
	slide = {
		grass = { { 0.37, 1.21, 1.84, 1.38, 1.04 }, { 0.27, 0.71, 1.02, 1.00, 0.69 },
			{ 0.18, 0.47, 0.70, 0.75, 0.31 }, { 0.11, 0.26, 0.49, 0.55, 0.40 } },
		sand = { { 0.19, 0.65, 0.77, 0.32, 0.29 }, { 0.12, 0.39, 0.44, 0.23, 0.15 },
			{ 0.07, 0.23, 0.27, 0.17, 0.07 }, { 0.04, 0.11, 0.21, 0.17, 0.08 } },
		snow = { { 0.34, 1.13, 1.66, 1.63, 1.71 }, { 0.23, 0.73, 1.05, 1.23, 1.18 },
			{ 0.13, 0.41, 0.68, 0.94, 0.87 }, { 0.09, 0.25, 0.49, 0.64, 0.72 } },
	},
	slideRefM = 6,          -- m: the landing distance slideFor reads when given none
	-- the body at release (world.drillLaunchState, 2026-11-16: the drill is a plain
	-- rigid body, like a baton). Jamie: "we didn't treat Kubb throws with the same
	-- physics as baton throws" and "Good drillers would never let a Kubb flip in the
	-- air". Held by its back end at the bottom of an underhand swing, the kubb hangs
	-- nose forward and down; the wrist's snap spirals it about its long axis, a
	-- gyroscope, so it lands about as it left the hand: nose first.
	noseDownDeg = 45,       -- the long axis this far below the horizontal at release on the
	                        -- planned arc (Jamie's technique: it lands nose first at about 45).
	                        -- A spun drill (a tap or more) holds it to the touch; with only the
	                        -- small natural spiral the air turns the kubb toward broadside to its
	                        -- fall, so it lands steeper (about 60 to 65) and less the same each
	                        -- time. A later release (higher loft) lifts the nose with the arm,
	                        -- degree for degree, an earlier one drops it.
	spiral = 3,             -- rad/s: the small spiral the wrist always gives a drill (+ = clockwise
	                        -- from behind; Jamie: "even if the thrower indicates no spin, there
	                        -- would always be some small, subtle amount of rotation"); B +
	                        -- left/right taps add to it (plan.tune.spinPerStep)
	pitchSdDps = 30,        -- deg/s sd of the swing's nose up or down turn at release ...
	yawSdDps = 15,          -- ... of a turn across the line (about the kubb's own up) ...
	spinSd = 3,             -- ... rad/s of the spiral ...
	noseSdDeg = 4,          -- ... degrees of the release attitude ...
	scatterJerk = 1.5,      -- ... each this much more again for a jerky swing (smoothness 0)
	-- the swing against the band
	bandNear = 0.35,        -- swing power the nearest marker needs (gauge band center)
	bandFar = 0.85,         -- ... and the farthest; leaves room above to throw long
	bandHalf = 0.06,        -- the band is this wide either side of its center
	inBandGain = 0.25,      -- inside the band a power error counts this much
	speedPerPower = 1.0,    -- outside: launch speed changes by this fraction per unit of power
	speedMinFrac = 0.4,     -- never slower than this fraction of the solved speed
	cleanAbove = 0.75,      -- smoothness at or above this is a clean flick: no wobble
	wobbleRate = 10,        -- rad/s of nose-over wobble at smoothness 0 (scales with how far
	                        -- under cleanAbove the swing was)
	tiltPushDeg = 0.05,     -- degrees of line per degree of swing tilt
	cutSpin = 25,           -- rad/s about the long axis with A or B held at release (drill.launch;
	                        -- the plan's spin is plan.tune.spinPerStep a tap)
}

drill.CUT_NONE, drill.CUT_A, drill.CUT_B = 0, 1, -1

local function lerp(a, b, f)
	return a + (b - a) * f
end

-- Keep the marker in its area: mx across, my as distance from lineY.
function drill.clampMarker(mx, my)
	local t = drill.tune
	return max(-t.markerXMax, min(t.markerXMax, mx)), max(t.markerNear, min(t.markerFar, my))
end


-- Solve the clean drill onto the marker (mx, my in the view frame, the
-- thrower's baseline at lineY) at the loft the distance picks (loftNearDeg to
-- loftFarDeg). Fills and returns `out`:
--   x          where the thrower stands on the baseline
--   swivel     radians, + = right
--   loft       degrees
--   dist       m from the thrower to the marker
--   speed      m/s of the clean launch
--   band       swing power that gives exactly that speed (band center)
--   T          s from release until the kubb's edge reaches the grass
--   land       m from the thrower to where it lands (short of the marker by
--              its mean run on, drill.slideFor)
function drill.solve(mx, my, lineY, out)
	local t = drill.tune
	local x = max(-t.throwerXMax, min(t.throwerXMax, mx))
	local dx, dy = mx - x, my - lineY
	local d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
	local f = max(0, min(1, (d - t.markerNear) / (t.markerFar - t.markerNear)))
	return drill.solveAt(mx, my, lineY, lerp(t.loftNearDeg, t.loftFarDeg, f), out, x)
end

-- Where a table's sorted keys put x: the index below and the share of the
-- way to the next (clamped at both ends).
local function between(keys, x)
	local n = #keys
	if x <= keys[1] then return 1, 0 end
	if x >= keys[n] then return n - 1, 1 end
	for i = 2, n do
		if x <= keys[i] then return i - 1, (x - keys[i - 1]) / (keys[i] - keys[i - 1]) end
	end
	return n - 1, 1
end

-- How far a clean drill at this loft (degrees) runs on along the throw after
-- it lands R m out (nil: slideRefM), on this ground (nil: grass):
-- tune.slide, between its rows and columns. spin is taken and not used:
-- spin moves a drill across more than along, and in no steady direction
-- (which corner strikes first decides more).
function drill.slideFor(loftDeg, surface, spin, R)
	local t = drill.tune
	local rows = t.slide[surface or "grass"] or t.slide.grass
	local i, fi = between(t.slideLofts, loftDeg)
	local j, fj = between(t.slideR, R or t.slideRefM)
	local a, b = rows[i], rows[i + 1]
	return max(0, lerp(lerp(a[j], a[j + 1], fj), lerp(b[j], b[j + 1], fj), fi))
end

-- The landing distance that runs on to d (m) at this loft: the R with
-- R + slideFor(R) = d (a few steps; the run on changes slower than R).
function drill.landFor(d, loftDeg, surface, spin)
	local R = d
	for _ = 1, 6 do
		R = d - drill.slideFor(loftDeg, surface, spin, R)
		if R < 0.5 then R = 0.5 end
	end
	return R
end

-- The clean drill onto the marker at a given loft (degrees): the plan's arc
-- (core/throwplan). px is where the thrower stands on the baseline (nil:
-- straight behind the marker, inside throwerXMax); surface the ground (nil:
-- grass) and spin the planned spin (rad/s, nil: none), for how far it runs
-- on (drill.slideFor). Fills and returns `out` with the fields of
-- drill.solve. No table is made when `out` is given.
function drill.solveAt(mx, my, lineY, loftDeg, out, px, surface, spin)
	local t = drill.tune
	out = out or {}
	local x = px or max(-t.throwerXMax, min(t.throwerXMax, mx))
	local dx, dy = mx - x, my - lineY
	local d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
	local f = max(0, min(1, (d - t.markerNear) / (t.markerFar - t.markerNear)))
	local ft = flight.tune
	local h0 = ft.handHeight - t.landZ
	local e = rad(loftDeg)
	local R = drill.landFor(d, loftDeg, surface, spin)
	-- the speed that lands it R out through still air, with a kubb's drag
	local k = ft.dragK.kubb
	local v = flight.speedForCarry(R, e, h0, k)
	local _, T = flight.carry(v, e, h0, k)
	out.x, out.swivel, out.loft, out.dist, out.speed = x, atan(dx, dy), loftDeg, d, v
	out.band = lerp(t.bandNear, t.bandFar, f)
	out.T, out.land = T, R
	return out
end

-- The power error as it reaches the speed: shrunk inside the band.
function drill.powerError(power, band)
	local t = drill.tune
	local err = power - band
	local a = abs(err)
	if a <= t.bandHalf then return err * t.inBandGain end
	local e = t.bandHalf * t.inBandGain + (a - t.bandHalf)
	return err < 0 and -e or e
end

-- "short", "on" or "long": where the swing's power sat against the band.
function drill.judge(power, band)
	local d = power - band
	if d < -drill.tune.bandHalf then return "short" end
	if d > drill.tune.bandHalf then return "long" end
	return "on"
end

-- The band launch for `r` = { power, smoothness, tilt, pull } against the
-- solution `sol` (drill.solve), with cut drill.CUT_NONE / CUT_A / CUT_B: the
-- solved loft, the speed from the power against the band, the line pushed by
-- the tilt the way pull says (+1 right, the default; -1 left, also the
-- wobble's sign). Fills and returns `out`: swivel, loft, speed, noseDown,
-- rollLand, spin, wobble (the arguments of world.launchDrill after
-- x and lineY), plus jerk (0..1). Not the plan's launch (tw.plan.launch):
-- the release angle is not read.
function drill.launch(sol, r, cut, out)
	local t = drill.tune
	out = out or {}
	local e = drill.powerError(r.power or 0, sol.band)
	out.speed = sol.speed * max(t.speedMinFrac, 1 + t.speedPerPower * e)
	local pull = (r.pull or 1) < 0 and -1 or 1
	out.swivel = sol.swivel + pull * rad(t.tiltPushDeg * (r.tilt or 0))
	out.loft = sol.loft
	-- A (+1) spins it positive about the forward long axis (clockwise from
	-- behind), B the other way, on top of the wrist's spiral
	return drill.body(r.smoothness or 1, pull, (cut or 0) * t.cutSpin, out)
end

-- The drilled kubb's body at release (world.launchDrill's arguments after
-- the line of flight): fills `out` with noseDown, rollLand, spin (rad/s about
-- the long axis: as given plus the wrist's spiral), wobble and jerk (0..1). smoothness is the
-- swing's (or the plan's effective smoothness: core/throwplan); under
-- cleanAbove the kubb wobbles nose over tail, up to wobbleRate at 0 and
-- never more. pull (+1 or -1) is the wobble's sign.
function drill.body(smoothness, pull, spin, out, dLoft)
	local t = drill.tune
	local jerk = (t.cleanAbove - smoothness) / t.cleanAbove
	if jerk < 0 then jerk = 0 elseif jerk > 1 then jerk = 1 end
	spin = (spin or 0) + t.spiral
	out.noseDown, out.rollLand, out.spin = t.noseDownDeg - (dLoft or 0), 0, spin
	out.jerk = jerk
	out.wobble = pull * t.wobbleRate * jerk
	return out
end


tw.drill = drill
core/drills:
-- Practice drills (the Drills board): what each drill sets up, how a run is
-- scored and the records kept. Pure: no playdate.*.
--
-- A run is a fixed number of throws on its own pitch. drills.setup(d, run)
-- gives the next throw as a core/match-style setup (pieces in the view frame,
-- the line, the projectile, the targets) for scenes/throw's prepare;
-- drills.tally(d, run, res) takes what the throw did ({ toppled = {ids},
-- restCm = n, bodies = { [id] = rest pose } }) and says whether the run is
-- over; drills.record(rec, d, run) folds a finished run into the saved
-- records. drills.wall(kubbs, n, stakeX, stakeY, out) is THE WALL's test.
import "core/tw"
import "core/pitch"
import "core/rect"

local pitch, rect = tw.pitch, tw.rect
local abs, atan = math.abs, math.atan

local drills = {}

local function standing(id, kind, x, y)
	return { id = id, kind = kind, role = kind == "king" and "king" or "base", x = x, y = y,
		qw = 1, qx = 0, qy = 0, qz = 0, toppled = false }
end

local BASE_X <const> = { -2, -1, 0, 1, 2 }

-- the drills, in the board's order. score: what one point is; of: the
-- points a run can make; throws: per run.
drills.list = {
	{ id = "8m", name = "8 METERS", lines = { "SIX BATONS", "FIVE BASE KUBBS", "FROM THE BASELINE" },
		throws = 6, of = 5, kind = "base" },
	{ id = "house", name = "THE HOUSE", lines = { "SIX BATONS", "FIVE FIELD KUBBS", "BUNCHED UP AT 4 M" },
		throws = 6, of = 5, kind = "house" },
	{ id = "king", name = "KING SHOTS", lines = { "SIX BATONS", "AT THE KING ALONE", "FROM THE BASELINE" },
		throws = 6, of = 6, kind = "king" },
	{ id = "blast", name = "BLAST", lines = { "SIX KUBBS DRILLED", "TO THE MARKER", "WITHIN HALF A METER" },
		throws = 6, of = 6, kind = "blast" },
	{ id = "around", name = "AROUND THE PITCH", lines = { "FIVE BATONS", "ONE AT EACH BASE KUBB", "FROM IN FRONT OF IT" },
		throws = 5, of = 5, kind = "around" },
	-- of: every kubb of the six groups (14) plus a bonus for each baton (6)
	{ id = "doubles", name = "DOUBLES", lines = { "SIX BATONS, SIX GROUPS", "A POINT A KUBB DOWN", "+1 FOR TWO AT ONCE" },
		throws = 6, of = 20, kind = "doubles" },
	{ id = "wall", name = "THE WALL", lines = { "SIX KUBBS DRILLED", "INTO THE RIGHT STAKE", "A POINT A KUBB IN IT" },
		throws = 6, of = 6, kind = "wall" },
}

drills.tune = {
	blastCm = 50,          -- a drilled kubb resting this near the marker scores
	blastMarkerY = 6,      -- m from the baseline: BLAST's marker, fixed (scores stay comparable)
	house = { { 0.00, 4.20 }, { 0.10, 4.30 }, { -0.10, 4.32 }, { 0.03, 4.42 }, { -0.06, 4.52 } },
	lastN = 10,            -- the scores kept for LAST TEN
	-- DOUBLES: one group per baton, in this order, each stood fresh for its
	-- baton (the last group's kubbs are cleared), so every run faces the same
	-- six shots and bests compare. kind: "pair"/"triple" side by side (across
	-- the throw), "inline2"/"inline3" one behind the other (along it); gap:
	-- face to face in m (tools/compound.lua's 3, 7 and 15 cm); x, y: the
	-- group's center, field-kubb distances from the baseline (guesses, an
	-- easy first shot to a hard last one).
	doubles = {
		{ kind = "pair", gap = 0.03, x = 0.0, y = 4.6 },
		{ kind = "inline2", gap = 0.03, x = -0.8, y = 4.9 },
		{ kind = "triple", gap = 0.03, x = 0.8, y = 5.2 },
		{ kind = "pair", gap = 0.07, x = -0.5, y = 5.5 },
		{ kind = "inline3", gap = 0.07, x = 0.5, y = 5.8 },
		{ kind = "pair", gap = 0.15, x = 0.0, y = 6.0 },
	},
	doublesBonus = 1,      -- extra points when one baton takes down two or more of its group
	-- THE WALL: kubbs drilled into the centerline stake on the thrower's right
	-- (x = 2.5, y = 4 in the view frame; the marker moves freely)
	wallStake = 4,         -- index in pitch.stakes: the right-hand end of the centerline
	wallBand = 0.15,       -- m: a wall kubb's center within this of the centerline ...
	wallGap = 0.12,        -- m: ... and its footprint this near (edge to edge) the stake or a wall kubb
	wallLyingCos = 0.7071, -- lying: the long axis within 45 degrees of horizontal (|r33| under cos 45)
}

function drills.byId(id)
	for _, d in ipairs(drills.list) do if d.id == id then return d end end
	return nil
end

-- A new run of drill d.
function drills.newRun(d)
	-- kubbs: THE WALL's drilled kubbs at rest ({id, x, y, z, qw..qz, toppled});
	-- inWall: which of them are in the wall now; multi: DOUBLES batons that took two or more
	return { id = d.id, n = 0, score = 0, down = {}, done = false, kubbs = {}, inWall = {}, multi = 0 }
end

-- DOUBLES group g (a drills.tune.doubles entry) as standing field kubbs
-- "g<i>k1".. appended to out (a new table when nil). Kubb centers are a
-- kubb's side plus the gap apart, the group centered on (g.x, g.y).
function drills.group(g, i, out)
	out = out or {}
	local n = (g.kind == "triple" or g.kind == "inline3") and 3 or 2
	local step = pitch.kubbSide + g.gap
	local inline = g.kind == "inline2" or g.kind == "inline3"
	for k = 1, n do
		local o = (k - (n + 1) / 2) * step
		local x, y = g.x, g.y
		if inline then y = y + o else x = x + o end
		local p = standing("g" .. i .. "k" .. k, "kubb", x, y)
		p.role = "field"
		out[#out + 1] = p
	end
	return out
end

-- THE WALL's test over rest poses: kubbs[1..n] are { x, y, qw, qx, qy, qz }
-- (world meters, the view frame of the thrower). A kubb is in the wall when
--   1. it lies (long axis within 45 degrees of horizontal: wallLyingCos),
--   2. its center is on the pitch's width (|x| <= halfWidth) and within
--      wallBand of the centerline (|y - 4| <= wallBand), and its footprint
--      reaches the far half (touches or crosses y = 4),
--   3. its footprint (an oriented 15 x 7 cm rectangle) is within wallGap,
--      edge to edge, of the stake's circle at (stakeX, stakeY), or of a kubb
--      already in the wall: the chain grows from the stake.
-- Fills out[i] = true/false and returns how many are in. The score is the
-- wall as it stands: a kubb knocked out of it (or cut off from the stake)
-- stops counting. Once per throw, not per frame (rect makes tables).
function drills.wall(kubbs, n, stakeX, stakeY, out)
	local t = drills.tune
	local hl, hw = pitch.kubbLong / 2, pitch.kubbSide / 2
	local cy = pitch.center
	local rects, cand = {}, {}
	for i = 1, n do
		out[i] = false
		local k = kubbs[i]
		-- the long axis: column 3 of the rotation matrix
		local ax = 2 * (k.qx * k.qz + k.qw * k.qy)
		local ay = 2 * (k.qy * k.qz - k.qw * k.qx)
		local az = 1 - 2 * (k.qx * k.qx + k.qy * k.qy)
		if abs(az) < t.wallLyingCos and abs(k.x) <= pitch.halfWidth and abs(k.y - cy) <= t.wallBand then
			local r = rect.new(k.x, k.y, atan(ay, ax), hl, hw)
			local top = -math.huge
			for _, c in ipairs(rect.corners(r)) do if c[2] > top then top = c[2] end end
			if top >= cy then
				rects[i], cand[#cand + 1] = r, i
			end
		end
	end
	-- the chain: from the stake, then from every kubb found in the wall
	local count, queue, head = 0, {}, 1
	for _, i in ipairs(cand) do
		if rect.pointDistance(rects[i], stakeX, stakeY) - pitch.stakeRadius <= t.wallGap then
			out[i], count = true, count + 1
			queue[#queue + 1] = i
		end
	end
	while head <= #queue do
		local a = rects[queue[head]]
		head = head + 1
		for _, i in ipairs(cand) do
			if not out[i] and rect.distance(a, rects[i]) <= t.wallGap then
				out[i], count = true, count + 1
				queue[#queue + 1] = i
			end
		end
	end
	return count
end

-- The pieces standing for this run now (kubbs knocked down stay down; the
-- king is stood back up after each throw).
local function pieces(d, run)
	local out = {}
	if d.kind == "base" or d.kind == "around" then
		for i, x in ipairs(BASE_X) do
			local id = "b" .. i
			if not run.down[id] then out[#out + 1] = standing(id, "kubb", x, pitch.length) end
		end
	elseif d.kind == "house" then
		for i, p in ipairs(drills.tune.house) do
			local id = "f" .. i
			if not run.down[id] then
				local k = standing(id, "kubb", p[1], p[2])
				k.role = "field" -- field kubbs: the aim takes the field-kubb arc (4 o'clock)
				out[#out + 1] = k
			end
		end
	elseif d.kind == "doubles" then
		-- this baton's group only, standing fresh
		local g = drills.tune.doubles[run.n + 1]
		if g then drills.group(g, run.n + 1, out) end
		return out
	elseif d.kind == "wall" then
		-- every kubb drilled so far, lying where it came to rest (no king:
		-- it stands on the centerline the wall runs along)
		for i = 1, #run.kubbs do
			local k = run.kubbs[i]
			out[#out + 1] = { id = k.id, kind = "kubb", role = "field", x = k.x, y = k.y, z = k.z,
				qw = k.qw, qx = k.qx, qy = k.qy, qz = k.qz, toppled = k.toppled }
		end
		return out
	end
	if d.kind ~= "blast" then out[#out + 1] = standing("king", "king", pitch.king.x, pitch.king.y) end
	return out
end

-- The next throw's setup, or nil when the run is over.
function drills.setup(d, run)
	if run.done then return nil end
	local ps = pieces(d, run)
	local s = { kind = "baton", side = "A", pieces = ps, lineY = 0, forwardY = 0, projectile = "baton",
		n = run.n + 1, of = d.throws, batonId = "baton" }
	local targets = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(ps) do
		if p.kind == "kubb" then targets[#targets + 1] = p.id end
	end
	if d.kind == "king" or #targets == 0 then targets = { "king" } end
	s.targets = targets
	if d.kind == "blast" then
		s.kind, s.projectile, s.kubb, s.targets = "toss", "kubb", "d1", nil
		s.markerX, s.markerY = 0, drills.tune.blastMarkerY   -- fixed: the d-pad does not move it
	elseif d.kind == "wall" then
		-- each drilled kubb its own piece (w1 .. w6), kept on the pitch; the
		-- marker is free (no markerY: throw keeps it where the last throw left it)
		s.kind, s.projectile, s.kubb, s.targets = "toss", "kubb", "w" .. (run.n + 1), nil
	elseif d.kind == "around" then
		-- from in front of the kubb whose turn it is (the next standing one)
		s.playerX = BASE_X[run.n + 1]
	end
	return s
end

-- What a throw did: res.toppled (ids), res.restCm (a drilled kubb's rest
-- from the marker). Returns true when the run is over.
function drills.tally(d, run, res)
	run.n = run.n + 1
	if d.kind == "blast" then
		if res.restCm and res.restCm <= drills.tune.blastCm then run.score = run.score + 1 end
	elseif d.kind == "doubles" then
		-- a point for every kubb of this baton's group down, and a bonus when
		-- one baton took two or more
		local prefix, n = "g" .. run.n .. "k", 0
		for _, id in ipairs(res.toppled or {}) do
			if id:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix and not run.down[id] then
				run.down[id] = true
				n = n + 1
			end
		end
		run.score = run.score + n
		if n >= 2 then
			run.score = run.score + drills.tune.doublesBonus
			run.multi = run.multi + 1
		end
	elseif d.kind == "wall" then
		-- every wall kubb where this throw left it (res.bodies: the throw's
		-- world result, rest poses by id), then the wall as it stands
		local bodies = res.bodies or {}
		local id = "w" .. run.n
		if bodies[id] then run.kubbs[#run.kubbs + 1] = { id = id } end
		for i = 1, #run.kubbs do
			local k, b = run.kubbs[i], bodies[run.kubbs[i].id]
			if b then
				k.x, k.y, k.z, k.qw, k.qx, k.qy, k.qz, k.toppled = b.x, b.y, b.z, b.qw, b.qx, b.qy, b.qz, b.toppled
			end
		end
		local st = pitch.stakes[drills.tune.wallStake]
		run.score = drills.wall(run.kubbs, #run.kubbs, st.x, st.y, run.inWall)
	elseif d.kind == "king" then
		for _, id in ipairs(res.toppled or {}) do
			if id == "king" then run.score = run.score + 1 break end
		end
	else
		for _, id in ipairs(res.toppled or {}) do
			if id ~= "king" and not run.down[id] then
				run.down[id] = true
				run.score = run.score + 1
			end
		end
	end
	-- over after its throws, or when nothing is left standing to knock down
	if run.n >= d.throws or ((d.kind == "base" or d.kind == "house" or d.kind == "around") and run.score >= d.of) then
		run.done = true
	end
	return run.done
end

-- Records: { [id] = { best, runs, points, possible, last = {...} } }.
-- Folds a finished run in; returns the drill's record and whether it is a
-- new best.
function drills.record(rec, d, run)
	local r = rec[d.id]
	if not r then
		r = { best = 0, runs = 0, points = 0, possible = 0, last = {} }
		rec[d.id] = r
	end
	local best = run.score > r.best
	if best then r.best = run.score end
	r.runs, r.points, r.possible = r.runs + 1, r.points + run.score, r.possible + d.of
	r.last[#r.last + 1] = run.score
	while #r.last > drills.tune.lastN do table.remove(r.last, 1) end
	return r, best
end

-- A record's rate (whole percent of the points possible), or nil.
function drills.rate(r)
	if not r or r.possible == 0 then return nil end
	return math.floor(100 * r.points / r.possible + 0.5)
end

tw.drills = drills
core/flight:
-- Baton flight for stage 1: a plain ballistic arc with tumble, no collisions.
-- Pure Lua: no playdate.*.
--
-- The baton leaves the hand at (x, lineY, handHeight), heading along the
-- swivel (0 = straight downfield, positive = toward +x) at the loft angle
-- above the horizontal. It turns end over end at the tumble
-- rate; the plane it turns in is tilted about the line of flight by the
-- swing's tilt (0 = clean end over end, 90 = a flat helicopter) and wobbles
-- around that tilt. Gravity and the air's drag (tune.dragK, the same figure
-- core/world flies the baton with). It stops dead the moment its center
-- reaches the ground and lies flat there (stage 2 replaces all of this with
-- the rigid body).
--
-- flight.carry and flight.speedForCarry are the aim's arithmetic: how far a
-- launch carries through still air, and the speed that carries a distance.
-- core/throwplan, core/drill and core/autothrow aim with them.
import "core/tw"

local sqrt, sin, cos, rad, abs, min, max = math.sqrt, math.sin, math.cos, math.rad, math.abs, math.min, math.max

local flight = {}

flight.tune = {
	g = 9.81,              -- m/s^2
	handHeight = 0.6,      -- m; release height at the throwing line
	batonLength = 0.30,    -- m (DESIGN 2)
	batonRadius = 0.022,   -- m (4.4 cm diameter)
	loftMinDeg = 5,        -- d-pad down limit: a low, hard throw (Jamie, 2026-11-14: was 15)
	loftMaxDeg = 55,       -- d-pad up limit: a high arc
	loftStepDeg = 5,       -- one d-pad press
	loftDefaultDeg = 35,   -- mid loft
	startAngle = math.pi / 2, -- tumble angle at release: upright in the hand
	wobbleAmp = 0.25,      -- the plane's tilt swings by this fraction of the tilt ...
	wobblePerTurn = 0.6,   -- ... this many times per tumble turn
	maxStep = 1 / 120,     -- s; flight.step subdivides longer frames
	-- The air's drag (audit 8, 2026-11-16): a thrown piece loses k |r| r of its
	-- velocity a second, r the air's velocity past it (the wind less its own),
	-- k = 0.5 rho Cd A / m (1/m), rho 1.2 kg/m^3. Figures from the drag tables
	-- in White, Fluid Mechanics, Tables 7.2 and 7.3 (after Hoerner, Fluid-Dynamic
	-- Drag), at a throw's Reynolds number (2 to 5 x 10^4, subcritical); estimates,
	-- good to perhaps 20 percent:
	--   baton  0.30 x 0.044 m round birch, 0.25 kg, turning end over end. Side on,
	--          a finite cylinder of L/D 6.8 has Cd 0.77 on 0.0132 m^2; end on,
	--          0.95 on 0.0015 m^2. At an angle the crossflow principle gives each
	--          part times |sin|^3 (|cos|^3 end on), whose mean over the turn is
	--          4 / 3 pi: Cd A = 0.0049 m^2, k = 0.0118
	--   kubb   0.15 x 0.07 x 0.07 m, 0.40 kg, tumbling (a lob) or spiralling
	--          about broadside to its flight (a drill, the nose 45 down on a
	--          rising throw): the mean area a tumbling block shows the air is a
	--          quarter of its surface (Cauchy), 0.0130 m^2, with Cd 1.0 (a cube
	--          is 1.07 face on, 0.81 edge on): Cd A = 0.0130 m^2, k = 0.0194
	-- At 10 m/s that is 1.2 m/s^2 on a baton, 1.9 on a kubb.
	dragK = { baton = 0.0118, kubb = 0.0194 },
	carryStep = 1 / 20,    -- s: flight.carry's midpoint step (within 2.5 mm of a fine one on
	                       -- any throw the game makes; cheap enough to solve every aim frame)
}

-- Unit launch velocity direction.
local function launchDir(swivel, loftDeg)
	local e = rad(loftDeg)
	local ce = cos(e)
	return sin(swivel) * ce, cos(swivel) * ce, sin(e)
end

-- Time from a launch height z0 with upward speed vz until z = 0.
local function timeToGround(z0, vz, g)
	return (vz + sqrt(vz * vz + 2 * g * z0)) / g
end

-- How far a launch at speed (m/s) and loft e (radians) from h (m) above the
-- ground carries through still air with drag k (1/m, tune.dragK) before it
-- comes down to the ground: R (m, horizontal) and T (s). Midpoint steps of
-- tune.carryStep (exact for gravity alone, which k = 0 takes in one go); the
-- last is cut where it reaches the ground. No tables.
local function carry(speed, e, h, k)
	local t = flight.tune
	local g = t.g
	local u, w = speed * cos(e), speed * sin(e)
	if k <= 0 then
		local T = timeToGround(h, w, g)
		return u * T, T
	end
	local H = t.carryStep
	local x, z, time = 0, h, 0
	for _ = 1, 3000 do
		local s = sqrt(u * u + w * w)
		local hu = u - 0.5 * H * k * s * u
		local hw = w - 0.5 * H * (g + k * s * w)
		local sm = sqrt(hu * hu + hw * hw)
		local au, aw = -k * sm * hu, -g - k * sm * hw
		local z1 = z + H * hw
		if z1 <= 0 then
			-- this step reaches the ground: z + w s + aw s^2 / 2 = 0 (aw < 0)
			local a = -aw
			local tau = (w + sqrt(w * w + 2 * a * z)) / a
			return x + u * tau + 0.5 * au * tau * tau, time + tau
		end
		x, z = x + H * hu, z1
		u, w = u + H * au, w + H * aw
		time = time + H
	end
	return x, time
end
flight.carry = carry

-- The speed (m/s) that carries R (m) at loft e (radians) from h (m) above the
-- ground through still air with drag k (flight.carry's inverse), and its
-- flight time T (s): from the drag-free speed, a scaled step and then secant
-- steps to within 0.1 um (so the two invert each other on the desktop), or
-- until a step stops getting closer: the device's 32-bit floats stop well
-- short of 0.1 um, and stepping on there only spent carries (the aim solves
-- this every frame the target moves). Two equal carries would divide by zero.
function flight.speedForCarry(R, e, h, k)
	local g = flight.tune.g
	local c = cos(e)
	local v0 = sqrt(g * R * R / (2 * c * c * (R * sin(e) / c + h)))
	if k <= 0 then return v0, timeToGround(h, v0 * sin(e), g) end
	local r0, T0 = carry(v0, e, h, k)
	local best = r0 - R
	if best < 0 then best = -best end
	local v1 = v0 * sqrt(R / r0)
	for _ = 1, 10 do
		local r1, T = carry(v1, e, h, k)
		local err = r1 - R
		local a = err < 0 and -err or err
		if a >= best then return v0, T0 end
		local dr = r1 - r0
		if a < 1e-7 or dr == 0 then return v1, T end
		local v2 = v1 - err * (v1 - v0) / dr
		if v2 == v1 or v2 ~= v2 then return v1, T end
		v0, r0, T0, v1, best = v1, r1, T, v2, a
	end
	return v0, T0
end

-- Predicted landing point and flight time of the baton's center:
-- lx, ly, T (flight.carry with the baton's drag): the arc flight.step follows.
-- z (nil: 0, the ground) is the height the centre comes down to: plan.solve
-- aims it through a piece at its aim height (plan.aimZFor).
function flight.predict(x, lineY, swivel, loftDeg, speed, z)
	local t = flight.tune
	local dx, dy = sin(swivel), cos(swivel)
	local R, T = carry(speed, rad(loftDeg), t.handHeight - (z or 0), t.dragK.baton)
	return x + R * dx, lineY + R * dy, T
end

-- The aim preview: where a full-power throw at this loft would land.
function flight.aimPreview(x, lineY, swivel, loftDeg, fullSpeed)
	local lx, ly = flight.predict(x, lineY, swivel, loftDeg, fullSpeed)
	return lx, ly
end

function flight.new()
	return {
		x = 0, y = 0, z = 0, vx = 0, vy = 0, vz = 0,
		t = 0, T = 0,         -- time since release, predicted flight time
		phi = 0, rate = 0,    -- tumble angle (rad) and rate (rad/s)
		tilt = 0,             -- rotation plane tilt, radians
		dx = 0, dy = 1,       -- horizontal line of flight (unit)
		ox = 0, oy = 0,       -- launch point (ground)
		lx = 0, ly = 0,       -- predicted landing point
		landed = false,
		restAx = 1, restAy = 0, -- axis when lying on the ground
	}
end

-- Start a throw. tiltDeg comes from the swing (0 = clean).
function flight.launch(fl, x, lineY, swivel, loftDeg, speed, tumbleRate, tiltDeg)
	local t = flight.tune
	local dx, dy, dz = launchDir(swivel, loftDeg)
	fl.x, fl.y, fl.z = x, lineY, t.handHeight
	fl.vx, fl.vy, fl.vz = speed * dx, speed * dy, speed * dz
	fl.ox, fl.oy = x, lineY
	fl.dx, fl.dy = sin(swivel), cos(swivel)
	fl.t, fl.phi, fl.rate, fl.tilt = 0, t.startAngle, tumbleRate, rad(tiltDeg or 0)
	fl.lx, fl.ly, fl.T = flight.predict(x, lineY, swivel, loftDeg, speed)
	fl.landed = false
	return fl
end

-- Current tilt of the rotation plane, with its wobble.
function flight.planeTilt(fl)
	local t = flight.tune
	local turns = (t.startAngle - fl.phi) / (2 * math.pi)
	return fl.tilt * (1 + t.wobbleAmp * sin(2 * math.pi * t.wobblePerTurn * turns))
end

-- Unit baton axis: ax, ay, az. In flight it turns in the plane spanned by
-- the line of flight d and the "up" of the plane u, where u is z rotated
-- about d by the plane tilt (so a 90 degree tilt is a flat helicopter).
-- The top end tips forward: phi falls from pi/2 (upright) through 0 (along d).
function flight.axis(fl)
	if fl.landed then return fl.restAx, fl.restAy, 0 end
	local tau = flight.planeTilt(fl)
	local dx, dy = fl.dx, fl.dy
	local rx, ry = dy, -dx               -- right of the line of flight
	local ct, st = cos(tau), sin(tau)
	local ux, uy, uz = rx * st, ry * st, ct
	local cp, sp = cos(fl.phi), sin(fl.phi)
	return dx * cp + ux * sp, dy * cp + uy * sp, uz * sp
end

local function settle(fl)
	local ax, ay = flight.axis(fl)
	local n = sqrt(ax * ax + ay * ay)
	if n < 1e-3 then ax, ay, n = fl.dx, fl.dy, 1 end
	fl.restAx, fl.restAy = ax / n, ay / n
	fl.landed = true
	fl.z = 0
	fl.vx, fl.vy, fl.vz = 0, 0, 0
end

-- Advance by dt seconds: gravity and the baton's drag, flight.carry's
-- midpoint steps; the step that reaches the ground is cut at the contact
-- instant. Returns true on the step that lands.
function flight.step(fl, dt)
	if fl.landed then return false end
	local g = flight.tune.g
	local k = flight.tune.dragK.baton
	local maxStep = flight.tune.maxStep
	while dt > 0 do
		local h = min(dt, maxStep)
		dt = dt - h
		local vx, vy, vz = fl.vx, fl.vy, fl.vz
		local s = sqrt(vx * vx + vy * vy + vz * vz)
		local mx, my = vx - 0.5 * h * k * s * vx, vy - 0.5 * h * k * s * vy
		local mz = vz - 0.5 * h * (g + k * s * vz)
		local sm = sqrt(mx * mx + my * my + mz * mz)
		local ax, ay, az = -k * sm * mx, -k * sm * my, -g - k * sm * mz
		local z1 = fl.z + h * mz
		if z1 <= 0 then
			-- the root of z + vz s + az s^2 / 2 = 0 in (0, h]
			local s1 = (vz + sqrt(vz * vz - 2 * az * fl.z)) / -az
			if s1 > h then s1 = h end
			fl.x = fl.x + (vx + 0.5 * ax * s1) * s1
			fl.y = fl.y + (vy + 0.5 * ay * s1) * s1
			fl.t = fl.t + s1
			fl.phi = fl.phi - fl.rate * s1
			settle(fl)
			return true
		end
		fl.x, fl.y, fl.z = fl.x + h * mx, fl.y + h * my, z1
		fl.vx, fl.vy, fl.vz = vx + h * ax, vy + h * ay, vz + h * az
		fl.t = fl.t + h
		fl.phi = fl.phi - fl.rate * h
	end
	return false
end

-- Horizontal distance from the launch point.
function flight.distance(fl)
	local ex, ey = fl.x - fl.ox, fl.y - fl.oy
	return sqrt(ex * ex + ey * ey)
end

-- Fraction of the predicted flight done, 0..1 (for the follow camera).
function flight.progress(fl)
	if fl.landed or fl.T <= 0 then return 1 end
	return max(0, min(1, fl.t / fl.T))
end

-- Whole tumble turns so far.
function flight.turns(fl)
	return abs(flight.tune.startAngle - fl.phi) / (2 * math.pi)
end

tw.flight = flight
core/frame:
-- The thrower's view frame. Throwing code (the throw scene, cameras, flight,
-- the HUD) always throws from y = 0 toward +y. Team A throws from y = 0 in
-- the world frame already; for Team B the whole pitch is turned 180 degrees
-- about its center, (x, y) -> (-x, 8 - y), angles + pi, so Team B's baseline
-- is at y = 0 of its view. The turn is its own inverse: the same functions
-- convert world -> view and view -> world. The six stakes, the king's spot
-- and the base kubb spots map onto themselves (b3 lands where a3 stands).
-- Pure Lua: no playdate.*.
import "core/tw"
import "core/pitch"

local pi = math.pi

local frame = {}

local LEN = tw.pitch.length

-- (x, y) in the other frame for `side` ("A" is the identity).
function frame.point(side, x, y)
	if side == "B" then return -x, LEN - y end
	return x, y
end

-- A y coordinate alone (a throwing or advantage line).
function frame.y(side, y)
	if side == "B" then return LEN - y end
	return y
end

-- An angle (radians from +x) in the other frame, kept in (-pi, pi].
function frame.angle(side, a)
	a = a or 0
	if side == "B" then a = a + pi end
	while a > pi do a = a - 2 * pi end
	while a <= -pi do a = a + 2 * pi end
	return a
end

-- An engine pose ({x, y, standing, angle, onTop}) in the other frame: a new table.
function frame.pose(side, p)
	local x, y = frame.point(side, p.x, p.y)
	return { x = x, y = y, standing = p.standing, angle = frame.angle(side, p.angle), onTop = p.onTop }
end

-- A body orientation in the other frame: the half turn about z applied on
-- the left, (0, 0, 0, 1) * q.
function frame.quat(side, qw, qx, qy, qz)
	if side == "B" then return -qz, -qy, qx, qw end
	return qw, qx, qy, qz
end

tw.frame = frame
core/gamefile:
-- What the games list shows of a finished game file (DESIGN 7, the Games
-- board): its headers, turns, minutes, each team's baton hit rate and the
-- baton the king fell to. Pure: reads the file's text, no playdate.*.
import "core/tw"
import "core/cards"

local cards = tw.cards

local gamefile = {}

local MONTHS <const> = { "JAN", "FEB", "MAR", "APR", "MAY", "JUN", "JUL", "AUG", "SEP", "OCT", "NOV", "DEC" }

-- An inkast token carries I or R (core/notation writes IRPQN in order).
local function isInkast(tok) return tok:find("[IR]") ~= nil end

-- The game's summary, or nil and why. Fields: headers (every [Key "Value"]),
-- a, b (team names), winner ("A" | "B" | nil), first ("A" | "B"), turns,
-- minutes, date ("NOV 20"), start (the header's text), mode, hits =
-- { A = { hits, thrown }, B = ... }, kingBaton (the baton of its turn the
-- king fell to, or nil), lines (the file's lines, for the score sheet).
function gamefile.parse(text)
	if type(text) ~= "string" then return nil, "no text" end
	local h, lines = {}, {}
	local hits = { A = { 0, 0 }, B = { 0, 0 } }
	local turns, kingBaton = 0, nil
	local first = nil
	for line in (text .. "\n"):gmatch("([^\n]*)\n") do
		lines[#lines + 1] = line
		local k, v = line:match('^%[([^"]-)%s+"(.*)"%]%s*$')
		if k then
			h[k] = v
		else
			local n, rest = line:match("^(%d+)%.%s+(.*)$")
			if n then
				n = tonumber(n)
				if n > turns then turns = n end
				first = first or ((h["First"] == "Team B") and "B" or "A")
				local side = (n % 2 == 1) and first or ((first == "A") and "B" or "A")
				local batons = 0
				-- a note (# ...) says what the tokens cannot: not throws
				rest = rest:gsub("%s*#.*$", "")
				-- comments in parentheses, positions "(@ 1.32,5.87)" among
				-- them, belong to the token before them: not tokens
				rest = rest:gsub("%b()", " ")
				for tok in rest:gmatch("%S+") do
					local t = tok:match("^[%w_]+:(.+)$") or tok
					if not t:match("^%d+A$") and not isInkast(t) then
						local _, _, hit, thrown = cards.batonCounts(t)
						if thrown then
							batons = batons + 1
							hits[side][2] = hits[side][2] + 1
							if hit then hits[side][1] = hits[side][1] + 1 end
							if t == "K" then kingBaton = batons end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if not h["Team A"] or not h["Team B"] then return nil, "no teams" end
	local win = h["Win"]
	local s = { headers = h, a = h["Team A"], b = h["Team B"], first = first or "A", turns = turns,
		winner = (win == "Team A") and "A" or ((win == "Team B") and "B" or nil),
		start = h["Start"], mode = h["Mode"], hits = hits, kingBaton = kingBaton, lines = lines }
	-- players a team ("Kim (kim), Max (max)": a comma between each)
	s.players = {}
	for _, side in ipairs { "A", "B" } do
		local v = h["Team " .. side .. " Players"]
		local n = 0
		if v then for _ in v:gmatch("%(") do n = n + 1 end end
		s.players[side] = n
	end
	s.minutes = tonumber((h["Duration"] or ""):match("^(%d+)m")) or 0
	local _, mo, d = (h["Start"] or ""):match("^(%d+)-(%d+)-(%d+)")
	s.date = mo and (MONTHS[tonumber(mo)] .. " " .. tonumber(d)) or ""
	return s
end

-- A game file's line as the score sheet shows it on screen: without the
-- positions on the pitch (" (@ 4.39,4.61 4.34,5.21)"), which are for readers
-- that draw the pitch and would fill the 400 px screen. Other comments stay.
function gamefile.shown(line)
	return (line:gsub(" ?%(@[^()]*%)", ""))
end

-- A team's hit rate as a whole percent, or nil when it threw no batons.
function gamefile.rate(s, side)
	local r = s.hits[side]
	if r[2] == 0 then return nil end
	return math.floor(100 * r[1] / r[2] + 0.5)
end

tw.gamefile = gamefile
core/history:
-- A saved player's history (docs/PLAYERS.md section 2): totals on the
-- roster record (core/roster), and in the player's own file (datastore
-- "player-<key>", source/players.lua) the recent games, the drill records
-- and the level changes. Pure Lua: no playdate.*. Folded in once at the end
-- of a match or a drill run; never read back from game files.
--
-- A history file is plain data:
--   { v = 1,
--     games = { { d, f, team, side, res, vs, b, h, k, lv }, ... }   newest last,
--             d = "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM", f = the game file name, team and vs =
--             the team names, res = "won" | "lost" | "resigned", b and h =
--             batons and hits, k = kubbs thrown in, lv = the level played at
--     drills = { [drill id] = core/drills record }
--     levels = { { d, from, to }, ... } }                           newest last
import "core/tw"
import "core/roster"
import "core/drills"

local roster, drills = tw.roster, tw.drills

local history = {}

history.version = 1

history.tune = {
	games = 20,     -- recent games kept per player
	levels = 10,    -- level changes kept
}

function history.new()
	return { v = history.version, games = {}, drills = {}, levels = {} }
end

-- A history file read back, cleaned (anything else: an empty history).
function history.valid(d)
	local h = history.new()
	if type(d) ~= "table" then return h end
	if type(d.games) == "table" then
		for _, e in ipairs(d.games) do
			if type(e) == "table" and type(e.d) == "string" then h.games[#h.games + 1] = e end
		end
	end
	if type(d.drills) == "table" then
		for id, rec in pairs(d.drills) do
			if type(id) == "string" and type(rec) == "table" and type(rec.best) == "number" then
				if type(rec.last) ~= "table" then rec.last = {} end
				h.drills[id] = rec
			end
		end
	end
	if type(d.levels) == "table" then
		for _, e in ipairs(d.levels) do
			if type(e) == "table" and type(e.to) == "string" then h.levels[#h.levels + 1] = e end
		end
	end
	return h
end

local function trim(list, n)
	while #list > n do table.remove(list, 1) end
end

-- "2FB" -> field 2, base 1; "K" a king; "=" a king missed; "Z" illegal.
local function batonCounts(token)
	local f, b = 0, 0
	local fs = token:match("^(%d*)F")
	if fs then f = fs == "" and 1 or tonumber(fs) end
	local bs = token:match("(%d*)BE?$")
	if bs then b = bs == "" and 1 or tonumber(bs) end
	return f, b
end

-- What each player of game g did, by player id:
--   { side, batons, hits, field, base, kings, kingMisses, illegal, I, R, P, Q }
-- Batons are throws (X and G are not); a hit toppled a kubb or, on a king
-- shot, the king.
function history.gameStats(g)
	local out = {}
	for _, side in ipairs { "A", "B" } do
		for _, p in ipairs(g.teams[side].players) do
			local s = { side = side }
			for _, k in ipairs(roster.TOTALS) do s[k] = 0 end
			out[p.id] = s
		end
	end
	for _, t in ipairs(g.sheet.turns) do
		for pid, k in pairs(t.inkast) do
			local s = out[pid]
			if s then
				s.I, s.R, s.P, s.Q = s.I + k.I, s.R + k.R, s.P + k.P, s.Q + k.Q
			end
		end
		for _, b in ipairs(t.batons) do
			local s = b.player and out[b.player]
			local tok = b.token
			if s and tok ~= "X" and tok ~= "G" then
				s.batons = s.batons + 1
				if tok == "K" then
					s.kings, s.hits = s.kings + 1, s.hits + 1
				elseif tok == "=" then
					s.kingMisses = s.kingMisses + 1
				elseif tok == "Z" then
					s.illegal = s.illegal + 1
				else
					-- a throw that also toppled the king early (E) is not a hit (kubb.js)
					local f, bb = batonCounts(tok)
					s.field, s.base = s.field + f, s.base + bb
					if f + bb > 0 and tok:sub(-1) ~= "E" then s.hits = s.hits + 1 end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return out
end

-- Fold a finished game into the players in it. `r` the roster, `hs` the
-- histories by key (an entry is made for a key that has none), g the
