-- engine game (over), meta:
--   keys     { [player id] = roster key }: the saved players in it (guests
--            and the Playdate have none and are left out)
--   levels   { [player id] = level played at } (optional)
--   date     "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM", the game's end
--   file     the game file name
-- Returns the keys folded.
function history.foldGame(r, hs, g, meta)
	local stats = history.gameStats(g)
	local day = meta.date and meta.date:sub(1, 10)
	local done = {}
	for pid, key in pairs(meta.keys or {}) do
		local p, s = roster.find(r, key), stats[pid]
		if p and s then
			local t = p.totals
			for _, k in ipairs(roster.TOTALS) do
				if s[k] then t[k] = t[k] + s[k] end
			end
			local won = g.winner == s.side
			local res = won and "won" or ((g.how == "resigned") and "resigned" or "lost")
			t.games = t.games + 1
			if won then t.wins = t.wins + 1 end
			if res == "resigned" then t.resigned = t.resigned + 1 end
			if day then p.last = day end
			local h = hs[key] or history.new()
			hs[key] = h
			local other = s.side == "A" and "B" or "A"
			h.games[#h.games + 1] = { d = meta.date, f = meta.file, team = g.teams[s.side].name, side = s.side,
				res = res, vs = g.teams[other].name, b = s.batons, h = s.hits, k = s.I,
				lv = meta.levels and meta.levels[pid] or p.level }
			trim(h.games, history.tune.games)
			done[#done + 1] = key
		end
	end
	table.sort(done)
	return done
end

-- Fold a finished drill run (core/drills) into a player's records; returns
-- the drill's record and whether it is a new best (drills.record).
function history.foldDrill(r, h, key, d, run, date)
	local p = roster.find(r, key)
	if p and date then p.last = date:sub(1, 10) end
	return drills.record(h.drills, d, run)
end

-- Set a player's level and log the change in their history; returns true
-- when it changed.
function history.setLevel(r, h, key, level, date)
	local was = roster.setLevel(r, key, level)
	if not was then return false end
	h.levels[#h.levels + 1] = { d = date, from = was, to = level }
	trim(h.levels, history.tune.levels)
	return true
end

-- Hits and batons of the last n games (newest last), for the bars of a
-- player screen: { { h, b }, ... }.
function history.lastGames(h, n)
	local out = {}
	local from = #h.games - n + 1
	if from < 1 then from = 1 end
	for i = from, #h.games do
		local e = h.games[i]
		out[#out + 1] = { h = e.h or 0, b = e.b or 0, res = e.res }
	end
	return out
end

tw.history = history
core/howto:
-- HOW TO THROW, the walkthrough of the clock throw (DESIGN 4). Jamie,
-- 2026-11-14, of the first one: "an interactive thing that walks the player
-- through the different steps and meaning of the crank for the throw"; the
-- clock throw replaced that one (2026-11-15) and this is it again for the new
-- throw. Pure: no playdate.*. The throw scene runs it over the practice pitch
-- (scenes/throw: throw.showHowTo), so every step is the real thing: the real
-- crank, the real dial, real throws at the far base kubbs.
--
-- Each step says what to do; when the player has done it, the step says what
-- it meant (the "after" lines, with the throw's verdicts after a throw) and A
-- goes on. A quick tap of B (no d-pad while it was down) skips a step; the
-- last step's A or B tap ends it.
--
--   steps   clock   the crank to the bottom (6 o'clock)
--           throw   point and throw: any throw (the verdicts explained)
--           power   how far back is how far: a throw with the power ON, or
--                   tune.tries throws
--           arc     where it stops is the arc: a throw with the release ON,
--                   or tune.tries throws
--           circle  the d-pad moves the circle: moved circleMove from where
--                   it was when the step began
--           walk    A + d-pad walks: moved walkMove
--           plan    B + up/down the arc, B + left/right tilt or spin: both
--           done    A: play
--
--   howto.new()            a walkthrough at its first step
--   howto.update(h, o)     one aiming frame; "close" when it ends. o is an
--                          observation the scene fills each frame (reused):
--     arm        the crank as the arm (swing.armAngle: 0 = 6 o'clock), or nil
--     docked     the crank is docked
--     thrown     a throw of the player's has just come back to aiming
--     powerV, releaseV, steady   that throw's verdicts (plan.launch)
--     markerX, markerY, playerX, playerY, release, tilt, spin   the aim
--     pressA     A pressed this frame
--     tapB       B tapped (released this frame, quick, no d-pad meanwhile)
--   howto.lines(h)         title, three lines and the footer to show now
--   h.rev                  bumped whenever what howto.lines says changes
import "core/tw"

local howto = {}

howto.tune = {
	bottomDeg = 20,    -- the crank counts as at 6 o'clock within this of the bottom
	tries = 3,         -- throws before the power and arc steps go on without an ON
	circleMove = 0.3,  -- m the circle must move in the circle step
	walkMove = 0.5,    -- m the thrower must walk in the walk step
}

-- What each step says: a title, the lines while it is to be done, and the
-- lines once it is done ("after"; for the power and arc steps "afterOn" when
-- the throw was ON, "after" when the tries ran out). Three lines at most,
-- each short enough for the panel. A throw step keeps its third line free
-- for the last throw's verdicts (render/howto; test_howto checks the
-- length, the howto self-test the width in the label font).
local STEPS = {
	{ id = "clock", title = "1  THE CRANK IS YOUR ARM",
		say = { "READ IT AS A CLOCK: 6 IS YOUR ARM HANGING DOWN.",
			"TURN THE CRANK DOWN TO 6 O'CLOCK." },
		after = { "THE DIAL BOTTOM RIGHT IS YOUR CRANK. WIND BACK",
			"UP THE LEFT FOR POWER, FLICK UP THE RIGHT AND",
			"WHERE YOU STOP IS WHERE YOU LET GO." } },
	{ id = "throw", title = "2  POINT AND THROW",
		say = { "THE CIRCLE IS ON A KUBB. WIND BACK INTO THE LEFT",
			"MARK, THEN FLICK FORWARD FAST AND STOP AT 3." },
		after = { "POWER: SHORT, ON OR LONG. SLOW: FLICK FASTER.",
			"RELEASE: LOW, ON OR HIGH. STEADY OR SHAKY." } },
	{ id = "power", title = "3  HOW FAR BACK IS HOW FAR",
		say = { "9 O'CLOCK IS ABOUT 4 M, 10 O'CLOCK 8 M, PAST 11 IS",
			"OVERPOWERED. WIND UNTIL THE DIAL SAYS FLICK!" },
		afterOn = { "POWER ON. THE LEFT MARK IS THE POWER THIS THROW",
			"NEEDS: IT MOVES WITH THE DISTANCE." },
		after = { "THE LEFT MARK IS THE POWER THIS THROW NEEDS: IT",
			"MOVES WITH THE DISTANCE. THE DRILLS TEACH IT." } },
	{ id = "arc", title = "4  WHERE YOU STOP IS THE ARC",
		say = { "STOP AT 5 O'CLOCK FOR LOW, 4 FOR FIELD KUBBS,",
			"3 FOR BASE KUBBS, HALF PAST 3 FOR THE KING." },
		afterOn = { "RELEASE ON. STOP EARLY AND IT FLIES LOW, LATE",
			"AND IT FLIES HIGH." },
		after = { "STOP EARLY AND IT FLIES LOW, LATE AND IT FLIES",
			"HIGH. THE RIGHT-HAND MARK IS WHERE TO STOP." } },
	{ id = "circle", title = "5  THE D-PAD AIMS",
		say = { "THE D-PAD MOVES THE CIRCLE, WHERE A CLEAN THROW",
			"COMES DOWN. MOVE IT OFF THE KUBB." },
		after = { "IT STAYS WHERE YOU LEAVE IT: IN A WIND, AIM",
			"INTO IT. THE MARKS ON THE DIAL MOVE WITH IT." } },
	{ id = "walk", title = "6  HOLD A TO WALK",
		say = { "HOLD A AND USE THE D-PAD: ALONG THE LINE, OR",
			"DOWN TO STEP BACK. YOU ALWAYS FACE THE CIRCLE." },
		after = { "IN A MATCH, UP WALKS TO THE ADVANTAGE LINE",
			"WHEN THERE IS ONE." } },
	{ id = "plan", title = "7  HOLD B TO PLAN",
		say = { "HOLD B: UP AND DOWN MOVE THE ARC, AND THE CAMERA",
			"SWINGS OUT TO SHOW IT. LEFT AND RIGHT TILT A",
			"BATON, OR SPIN A DRILLED KUBB." },
		after = { "TILT STEERS A BATON THROUGH A GROUP. SPIN KEEPS",
			"A DRILLED KUBB STEADY IN THE AIR." },
		-- one line kept on screen while B holds the camera out (the panel folds
		-- to a strip then; the RC review of 2026-11-15: its words went with it)
		held = "B HELD: UP/DOWN THE ARC, LEFT/RIGHT TILT OR SPIN" },
	{ id = "done", title = "THAT'S THE THROW",
		say = { "A AND B ARE EXTRAS: POINT AND THROW IS ENOUGH.",
			"THE DRILLS ARE WHERE YOU GET GOOD." } },
}
howto.STEPS = STEPS

local POWER = { [-2] = "SLOW", [-1] = "SHORT", [0] = "ON", [1] = "LONG" }
local RELEASE = { [-1] = "LOW", [0] = "ON", [1] = "HIGH" }

function howto.new()
	return {
		step = 1, phase = "do", tries = 0, on = false, rev = 1,
		started = false,
		x0 = 0, y0 = 0, px0 = 0, py0 = 0, rel0 = 0,   -- the aim when the step began
		powerV = nil, releaseV = nil, steady = nil,     -- the last throw's verdicts
	}
end

-- The aim as the step begins (what the circle, walk and plan steps measure from).
local function snapshot(h, o)
	h.x0, h.y0 = o.markerX or 0, o.markerY or 0
	h.px0, h.py0 = o.playerX or 0, o.playerY or 0
	h.rel0 = o.release or 0
end

local function nextStep(h, o)
	if h.step >= #STEPS then return "close" end
	h.step, h.phase, h.tries, h.on = h.step + 1, "do", 0, false
	h.powerV, h.releaseV, h.steady = nil, nil, nil
	h.rev = h.rev + 1
	snapshot(h, o)
	return nil
end

local function moved(ax, ay, bx, by, d)
	local dx, dy = ax - bx, ay - by
	return dx * dx + dy * dy >= d * d
end

-- Has the player done step `id` this frame?
local function passed(h, id, o)
	local t = howto.tune
	if id == "clock" then
		local a = o.arm
		return a ~= nil and not o.docked and a >= -t.bottomDeg and a <= t.bottomDeg
	elseif id == "throw" then
		return o.thrown
	elseif id == "power" then
		return o.thrown and (o.powerV == 0 or h.tries >= t.tries)
	elseif id == "arc" then
		return o.thrown and (o.releaseV == 0 or h.tries >= t.tries)
	elseif id == "circle" then
		return moved(o.markerX or 0, o.markerY or 0, h.x0, h.y0, t.circleMove)
	elseif id == "walk" then
		return moved(o.playerX or 0, o.playerY or 0, h.px0, h.py0, t.walkMove)
	elseif id == "plan" then
		return (o.release or 0) ~= h.rel0 and ((o.tilt or 0) ~= 0 or (o.spin or 0) ~= 0)
	end
	return false
end

function howto.update(h, o)
	if not h.started then
		snapshot(h, o)
		h.started = true
	end
	local st = STEPS[h.step]
	if st.id == "done" then
		if o.pressA or o.tapB then return "close" end
		return nil
	end
	if o.tapB then return nextStep(h, o) end
	if h.phase == "after" then
		if o.pressA then return nextStep(h, o) end
		return nil
	end
	if o.thrown then
		h.tries = h.tries + 1
		h.powerV, h.releaseV, h.steady = o.powerV, o.releaseV, o.steady
		h.rev = h.rev + 1
	end
	if passed(h, st.id, o) then
		h.phase = "after"
		h.on = (st.id == "power" and o.powerV == 0) or (st.id == "arc" and o.releaseV == 0)
		h.rev = h.rev + 1
	end
	return nil
end

-- The last throw's verdicts as one line ("THAT ONE: ON  HIGH  STEADY"), or nil.
function howto.verdictLine(h)
	if h.powerV == nil then return nil end
	return "THAT ONE: " .. (POWER[h.powerV] or "?") .. "  " .. (RELEASE[h.releaseV] or "?") .. "  "
		.. (h.steady and "STEADY" or "SHAKY")
end

-- What to show now: the title, three lines (nil for none) and the footer.
-- Strings only (render/howto draws them, once per h.rev).
-- The step's one line for the folded panel while B holds the camera out
-- (nil: the title strip alone).
function howto.heldLine(h)
	return STEPS[h.step].held
end

function howto.lines(h)
	local st = STEPS[h.step]
	local L
	if h.phase == "after" then
		L = (h.on and st.afterOn) or st.after
	else
		L = st.say
	end
	local a, b, c = L[1], L[2], L[3]
	-- after a throw step, the throw's own verdicts come first
	local v = (h.phase == "after" or h.tries > 0) and howto.verdictLine(h) or nil
	if v and (st.id == "throw" or st.id == "power" or st.id == "arc") then
		if h.phase == "after" then
			a, b, c = v, L[1], L[2]
		elseif not c then
			c = v
		end
	end
	local foot
	if st.id == "done" then
		foot = "A: PLAY"
	elseif h.phase == "after" then
		foot = "A: NEXT"
	else
		foot = "TAP B: SKIP"
	end
	return st.title, a, b, c, foot
end

tw.howto = howto
core/howtoplay:
-- HOW TO PLAY: the rules of Kubb on six cards, for someone who has never
-- played, in the words a friend would use on the lawn (Rules V4.0 as the game
-- plays them: core/rules). The cards come before HOW TO THROW (core/howto):
-- the last one leads into it. Pure: the text, what each card's little pitch
-- shows, and the paging; render/howtoplay draws a card, scenes/howtoplay
-- runs them.
--
--   howtoplay.CARDS          the cards: { id, title, text = { paragraphs },
--                            map = { pieces, arrow, line } or nil }
--   howtoplay.new()          { page = 1 }
--   howtoplay.press(st, b)   b = "a" | "b" | "left" | "right": turns the page;
--                            returns "howto" (A on the last card: on to HOW TO
--                            THROW), "exit" (B on the first or the last card)
--                            or nil
--
-- Map coordinates are world metres as everywhere (x across, y from your
-- baseline at 0 to theirs at 8). Pieces: base (a kubb standing on a
-- baseline), field (a field kubb standing), down (a kubb knocked over), king.
import "core/tw"

local howtoplay = {}

local BASES = {}
for i, x in ipairs({ -2, -1, 0, 1, 2 }) do
	BASES[i] = { kind = "base", x = x, y = 0 }
	BASES[5 + i] = { kind = "base", x = x, y = 8 }
end

local function with(list, extra)
	local out = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(list) do out[#out + 1] = p end
	for _, p in ipairs(extra) do out[#out + 1] = p end
	return out
end

local KING = { kind = "king", x = 0, y = 4 }

-- Their base kubbs all down, ours standing: the king's card.
local KINGPITCH = {}
for i, x in ipairs({ -2, -1, 0, 1, 2 }) do
	KINGPITCH[i] = { kind = "base", x = x, y = 0 }
	KINGPITCH[5 + i] = { kind = "down", x = x, y = 8 }
end
KINGPITCH[11] = KING

howtoplay.CARDS = {
	{ id = "pitch", title = "THE PITCH",
		text = { "TWO TEAMS, ONE AT EACH END OF A PATCH OF LAWN 8 M LONG AND 5 M WIDE.",
			"EACH TEAM HAS FIVE KUBBS STANDING ON ITS BASELINE. THE KING STANDS IN THE MIDDLE.",
			"KNOCK DOWN ALL OF THEIR KUBBS, THEN THE KING, AND YOU WIN." },
		map = { pieces = with(BASES, { KING }) } },
	{ id = "batons", title = "BATONS",
		text = { "ON YOUR TURN YOU GET SIX BATONS TO THROW AT THEIR KUBBS.",
			"THROW THEM UNDERARM SO THEY TURN END OVER END. ONE THAT SPINS FLAT LIKE A HELICOPTER DOESN'T COUNT.",
			"IN THE 2-4-6 OPENING THE FIRST TURN GETS TWO AND THE SECOND FOUR." },
		map = { pieces = with(BASES, { KING }), arrow = { 0.3, 0.4, 1, 7.6 } } },
	{ id = "back", title = "THROW THEM BACK IN",
		text = { "EVERY KUBB YOU KNOCK DOWN, THEY THROW BACK INTO YOUR HALF.",
			"YOU STAND THEM UP WHERE THEY LAND. NOW THEY'RE FIELD KUBBS.",
			"IF ONE LANDS OUT THEY THROW IT AGAIN. OUT TWICE, YOU PICK THE SPOT." },
		map = { pieces = with(BASES, { KING, { kind = "field", x = -1.2, y = 2.6 }, { kind = "field", x = 0.9, y = 3.2 },
			{ kind = "field", x = 1.5, y = 1.9 } }), arrow = { 0.6, 7.6, 0.9, 3.5 } } },
	{ id = "field", title = "FIELD KUBBS FIRST",
		text = { "THEIR FIELD KUBBS COME FIRST, THEN THE ONES ON THEIR BASELINE.",
			"HIT A BASE KUBB TOO SOON AND IT JUST GETS STOOD BACK UP.",
			"LEAVE ANY STANDING AND NEXT TURN THEY STEP UP AND THROW FROM THE ONE NEAREST THE MIDDLE." },
		map = { pieces = with(BASES, { KING, { kind = "field", x = -0.9, y = 5.3 }, { kind = "field", x = 1.1, y = 6.2 } }),
			line = 5.3 } },
	{ id = "king", title = "THE KING LAST",
		text = { "ONCE ALL THEIR KUBBS ARE DOWN, GO FOR THE KING FROM YOUR BASELINE. KNOCK HIM OVER AND YOU WIN.",
			"KNOCK THE KING OVER TOO EARLY AND YOU LOSE. SAME IF A KUBB YOU THROW IN KNOCKS HIM OVER." },
		map = { pieces = KINGPITCH, arrow = { 0, 0.4, 0, 3.6 } } },
	{ id = "sheet", title = "THE SCORE SHEET",
		text = { "EVERY GAME GETS WRITTEN DOWN BATON BY BATON IN PLANET KUBB NOTATION, THE SAME WAY TOURNAMENT SCOREKEEPERS DO IT.",
			"TO LOOK BACK AT YOUR GAMES, OPEN THE SYSTEM MENU ON THE TITLE AND PICK GAMES.",
			"THAT'S KUBB. NEXT UP: HOW TO THROW WITH THE CRANK." } },
}

function howtoplay.new()
	return { page = 1 }
end

function howtoplay.press(st, b)
	local n = #howtoplay.CARDS
	if b == "a" then
		if st.page == n then return "howto" end
		st.page = st.page + 1
	elseif b == "right" then
		if st.page < n then st.page = st.page + 1 end
	elseif b == "left" then
		if st.page > 1 then st.page = st.page - 1 end
	elseif b == "b" then
		if st.page == 1 or st.page == n then return "exit" end
		st.page = st.page - 1
	end
	return nil
end

tw.howtoplay = howtoplay
core/lineup:
-- The two teams before a match (docs/PLAYERS.md section 4): which saved
-- players and guests are on each side, in throwing order, and the team
-- names. Pure Lua: no playdate.*; scenes/teams is the screen.
--
--   local L = lineup.new(vs)                -- vs: Team B is the Playdate
--   lineup.add(L, "A", lineup.entry(rec))   -- a saved player (core/roster record)
--   lineup.add(L, "B", lineup.guest("Ray", "club"))
--   lineup.ready(L), lineup.teams(L)        -- core/match's teams
--
-- An entry is { key, name, level, guest }: key is the roster key (nil for a
-- guest, who is not saved). A side holds lineup.tune.size (6); a player is on
-- one side at most. Against the Playdate (vs) Team B is the Playdate's own
-- team and takes nobody.
import "core/tw"
import "core/names"
import "core/notation"
import "core/roster"

local cnames, notation, roster = tw.names, tw.notation, tw.roster

local lineup = {}

lineup.tune = {
	size = 6,           -- players a side at most
}

lineup.PLAYDATE = "Playdate"   -- the computer's team and player name (VS PLAYDATE)

function lineup.new(vs)
	return { vs = vs and true or false, A = {}, B = {}, names = {} }
end

function lineup.entry(rec)
	return { key = rec.key, name = rec.name, level = rec.level }
end

function lineup.guest(name, level)
	return { key = nil, name = name, level = roster.isLevel(level) and level or roster.defaultLevel(), guest = true }
end

-- Which side an entry with this key (or, for a guest, this name's id) is
-- on, and where; nil when on neither.
function lineup.find(L, e)
	for _, side in ipairs { "A", "B" } do
		for i, x in ipairs(L[side]) do
			if (e.key and x.key == e.key) or (not e.key and not x.key and notation.baseId(x.name) == notation.baseId(e.name)) then
				return side, i
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Put entry e at the end of `side`; returns ok, why ("full", "vs": Team B
-- is the Playdate, "taken": already on a team).
function lineup.add(L, side, e)
	if L.vs and side == "B" then return false, "vs" end
	if lineup.find(L, e) then return false, "taken" end
	if #L[side] >= lineup.tune.size then return false, "full" end
	L[side][#L[side] + 1] = e
	return true
end

-- A player just made on the teams screen (+ PLAYER or + GUEST) takes an
-- empty team's place at once, so a first match needs no trip through the
-- bench (the RC review of 2026-11-15): Team A when it is empty, else Team B
-- when it is empty and not the Playdate's. Returns the side, or nil when both
-- teams have players already (the player waits on the bench as before).
function lineup.seatNew(L, e)
	for _, side in ipairs { "A", "B" } do
		if #L[side] == 0 and not (L.vs and side == "B") then
			if lineup.add(L, side, e) then return side end
			return nil
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Take player i off `side` (back to the bench); returns the entry.
function lineup.remove(L, side, i)
	return table.remove(L[side], i)
end

-- Move player i of `side` one place up (dir -1) or down (+1) the order;
-- returns its new place.
function lineup.move(L, side, i, dir)
	local t = L[side]
	local j = i + dir
	if j < 1 or j > #t then return i end
	t[i], t[j] = t[j], t[i]
	return j
end

-- A team's name: the one given (L.names[side]), else the player's own
-- name for a team of one, else "Team <first player>"; "Playdate" for the
-- computer; "Team A" / "Team B" while empty.
function lineup.teamName(L, side)
	if L.vs and side == "B" then return lineup.PLAYDATE end
	if L.names[side] then return L.names[side] end
	local t = L[side]
	if #t == 1 then return t[1].name end
	if #t > 1 then return "Team " .. t[1].name end
	return "Team " .. side
end

-- Give a team a name (nil: back to the default). Returns the name kept.
function lineup.setName(L, side, name)
	L.names[side] = name and cnames.finish(name) or nil
	return L.names[side]
end

function lineup.ready(L)
	return #L.A > 0 and (L.vs or #L.B > 0)
end

-- core/match's teams: { A = { name, players = { { name, key, level, guest } } }, B }.
-- Against the Playdate, Team B is "Playdate" with one player, "Playdate".
function lineup.teams(L)
	local out = {}
	for _, side in ipairs { "A", "B" } do
		local ps = {}
		if L.vs and side == "B" then
			ps[1] = { name = lineup.PLAYDATE }
		else
			for i, e in ipairs(L[side]) do
				ps[i] = { name = e.name, key = e.key, level = e.level, guest = e.guest }
			end
		end
		out[side] = { name = lineup.teamName(L, side), players = ps }
	end
	return out
end

-- What the datastore keeps to offer the lineup again: the saved players'
-- keys in order and the names given (guests are not kept).
function lineup.pack(L)
	local d = { A = {}, B = {}, names = { A = L.names.A, B = L.names.B } }
	for _, side in ipairs { "A", "B" } do
		for _, e in ipairs(L[side]) do
			if e.key then d[side][#d[side] + 1] = e.key end
		end
	end
	return d
end

-- A kept lineup back against roster r (players removed since are left
-- out; anything unreadable gives an empty lineup).
function lineup.unpack(d, r, vs)
	local L = lineup.new(vs)
	if type(d) ~= "table" then return L end
	for _, side in ipairs { "A", "B" } do
		if type(d[side]) == "table" then
			for _, key in ipairs(d[side]) do
				local rec = roster.find(r, key)
				if rec then lineup.add(L, side, lineup.entry(rec)) end
			end
		end
		local n = type(d.names) == "table" and d.names[side]
		if type(n) == "string" and not (vs and side == "B") then lineup.setName(L, side, n) end
	end
	return L
end

tw.lineup = lineup
core/match:
-- A match: the rules engine (core/rules) driven by physics throws, as the
-- match scene plays it. Pure Lua: no playdate.*. Not a per-frame path.
--
-- The engine is the truth for the layout between throws; physics is the
-- truth during a throw. match.setup says what the next throw is and gives
-- the pitch as physics pieces in the thrower's view frame (core/frame: the
-- thrower always throws from y = 0 toward +y); match.resolve takes the
-- finished physics throw, turns it into the engine's outcome record
-- (core/outcome) and applies it. Raising and punishment placement are
-- automatic (the engine's policies) and happen in match.setup.
--
--   local m = match.new{ surface = "Grass", start = {year, month, day, hour, min} }
--   while not match.over(m) do
--     local s = match.setup(m)          -- s.kind "toss" | "baton"
--     ... build tw.world from s.pieces, launch s.projectile, run to rest ...
--     match.resolve(m, tw.world.result(w), illegal)   -- m.text says what happened
--   end
--   local text, name = match.file(m, finish, version)
--
-- Everything a resume needs (stage 5) is in the one table m: the engine
-- game (plain fields and a metatable), the start time, the surface, the
-- per-turn counters and the throwing order.
--
-- Teams have 1 to 6 players (match.new's `teams`, the engine's). Who throws
-- each kubb and baton is core/order's (docs/PLAYERS.md section 5): blocks
-- dealt round each team within Rules V4.0 II.A.4 and II.B.5, one inkaster a
-- turn; match.setup names the thrower (s.thrower) and match.resolve gives
-- the engine that player's id.
import "core/tw"
import "core/rules"
import "core/notation"
import "core/frame"
import "core/outcome"
import "core/debris"
import "core/order"
import "core/world"
import "core/body"

local rules, notation, frame, outcome, debris = tw.rules, tw.notation, tw.frame, tw.outcome, tw.debris
local order, world, body, pitch = tw.order, tw.world, tw.body, tw.pitch
local fmt = string.format

local match = {}

-- A team's name: the engine's (match.new's `teams`), "Team A" / "Team B"
-- when no game is given.
function match.teamName(side, g)
	local t = g and g.teams and g.teams[side]
	return t and t.name or ("Team " .. side)
end

-- Each engine player's saved player and throw level, from the teams given
-- to match.new (core/lineup's: { name, key, level, guest }), by side and in
-- order: { A = { { id, key, level, guest } }, B = ... }. rules.new keeps the
-- players in order, so the two lists line up.
function match.lineupOf(g, teams)
	local out = {}
	for _, side in ipairs { "A", "B" } do
		local given = teams and teams[side] and teams[side].players or {}
		local list = {}
		for i, p in ipairs(g.teams[side].players) do
			local q = given[i] or {}
			list[i] = { id = p.id, key = q.key, level = q.level, guest = q.guest or nil }
		end
		out[side] = list
	end
	return out
end

-- A player's lineup entry by id ({ id, key, level, guest }), or nil.
function match.member(m, side, id)
	for _, e in ipairs(m.lineup and m.lineup[side] or {}) do
		if e.id == id then return e end
	end
	return nil
end

function match.new(opts)
	opts = opts or {}
	local g = rules.new {
		teams = opts.teams or {
			A = { name = "Team A", players = { { name = "Player A", id = "a" } } },
			B = { name = "Team B", players = { { name = "Player B", id = "b" } } },
		},
		surface = opts.surface or "Grass", opening = opts.opening or "2-4-6", first = opts.first or "A",
	}
	return {
		game = g,
		start = opts.start,       -- {year, month, day, hour, min}
		mode = opts.mode or "Pass and Play",
		turn = g.turn,            -- the turn the counters below belong to
		tossed = 0,               -- kubbs thrown (and rethrown) this turn
		text = nil,               -- what the last throw (or the automatic steps) did
		settled = nil,            -- raised and punishment kubbs placed before this throw
		setup = nil,              -- the current throw (match.setup)
		debris = debris.new(),    -- batons and downed kubbs lying on the pitch this turn
		order = order.new(g.teams),   -- who throws (core/order)
		lineup = match.lineupOf(g, opts.teams),   -- each player's roster key and level
	}
end

-- The order (a match saved before it had one gets a fresh one).
local function orderOf(m)
	if not m.order then m.order = order.new(m.game.teams) end
	return m.order
end

-- A player of the engine's team `side` by id: { id, name }.
function match.player(m, side, id)
	for _, p in ipairs(m.game.teams[side].players) do
		if p.id == id then return p end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Who throws next: { id, name } of the attacking team's player (nil when
-- the game is over).
function match.thrower(m)
	local g = m.game
	local pid = order.thrower(orderOf(m), g)
	if not pid then return nil end
	local p = match.player(m, g.attacker, pid)
	local e = match.member(m, g.attacker, pid)
	return { id = pid, name = p and p.name or pid, key = e and e.key, level = e and e.level }
end

-- Hand the throw set up (m.setup) to another player of its team: the kubbs
-- (the inkaster, core/order.setInkaster) or this baton (core/order.change).
-- Returns ok, why ("team", "cap", "distinct"); on ok m.setup.thrower is the
-- new player's.
function match.changeThrower(m, pid)
	local s, g = m.setup, m.game
	if not s then return false, "none" end
	local o = orderOf(m)
	local ok, why
	if s.kind == "toss" then ok, why = order.setInkaster(o, pid)
	else ok, why = order.change(o, s.n, pid, s.n - 1) end
	if ok then s.thrower = match.thrower(m) end
	return ok, why
end

-- Who may take the throw set up, for the change list: every player of the
-- team, in order, { id, name, ok, why } (why as match.changeThrower's).
function match.candidates(m)
	local s, g = m.setup, m.game
	local out = {}
	if not s then return out end
	local o = orderOf(m)
	for _, p in ipairs(g.teams[s.side].players) do
		local ok, why
		if s.kind == "toss" then ok = true else ok, why = order.allowed(o, s.n, p.id, s.n - 1) end
		out[#out + 1] = { id = p.id, name = p.name, ok = ok and true or false, why = why,
			current = s.thrower and s.thrower.id == p.id }
	end
	return out
end

-- This turn's batons by player, in order: { { id, name, n }, ... } (runs of
-- one player together), for the hand-off card.
function match.turnOrder(m)
	local g = m.game
	local o = orderOf(m)
	order.sync(o, g)
	local out = {}
	for _, pid in ipairs(o.deal or {}) do
		local last = out[#out]
		if last and last.id == pid then last.n = last.n + 1
		else
			local p = match.player(m, o.side, pid)
			out[#out + 1] = { id = pid, name = p and p.name or pid, n = 1 }
		end
	end
	return out, o.inkaster and match.player(m, o.side, o.inkaster)
end

function match.over(m) return m.game.phase == "over" end

local function countTurn(m)
	if m.game.turn ~= m.turn then m.turn, m.tossed = m.game.turn, 0 end
end

-- Raise every lying kubb and place every punishment kubb (automatically,
-- with the engine's policies). Returns how many of each.
function match.settle(m)
	local g = m.game
	local raised, punished = 0, 0
	while true do
		local n = g:need()
		if n.kind == "raise" then
			g:raise(nil)
			raised = raised + 1
		elseif n.kind == "punish" then
			g:autoPunishment()
			punished = punished + 1
		else
			break
		end
	end
	return raised, punished
end

-- The next throw, in the thrower's view frame:
--   kind        "toss" | "baton"
--   side        the attacker ("A" | "B")
--   projectile  "kubb" | "baton"; kubb = the id of the kubb thrown
--   pieces      outcome.pieces: what is on the pitch (view frame)
--   lineY       the baseline (0)
--   forwardY    how far forward the thrower may stand: the advantage line
--               for batons at kubbs when there is one, else the baseline
--   advY        the advantage line to draw (view frame), or nil
--   targets     ids to frame: standing field kubbs, else base kubbs, else
--               the king (batons); nil for a toss
--   n, of       this throw's number and the throws of its kind this turn
--   label       "Team A  baton 2 of 6", "Team B  kubb 1 of 3"
--   debris      core/debris pieces: the batons thrown and the kubbs knocked
--               down earlier this turn, lying where they came to rest (view
--               frame; physics bodies, not engine pieces)
--   batonId     the body id of this baton ("baton1" .. "baton6"), so it can
--               lie on the pitch as debris after it
--   thrower     { id, name }: the attacking team's player who throws it
--               (core/order)
-- Returns nil when the game is over.
-- core/world's surface for the engine's (the game file's "Grass", "Sand",
-- "Snow"); grass for anything it does not know.
function match.surfaceName(g)
	local name = string.lower(g.surface or "grass")
	if tw.world and tw.world.surfaces and not tw.world.surfaces[name] then return "grass" end
	return name
end

function match.setup(m)
	local g = m.game
	local raised, punished = match.settle(m)
	if raised > 0 or punished > 0 then m.settled = { raised = raised, punished = punished } else m.settled = nil end
	countTurn(m)
	local n = g:need()
	if n.kind == "over" then
		m.setup = nil
		return nil
	end
	local side = n.side
	debris.begin(m.debris, g.turn)
	-- from the inkast to the batons the lying kubbs were raised (by the
	-- engine here or by hand in scenes/settle): settle what they propped
	if m.debris.kind ~= n.kind then m.debris.settle = true end
	m.debris.kind = n.kind
	local s = { kind = n.kind, side = side, pieces = outcome.pieces(g, side), lineY = 0, forwardY = 0,
		surface = match.surfaceName(g) }
	debris.applyExact(m.debris, s.pieces, side)
	s.debris = debris.pieces(m.debris, side)
	-- settling can move the advantage line (and so the throw request's line)
	if m.debris.settle and match.settleStanding(m, s) > 0 then n = g:need() end
	if g.advantageY then s.advY = frame.y(side, g.advantageY) end
	if n.kind == "toss" then
		s.projectile, s.kubb = "kubb", n.kubb
		s.rethrow = n.rethrow
		s.n, s.of = m.tossed + 1, m.tossed + n.left
		s.label = fmt("%s  %s %d of %d", match.teamName(side, g), n.rethrow and "rethrow" or "kubb", s.n, s.of)
	else
		s.projectile = "baton"
		s.kingShot = n.kingShot
		if n.advantageY and not n.kingShot then s.forwardY = frame.y(side, n.advantageY) end
		s.targets = n.targets
		s.n, s.of = n.n, n.of
		s.batonId = "baton" .. n.n
		s.label = fmt("%s  %s %d of %d", match.teamName(side, g), n.kingShot and "king shot, baton" or "baton", n.n, n.of)
	end
	s.thrower = match.thrower(m)
	m.setup = s
	return s
end

-- Standing pieces keep the exact pose a throw left them in (core/debris):
-- tilted on an edge against a piece lying beside it, raised on a piece. (A
-- kubb leaning on a neighbour by its own weight is past its tipping point,
-- and the leaner rule has it down.) When what may have propped one has gone
-- since (the turn's debris picked up, the inkast's kubbs raised or lifted),
-- the world runs the tilted or raised ones to rest once, before the next
-- throw, from the pitch as it is now. One that falls back straight stands
-- where it settled (the engine's pose follows); one that topples or leaves
-- the pitch while settling was knocked by clearing the pitch and is stood
-- back up where the engine has it. Returns how many pieces it woke.
match.tune = {
	settleDeg = 0.5,   -- a standing piece tilted more than this ...
	settleGap = 0.002, -- m ... or this far off the ground is run to rest
}

function match.settleStanding(m, s)
	local d, g, side = m.debris, m.game, s.side
	d.settle = nil
	local cosTol, gapTol = math.cos(math.rad(match.tune.settleDeg)), match.tune.settleGap
	local wake = nil
	for _, p in ipairs(s.pieces) do
		local e, k = d.exact[p.id], body.kinds[p.kind]
		if e and e.standing and not p.toppled and p.z and k then
			-- the long axis (column 3 of the rotation) and the lowest corner
			local qw, qx, qy, qz = p.qw, p.qx, p.qy, p.qz
			local r31, r32, r33 = 2 * (qx * qz - qw * qy), 2 * (qy * qz + qw * qx), 1 - 2 * (qx * qx + qy * qy)
			local gap = p.z - (k.hx * math.abs(r31) + k.hy * math.abs(r32) + k.hz * math.abs(r33))
			if math.abs(r33) < cosTol or gap > gapTol then
				wake = wake or {}
				wake[#wake + 1] = p.id
			end
		end
	end
	if not wake then return 0 end
	local w = world.new { surface = s.surface or "grass", pieces = match.worldPieces(s) }
	for _, id in ipairs(wake) do world.wake(w.byId[id]) end
	world.run(w)
	local res = world.result(w)
	local eps = debris.tune.matchEps
	for _, p in ipairs(s.pieces) do
		local rb = res.bodies[p.id]
		if rb and not p.toppled then
			local piece = p.id == "king" and g.king or g.kubbs[p.id]
			local wp = frame.pose(side, (outcome.poseOf(rb.x, rb.y, rb.z, rb.qw, rb.qx, rb.qy, rb.qz)))
			local old = piece.pose
			if rb.toppled or not wp.standing or not pitch.onPitch(wp.x, wp.y) then
				d.exact[p.id] = nil
			elseif (wp.x - old.x) ^ 2 + (wp.y - old.y) ^ 2 > eps * eps then
				piece.pose = { x = wp.x, y = wp.y, standing = true, angle = wp.angle }
			end
		end
	end
	debris.carry(d, res, side)
	debris.recordExact(d, g, res, side)
	-- a field kubb that settled may have moved the line the turn throws from
	-- (fixed for the turn once its first kubb or baton is thrown: II.C.4b)
	local cur = g.sheet.current
	if g.tossSeq == 0 and cur and #cur.batons == 0 then g:_advantage() end
	-- and where the turn's kubbs stand as the batons begin (the sheet's inkast
	-- positions, copied when the batons phase began)
	if g.phase == "batons" and cur and #cur.batons == 0 then g:_inkastPositions() end
	s.pieces = outcome.pieces(g, side)
	debris.applyExact(d, s.pieces, side)
	s.debris = debris.pieces(d, side)
	return #wake
end

-- Every body a throw's physics world starts with: the engine's pieces, then
-- the debris (a new list; once per throw).
function match.worldPieces(s)
	local out = {}
	for i, p in ipairs(s.pieces) do out[i] = p end
	for _, p in ipairs(s.debris or {}) do out[#out + 1] = p end
	return out
end

-- ---------- what happened, in words ----------

local function plural(n, one, many) return n == 1 and one or (n .. " " .. many) end

local function hasNote(notes, from, pattern)
	for i = from, #notes do
		if notes[i]:find(pattern, 1, true) then return true end
	end
	return false
end

local function wins(g)
	return match.teamName(g.winner, g) .. " wins"
end

-- A short line for a baton token (and the notes the throw added).
local function batonText(g, token, notes, from)
	local parts = {}
	if token == "K" then return "king down: " .. wins(g) end
	if token:sub(-1) == "E" then return "king down early: " .. wins(g) end
	if token == "G" then return "resigned: " .. wins(g) end
	if token == "=" then
		parts[1] = "missed the king"
	elseif token == "Z" then
		if hasNote(notes, from, "II.B.11") then parts[1] = "own-half kubb hit: all put back"
		else parts[1] = "helicopter: illegal" end
	elseif token == "-" then
		parts[1] = "missed"
	else
		local function n(c) if not c then return 0 end return c == "" and 1 or tonumber(c) end
		local f, b = n(token:match("^(%d*)F")), n(token:match("(%d*)B$"))
		if f > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = plural(f, "field kubb", "field kubbs") end
		if b > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = plural(b, "base kubb", "base kubbs") end
		parts = { table.concat(parts, " and ") .. " down" }
	end
	if hasNote(notes, from, "II.B.4a") then parts[#parts + 1] = "base kubb early: raised" end
	if hasNote(notes, from, "II.B.7") then parts[#parts + 1] = "pushed out: put back" end
	return table.concat(parts, "; ")
end

-- Apply a finished physics throw. `res` is tw.world.result of a world
-- built from m.setup.pieces with the projectile launched (a kubb toss's
-- projectile body has the kubb's id); `illegal` is true for a helicopter
-- baton. Sets m.text and returns the outcome record given to the engine.
-- The kubb throwing is judged at the final position (core/rules): after a
-- toss that is not the last of its round m.text says only where the kubb
-- lies for now; after the last one it says what the judgment did.
function match.resolve(m, res, illegal)
	local g, s = m.game, m.setup
	assert(s, "no throw set up")
	local turn = g.turn
	local sheetTurn = g.sheet.turns[turn]
	local nb, nn = #sheetTurn.batons, #sheetTurn.notes
	local o
	if s.kind == "toss" then
		local before = {}
		local ink = sheetTurn.inkast
		local function inkCount(code)
			local c = 0
			for _, k in pairs(ink) do c = c + (k[code] or 0) end
			return c
		end
		before.Q, before.N = inkCount("Q"), inkCount("N")
		o = outcome.toss(res, s.pieces, s.side, s.kubb)
		g:toss(o, s.thrower and s.thrower.id)
		m.tossed = m.tossed + 1
		local parts = {}
		local fouled = hasNote(sheetTurn.notes, nn + 1, "II.C.4b")
		local j = g.judgment
		if g.phase == "over" then
			parts[1] = "king down: " .. wins(g)
		elseif not j then
			-- more kubbs to throw in this round: only where it lies now
			if fouled then parts[1] = "own half hit: kubb out"
			elseif g:liesNow(s.kubb) == "out" then parts[1] = "kubb out for now"
			else parts[1] = "kubb in for now" end
		else
			-- the last throw of the round: the judgment
			if fouled then parts[1] = "own half hit" end
			if j.rethrow == 0 and j.punish == 0 and j.rescue == 0 and not fouled then
				parts[#parts + 1] = j.thrown == 1 and "kubb in" or "all in"
			end
			if j.rethrow > 0 then
				parts[#parts + 1] = j.rethrow == 1 and "kubb out: rethrown" or (j.rethrow .. " out: rethrown")
			end
			if j.punish > 0 then
				parts[#parts + 1] = j.punish == 1 and "out twice: punishment kubb" or (j.punish .. " punishment kubbs")
			end
			if inkCount("N") > before.N then parts[#parts + 1] = "on a kubb: lowered" end
			local q = inkCount("Q") - before.Q
			if q > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = plural(q, "rescue", "rescues") end
		end
		m.text = table.concat(parts, "; ")
	else
		o = outcome.baton(res, s.pieces, s.side, illegal)
		g:throwBaton(o, s.thrower and s.thrower.id)
		local b = sheetTurn.batons[nb + 1]
		m.text = batonText(g, b and b.token or "-", sheetTurn.notes, nn + 1)
	end
	match.carryDebris(m, s, res, turn, sheetTurn.batons[nb + 1])
	countTurn(m)
	m.setup = nil
	return o
end

-- After the engine has ruled on a throw: what stays lying on the pitch for
-- the next throw of this turn. The thrown baton lies where it came to rest;
-- every kubb this throw toppled that the engine took off the pitch (into a
-- hand) lies where it fell; the debris already there moves if it was struck.
-- A throw the engine puts back (Z: a helicopter, II.B.11) leaves the earlier
-- debris where it was, as it does the standing pieces; only its baton is
-- added. The turn over: no debris is carried, only the standing pieces'
-- exact poses (core/debris); the game over: nothing.
function match.carryDebris(m, s, res, turn, batonRec)
	local g, d = m.game, m.debris
	if g.phase == "over" then
		debris.clear(d)
		return
	end
	if g.turn ~= turn then
		-- the turn is over: its debris is picked up, but the standing
		-- pieces stay as this throw left them
		debris.recordExact(d, g, res, s.side)
		debris.begin(d, g.turn)
		return
	end
	if s.kind == "toss" then
		-- the engine keeps every thrown kubb on the pitch until its round is
		-- judged (out ones too), and any it struck: only their exact rest
		-- poses are carried. A kubb whose support was picked up at the
		-- judgment lies flat where it is, not floating at its old height.
		debris.recordExact(d, g, res, s.side)
		local j = g.judgment
		for _, id in ipairs(j and j.lifted or {}) do
			d.exact[id] = nil
			d.settle = true
		end
		-- a kubb picked up for a rethrow, a rescue or a punishment may have been
		-- propping a standing one sideways: settle whenever the judgment took any
		if j and ((j.rethrow or 0) > 0 or (j.rescue or 0) > 0 or (j.punish or 0) > 0) then
			d.settle = true
		end
		return
	end
	local putBack = batonRec and batonRec.token == "Z"
	if not putBack then
		debris.carry(d, res, s.side)
		for _, id in ipairs(res.toppled or {}) do
			local k = g.kubbs[id]
			if k and k.where ~= "pitch" then debris.add(d, id, "kubb", res, s.side) end
		end
	end
	if s.batonId then debris.add(d, s.batonId, "baton", res, s.side) end
	debris.recordExact(d, g, res, s.side)
end

-- Resign: the team on turn gives up (DESIGN 7: `G` on its own turn).
function match.resign(m)
	local g = m.game
	if g.phase == "over" then return false end
	local side = g.attacker
	g:resign(side, order.thrower(orderOf(m), g))
	m.setup = nil
	debris.clear(m.debris)
	m.text = match.teamName(side, g) .. " resigned: " .. wins(g)
	return true
end

-- One line for the winner screen.
function match.howText(m)
	local g = m.game
	local loser = match.teamName(g.winner == "A" and "B" or "A", g)
	if g.how == "king" then return match.teamName(g.winner, g) .. " toppled the king"
	elseif g.how == "resigned" then return loser .. " resigned"
	elseif g.how == "king toppled by a thrown kubb" then return loser .. " toppled the king with a kubb"
	elseif g.how == "king toppled early" then return loser .. " hit the king too soon" end
	return g.how or ""
end

-- The game file (DESIGN 7): text and file name. finish = {year, month, day,
-- hour, min}; the start is m.start (finish when it was not given).
function match.file(m, finish, version)
	local start = m.start or finish
	local g = m.game
	local levels = {}
	for _, side in ipairs { "A", "B" } do
		for _, e in ipairs(m.lineup and m.lineup[side] or {}) do
			if e.level then levels[#levels + 1] = e.id .. " " .. e.level end
		end
	end
	local text = notation.render(g, { start = start, finish = finish, version = version, mode = m.mode,
		levels = levels })
	return text, notation.filename(start, g.teams.A.name, g.teams.B.name)
end

-- Standing kubbs of a side's half (field and base), for the HUD.
function match.standing(m, side)
	local g = m.game
	return #g:fieldKubbs(side) + #g:baseKubbs(side)
end

tw.match = match
core/matchopts:
-- The match options (Jamie, 2026-11-14: "essentially it is the game options
-- for the match you are starting"): chosen on scenes/options before each
-- match, after the names. Pure: no playdate.*.
--
--   matchopts.list           the rows, in order: key, label, values, shown
--   matchopts.defaults()     a choice table { surface = 1, opening = 1, raising = 1, set = 1, wind = 1 }
--   matchopts.valid(c)       a choice table read back from the datastore, or the defaults
--   matchopts.step(c, key, d)  the value of row `key` moved by d (-1 or 1), wrapping
--   matchopts.value(c, key)  the chosen value; matchopts.shown(c, key) its words
--   matchopts.apply(opts, c) the scenes/match options the choice makes
import "core/tw"

local matchopts = {}

matchopts.list = {
	{ key = "surface", label = "SURFACE", values = { "Grass", "Sand", "Snow" }, shown = { "GRASS", "SAND", "SNOW" } },
	{ key = "opening", label = "OPENING", values = { "2-4-6", "six" },
		shown = { "2-4-6", "SIX FROM THE START" } },
	{ key = "raising", label = "RAISING", values = { "hand", "auto" }, shown = { "BY HAND", "AUTOMATIC" } },
	-- the kubb set (Jamie, 2026-11-14; render/world's sets: painted heads and crown)
	{ key = "set", label = "SET", values = { "classic", "usa", "sweden", "minnesota", "wisconsin" },
		shown = { "CLASSIC", "USA", "SWEDEN", "MINNESOTA", "WISCONSIN" } },
	-- the wind (Jamie and Tyler, 2026-11-14; core/wind)
	{ key = "wind", label = "WIND", values = { "off", "light", "strong" }, shown = { "OFF", "LIGHT", "STRONG" } },
}

local byKey = {}
for _, row in ipairs(matchopts.list) do byKey[row.key] = row end

function matchopts.defaults()
	local c = {}
	for _, row in ipairs(matchopts.list) do c[row.key] = 1 end
	return c
end

function matchopts.valid(c)
	local d = matchopts.defaults()
	if type(c) ~= "table" then return d end
	for _, row in ipairs(matchopts.list) do
		local v = c[row.key]
		if type(v) == "number" and v >= 1 and v <= #row.values and v == math.floor(v) then d[row.key] = v end
	end
	return d
end

function matchopts.step(c, key, d)
	local n = #byKey[key].values
	c[key] = (c[key] - 1 + d) % n + 1
	return c[key]
end

function matchopts.value(c, key) return byKey[key].values[c[key]] end
function matchopts.shown(c, key) return byKey[key].shown[c[key]] end

-- opts (scenes/match options: names, vs, ...) with the surface, the opening,
-- whether the engine raises the kubbs (autoSettle), the kubb set and the wind
-- from the choice.
function matchopts.apply(opts, c)
	opts.surface = matchopts.value(c, "surface")
	opts.opening = matchopts.value(c, "opening")
	opts.autoSettle = matchopts.value(c, "raising") == "auto" or nil
	opts.set = matchopts.value(c, "set")
	opts.wind = matchopts.value(c, "wind")
	return opts
end

tw.matchopts = matchopts
core/names:
-- Team names as typed (the Names board: "UP TO 10 LETTERS"). Pure: no
-- playdate.*.
--
-- A name keeps letters, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes, at most names.max
-- characters, with no leading space and no doubled spaces. It needs one
-- letter to count. The game file's id for it is notation.baseId.
import "core/tw"
import "core/notation"

local notation = tw.notation

local names = {}

names.max = 10
names.defaults = { A = "Team A", B = "Team B", you = "You" }

-- The text as a name may be: unwanted characters dropped, spaces tidied,
-- cut to names.max.
function names.clean(s)
	s = (s or ""):gsub("[^%a%s%-']", ""):gsub("%s+", " "):gsub("^ ", "")
	if #s > names.max then s = s:sub(1, names.max) end
	return s
end

-- A finished name: cleaned, trailing space dropped; nil when it has no letter.
function names.finish(s)
	s = names.clean(s):gsub(" $", "")
	if not s:find("%a") then return nil end
	return s
end

-- The game file id the name will have (before a clash with the other team's
-- adds "_b").
function names.id(s)
	return notation.baseId(s)
end

-- The engine's teams for a match: one player per team, named as the team.
-- list = { A = name, B = name }.
function names.teams(list)
	return {
		A = { name = list.A, players = { { name = list.A } } },
		B = { name = list.B, players = { { name = list.B } } },
	}
end

tw.names = names
core/notation:
-- Planet Kubb Notation: the score sheet the rules engine fills in as a game
-- runs, and the game file text (DESIGN.md section 7). Pure Lua: no
-- playdate.*, no os.time: times are passed in as tables
-- { year, month, day, hour, min }.
--
-- Counting, chosen so kubb.js (pk-kubb-score) replays every file with no
-- warnings:
--   I  every first throw of a kubb this turn, rescued kubbs included, so
--      I = kubbs knocked down last turn + Q (kubb.js checks I + Y = that).
--   R  every rethrow made (a kubb's second throw).
--   P  every punishment kubb (a kubb out after two throws; it is in R too).
--   Q  every established field kubb a toss knocked out of bounds (II.C.5a).
--   N  every kubb that came to rest on top of another (II.D.6), at most 5
--      per token (the grammar's limit).
--   Y  never written: a failed rescue attempt is intent the game cannot see.
--
-- Positions (optional in the notation, written by the game since
-- 2026-11-16): a comment that starts with @ straight after an inkast token
-- or a baton token, "j:2I (@ 1.32,5.87 1.40,6.02)". The sheet keeps them as
-- data beside the token in the engine's world frame (meters, x across
-- -2.5..2.5, y from Team A's baseline); turnLine converts them with
-- notation.pitchXY and never writes more than the token counts.
import "core/tw"

local floor, concat, fmt = math.floor, table.concat, string.format

local notation = {}

notation.event = "Throwing Wood"
notation.location = "Playdate"
notation.scorer = "Throwing Wood"

-- ---------- player ids ----------

-- The id of a name: lowercased, spaces and hyphens become "_", anything else
-- that is not a letter is dropped, underscores are not doubled or left at
-- the ends. "p" if nothing is left.
function notation.baseId(name)
	local s = (name or ""):lower():gsub("[%s%-]+", "_"):gsub("[^a-z_]", "")
	s = s:gsub("_+", "_"):gsub("^_", ""):gsub("_$", "")
	if s == "" then s = "p" end
	return s
end

-- Ids for every player of both teams, unique across the game. A name whose
-- id is taken gets "_b", "_c", ... (letters only, so the grammar accepts it).
-- teams = { A = { players = { { name = } } }, B = ... }; sets players[i].id
-- unless one is given (a given id is cleaned the same way).
function notation.assignIds(teams)
	local taken = {}
	local letters = "bcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
	for _, side in ipairs { "A", "B" } do
		for _, p in ipairs(teams[side].players) do
			local base = notation.baseId(p.id or p.name)
			local id = base
			local i = 1
			while taken[id] do
				local suffix = ""
				local n = i
				repeat
					local k = (n - 1) % #letters + 1
					suffix = letters:sub(k, k) .. suffix
					n = (n - 1) // #letters
				until n == 0
				id = base .. "_" .. suffix
				i = i + 1
			end
			taken[id] = true
			p.id = id
		end
	end
end

-- Names inside header values: no quotes, backslashes or line breaks; player
-- names also lose commas and parentheses (kubb.js splits on them).
function notation.cleanName(s, forPlayers)
	s = (s or ""):gsub("[\"\\\r\n%]%[]", "")
	if forPlayers then s = s:gsub("[,()]", "") end
	s = s:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
	return s
end

-- ---------- times ----------

-- Days since 1970-01-01 for a civil date (Howard Hinnant's algorithm).
local function daysFromCivil(y, m, d)
	if m <= 2 then y = y - 1 end
	local era = floor(y / 400)
	local yoe = y - era * 400
	local mp = (m + 9) % 12
	local doy = floor((153 * mp + 2) / 5) + d - 1
	local doe = yoe * 365 + floor(yoe / 4) - floor(yoe / 100) + doy
	return era * 146097 + doe - 719468
end

local function civilFromDays(z)
	z = z + 719468
	local era = floor(z / 146097)
	local doe = z - era * 146097
	local yoe = floor((doe - floor(doe / 1460) + floor(doe / 36524) - floor(doe / 146096)) / 365)
	local y = yoe + era * 400
	local doy = doe - (365 * yoe + floor(yoe / 4) - floor(yoe / 100))
	local mp = floor((5 * doy + 2) / 153)
	local d = doy - floor((153 * mp + 2) / 5) + 1
	local m = mp < 10 and mp + 3 or mp - 9
	if m <= 2 then y = y + 1 end
	return y, m, d
end

local function toMinutes(t)
	return daysFromCivil(t.year, t.month, t.day) * 1440 + (t.hour or 0) * 60 + (t.min or 0)
end

function notation.minutesBetween(a, b)
	return toMinutes(b) - toMinutes(a)
end

function notation.addMinutes(t, minutes)
	local total = toMinutes(t) + minutes
	local days = floor(total / 1440)
	local rest = total - days * 1440
	local y, m, d = civilFromDays(days)
	return { year = y, month = m, day = d, hour = rest // 60, min = rest % 60 }
end

function notation.formatTime(t)
	return fmt("%04d-%02d-%02d %02d:%02d", t.year, t.month, t.day, t.hour or 0, t.min or 0)
end

local function slug(s)
	s = (s or ""):lower():gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "-"):gsub("^%-+", ""):gsub("%-+$", "")
	if s == "" then s = "team" end
	return s
end
notation.slug = slug

-- YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM-<team-a>-v-<team-b>.txt
function notation.filename(start, teamA, teamB)
	return fmt("%04d-%02d-%02d-%02d%02d-%s-v-%s.txt", start.year, start.month, start.day,
		start.hour or 0, start.min or 0, slug(teamA), slug(teamB))
end

-- ---------- tokens ----------

local function count(n, code)
	if n == 0 then return "" end
	if n == 1 then return code end
	return n .. code
end

-- Inkast token body from { I, R, P, Q, N, E }: "5I2R", "2IRP", "3IQ", "4IE".
function notation.inkastBody(k)
	local n = k.N or 0
	if n > 5 then n = 5 end
	local s = count(k.I or 0, "I") .. count(k.R or 0, "R") .. count(k.P or 0, "P")
		.. count(k.Q or 0, "Q") .. count(n, "N")
	if s == "" then s = "0" end
	if k.E then s = s .. "E" end
	return s
end

-- Baton token from field and base counts and an early-king flag:
-- "-", "F", "2F", "B", "2FB", "2FE", "E".
function notation.hitToken(f, b, e)
	local s = count(f, "F") .. count(b, "B")
	if e then return s .. "E" end
	if s == "" then return "-" end
	return s
end

-- ---------- positions ----------

-- The notation's frame from the engine's: the pitch seen from Team A's
-- baseline in every turn, x meters across from the left sideline (0 to 5),
-- y meters up from Team A's baseline (0 to 8). The engine's x runs across
-- with the sidelines at -2.5 and 2.5, +x on the right of someone on Team A's
-- baseline facing Team B (core/camera: a positive swivel aims toward +x, to
-- the right), and its y is already up from Team A's baseline (y = 0). So it
-- is a shift of x by half the width. Clamped to the pitch (a piece's centre
-- on a line is in; the grammar has no minus sign).
function notation.pitchXY(x, y)
	local nx, ny = x + 2.5, y
	if nx <= 0 then nx = 0 elseif nx > 5 then nx = 5 end
	if ny <= 0 then ny = 0 elseif ny > 8 then ny = 8 end
	return nx, ny
end

-- " (@ 1.32,5.87 1.40,6.02)" for at most `most` world-frame points
-- { x, y } of list `at`; "" when there are none.
function notation.positions(at, most)
	if not at or #at == 0 or (most or 0) <= 0 then return "" end
	local ps = {}
	for i = 1, math.min(#at, most) do
		local nx, ny = notation.pitchXY(at[i].x, at[i].y)
		ps[i] = fmt("%.2f,%.2f", nx, ny)
	end
	return " (@ " .. concat(ps, " ") .. ")"
end

-- How many kubbs a token counts, as kubb.js reads it (its cap on positions):
-- an inkast's I + R + P + Q + N, a baton's F + B.
local function inkastCount(k)
	local n = k.N or 0
	if n > 5 then n = 5 end
	return (k.I or 0) + (k.R or 0) + (k.P or 0) + (k.Q or 0) + n
end

local function batonCount(token)
	local f = token:match("^(%d*)F")
	local b = token:match("(%d*)BE?$")
	local c = 0
	if f then c = c + (f == "" and 1 or tonumber(f)) end
	if b then c = c + (b == "" and 1 or tonumber(b)) end
	return c
end
notation.batonCount = batonCount

-- ---------- the score sheet ----------

local Sheet = {}
Sheet.__index = Sheet
notation.Sheet = Sheet   -- (core/save restores a saved sheet with it)

function notation.sheet()
	return setmetatable({ turns = {} }, Sheet)
end

function Sheet:beginTurn(n, side)
	local t = { n = n, side = side, inkast = {}, inkastOrder = {}, advantage = nil,
		batons = {}, notes = {} }
	self.turns[n] = t
	self.current = t
	return t
end

-- Add `by` (default 1) to inkast code `code` for player `pid`.
function Sheet:ink(pid, code, by)
	local t = self.current
	local k = t.inkast[pid]
	if not k then
		k = { I = 0, R = 0, P = 0, Q = 0, N = 0, E = false }
		t.inkast[pid] = k
		t.inkastOrder[#t.inkastOrder + 1] = pid
	end
	if code == "E" then k.E = true else k[code] = k[code] + (by or 1) end
end

function Sheet:advantage(meters)
	self.current.advantage = meters
end

-- at: optional world-frame points { x, y } of the kubbs it knocked down,
-- each where it stood before the throw (the token's F kubbs, then its B).
function Sheet:baton(pid, token, at)
	local b = self.current.batons
	b[#b + 1] = { player = pid, token = token, at = (at and #at > 0) and at or nil }
end

-- Where a kubb player `pid` threw in this turn stood once raised (or
-- placed), in world meters. Kept per player in t.inkastAt (absent in turns
-- saved before positions).
function Sheet:inkAt(pid, x, y)
	local t = self.current
	local at = t.inkastAt
	if not at then at = {}; t.inkastAt = at end
	local l = at[pid]
	if not l then l = {}; at[pid] = l end
	l[#l + 1] = { x = x, y = y }
end

function Sheet:note(text)
	local n = self.current.notes
	n[#n + 1] = text
end

-- One turn's line, without the trailing newline.
function notation.turnLine(t)
	local parts = { t.n .. "." }
	local notes = {}
	for _, pid in ipairs(t.inkastOrder) do
		local k = t.inkast[pid]
		if (k.N or 0) > 5 then notes[#notes + 1] = k.N .. " kubbs came to rest on another (N is capped at 5)" end
		parts[#parts + 1] = pid .. ":" .. notation.inkastBody(k)
			.. notation.positions(t.inkastAt and t.inkastAt[pid], inkastCount(k))
	end
	if t.advantage then parts[#parts + 1] = t.advantage .. "A" end
	for _, b in ipairs(t.batons) do
		parts[#parts + 1] = (b.player and (b.player .. ":" .. b.token) or b.token)
			.. notation.positions(b.at, batonCount(b.token))
	end
	for _, n in ipairs(t.notes) do notes[#notes + 1] = n end
	local line = concat(parts, " ")
	if #notes > 0 then
		line = line .. " # " .. concat(notes, "; "):gsub("[\r\n#]", " ")
	end
	return line
end

local function teamLabel(side) return "Team " .. side end

-- The game file. `game` is a rules game (tw.rules) that has ended; meta is
-- { start, finish (time tables), version, mode, event, location, levels }.
-- levels: { "kim pro", "sam club", ... } (player id and throw level), written
-- as [Throw Levels "..."] after [Mode] when given.
function notation.render(game, meta)
	meta = meta or {}
	local lines = {}
	local function h(k, v) lines[#lines + 1] = fmt('[%s "%s"]', k, v) end
	h("Event", notation.cleanName(meta.event or notation.event))
	h("Location", notation.cleanName(meta.location or notation.location))
	if meta.start then h("Start", notation.formatTime(meta.start)) end
	if meta.finish then h("End", notation.formatTime(meta.finish)) end
	if meta.start and meta.finish then h("Duration", notation.minutesBetween(meta.start, meta.finish) .. "m") end
	h("Surface", game.surface)
	for _, side in ipairs { "A", "B" } do
		local team = game.teams[side]
		h("Team " .. side, notation.cleanName(team.name))
		local ps = {}
		for _, p in ipairs(team.players) do
			ps[#ps + 1] = notation.cleanName(p.name, true) .. " (" .. p.id .. ")"
		end
		h("Team " .. side .. " Players", concat(ps, ", "))
	end
	h("First", teamLabel(game.first))
	if game.winner then h("Win", teamLabel(game.winner)) end
	h("Scored by", notation.scorer .. " " .. (meta.version or "0.0.0"))
	if meta.mode then h("Mode", meta.mode) end
	-- each player's throw level (docs/PLAYERS.md decision 7): "kim pro, sam club"
	if meta.levels and #meta.levels > 0 then h("Throw Levels", concat(meta.levels, ", ")) end
	h("Rules", game.opening == "six" and "U.S. Championship 4.0, six from the start"
		or "U.S. Championship 4.0, 2-4-6")
	lines[#lines + 1] = ""
	for i = 1, #game.sheet.turns do
		lines[#lines + 1] = notation.turnLine(game.sheet.turns[i])
	end
	return concat(lines, "\n") .. "\n"
end

tw.notation = notation
core/order:
-- The throwing order inside a team (docs/PLAYERS.md section 5): who throws
-- every baton and kubb, decided before the throw, within Rules V4.0. Pure
-- Lua: no playdate.*. Once per throw, not a per-frame path.
--
-- The rules (V4.0), kept as far as a team's size allows:
--   II.B.5  no player throws more than two batons in a turn: a team of n
--           players caps each at max(2, ceil(batons / n)) (one player
--           throws all six, two throw three each);
--   II.A.4  in the 2-4-6 opening the two batons are thrown by two different
--           players and the four by at least three (fewer when the team is
--           smaller).
-- kubb.js checks neither; order.checkSheet does, for the headless games.
--
-- Each team has a rotation, its players in order. A turn's batons are dealt
-- from it in blocks, as evenly as possible over as many players as there
-- are batons (order.split): a player throws their batons in a row, so the
-- Playdate changes hands as few times as the rules allow. The next turn
-- starts past the players who threw an extra baton (past everyone dealt
-- when all threw the same), so the doubles go round the team. The kubbs (first throws,
-- rethrows) are thrown by one inkaster, by default the turn's first baton
-- thrower. Either can be changed before a throw (order.change,
-- order.setInkaster) as long as the rules still hold.
--
--   local o = order.new(g.teams)          -- plain tables: core/save keeps it
--   local pid = order.thrower(o, g)       -- who throws what g:need() asks for
--   g:throwBaton(outcome, pid)
--
-- The state:
--   o.A, o.B   { ids = { player ids in rotation order }, start = index of
--              the player who opens the team's next turn }
--   o.turn, o.side, o.batons   the turn dealt (the engine's turn number)
--   o.deal     player id per baton of that turn
--   o.inkaster player id who throws that turn's kubbs
import "core/tw"
import "core/rules"

local rules = tw.rules
local ceil = math.ceil

local order = {}

-- Batons one player may throw in a turn of `batons` (II.B.5) on a team of n.
function order.cap(n, batons)
	local c = ceil(batons / n)
	if c < 2 then c = 2 end
	return c
end

-- Different players a turn of `batons` needs on a team of n (II.A.4: two
-- for the opening's two batons, three for its four).
function order.distinct(n, batons)
	local d = 1
	if batons == 2 then d = 2 elseif batons == 4 then d = 3 end
	if d > n then d = n end
	return d
end

-- The blocks: batons each player throws, in rotation order, for a turn of
-- `batons` on a team of n. { 2, 2, 1, 1 } for six batons and four players.
function order.split(n, batons)
	local k = n < batons and n or batons
	local base, extra = batons // k, batons % k
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, k do out[i] = base + (i <= extra and 1 or 0) end
	return out
end

-- Whether the batons thrown so far (`pids`, player ids in order) can still
-- make a legal turn of `batons` on a team of n. false and why ("cap": a
-- player over the limit, "distinct": too few different players left
-- possible) otherwise.
function order.check(n, batons, pids)
	local count, distinct = {}, 0
	local cap = order.cap(n, batons)
	for _, pid in ipairs(pids) do
		local c = (count[pid] or 0) + 1
		if c == 1 then distinct = distinct + 1 end
		if c > cap then return false, "cap" end
		count[pid] = c
	end
	if distinct + (batons - #pids) < order.distinct(n, batons) then return false, "distinct" end
	return true
end

function order.new(teams)
	local o = {}
	for _, side in ipairs { "A", "B" } do
		local ids = {}
		for i, p in ipairs(teams[side].players) do ids[i] = p.id end
		o[side] = { ids = ids, start = 1 }
	end
	return o
end

local function onTeam(o, side, pid)
	for _, id in ipairs(o[side].ids) do
		if id == pid then return true end
	end
	return false
end

-- Deal the turn: `side` throws `batons` in engine turn `turn`.
function order.beginTurn(o, side, turn, batons)
	local t = o[side]
	local n = #t.ids
	local blocks = order.split(n, batons)
	local deal = {}
	for i, c in ipairs(blocks) do
		local pid = t.ids[(t.start - 1 + i - 1) % n + 1]
		for _ = 1, c do deal[#deal + 1] = pid end
	end
	o.turn, o.side, o.batons, o.deal, o.inkaster = turn, side, batons, deal, deal[1]
	-- move on past those who threw an extra baton, so the doubles go round
	-- the team; past everyone dealt when all threw the same (in the
	-- opening, whoever did not throw opens the team's next turn)
	local extra = batons % #blocks
	t.start = (t.start - 1 + (extra > 0 and extra or #blocks)) % n + 1
end

-- Deal the engine's current turn if it has not been dealt yet.
function order.sync(o, g)
	if g.phase ~= "over" and o.turn ~= g.turn then
		order.beginTurn(o, g.attacker, g.turn, g.batonsTotal)
	end
end

-- Who throws next in game g: the inkaster during the kubb throwing, the
-- dealt player for the next baton otherwise (also while the defender
-- raises, so a resign then is the next baton thrower's). nil once over.
function order.thrower(o, g)
	if g.phase == "over" then return nil end
	order.sync(o, g)
	if g.phase == "toss" or g.phase == "rethrow" then return o.inkaster end
	return o.deal[g.batonIndex + 1] or o.deal[#o.deal]
end

-- Whether `pid` may take baton n of the dealt turn: the deal with pid on
-- baton n and the player it replaces on pid's first later baton (a swap,
-- so the rest of the turn keeps its shape), checked whole. Returns ok, why
-- ("team", "cap", "distinct", "thrown") and the new deal.
function order.allowed(o, n, pid, thrown)
	if not onTeam(o, o.side, pid) then return false, "team" end
	if thrown and n <= thrown then return false, "thrown" end
	local deal = {}
	for i, p in ipairs(o.deal) do deal[i] = p end
	local was = deal[n]
	if was == pid then return true, nil, deal end
	deal[n] = pid
	for j = n + 1, #deal do
		if deal[j] == pid then deal[j] = was; break end
	end
	local ok, why = order.check(#o[o.side].ids, o.batons, deal)
	if not ok then return false, why end
	return true, nil, deal
end

-- Give baton n to `pid` (order.allowed); returns ok, why.
function order.change(o, n, pid, thrown)
	local ok, why, deal = order.allowed(o, n, pid, thrown)
	if ok then o.deal = deal end
	return ok, why
end

-- The turn's kubbs go to `pid` (any player of the team); returns ok, why.
function order.setInkaster(o, pid)
	if not onTeam(o, o.side, pid) then return false, "team" end
	o.inkaster = pid
	return true
end

-- Every way game g's score sheet breaks the order's rules or its teams:
-- a list of strings, empty when it keeps them all.
function order.checkSheet(g)
	local out = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(g.sheet.turns) do
		local side = t.side
		local members = {}
		for _, p in ipairs(g.teams[side].players) do members[p.id] = true end
		local n = #g.teams[side].players
		local batons = rules.batonsFor(g.opening, t.n)
		local pids = {}
		for _, b in ipairs(t.batons) do
			if b.player and not members[b.player] then
				out[#out + 1] = ("turn %d: %s is not on Team %s"):format(t.n, b.player, side)
			end
			if b.token ~= "X" and b.token ~= "G" then pids[#pids + 1] = b.player end
		end
		for _, pid in ipairs(t.inkastOrder) do
			if not members[pid] then out[#out + 1] = ("turn %d: kubbs by %s, not on Team %s"):format(t.n, pid, side) end
		end
		local ok, why = order.check(n, batons, pids)
		if not ok then
			out[#out + 1] = ("turn %d: %s (%d players, %s)"):format(t.n,
				why == "cap" and "a player over the baton limit (II.B.5)" or "too few different throwers (II.A.4)",
				n, table.concat(pids, " "))
		end
	end
	return out
end

tw.order = order
core/outcome:
-- Physics <-> rules. Turns the rules engine's pitch (tw.rules poses, world
-- frame) into physics pieces in the thrower's view frame (core/frame), and a
-- finished physics throw (tw.world.result, view frame) back into the outcome
-- records the engine takes (docs/notes/rules-engine.md "Baton outcome", "Kubb-toss outcome").
-- Pure Lua: no playdate.*. Not a per-frame path: once per throw.
--
--   local pieces = outcome.pieces(g, side)        -- what is on the pitch now
--   local w = tw.world.new{ surface = s, pieces = pieces }
--   ... launch, run to rest ...
--   local res = tw.world.result(w)
--   g:throwBaton(outcome.baton(res, pieces, side, illegal))
--   g:toss(outcome.toss(res, pieces, side, kubbId))
--
-- A piece of outcome.pieces is a tw.world piece ({id, kind, x, y, qw..qz,
-- toppled} in the view frame) with what the conversion needs back:
-- role ("base" | "field" | "king"), half ("A" | "B") and pose (the engine's
-- pose, world frame).
import "core/tw"
import "core/frame"
import "core/quat"

local frame, quat = tw.frame, tw.quat
local sqrt, atan, cos, sin, pi = math.sqrt, math.atan, math.cos, math.sin, math.pi

local outcome = {}

outcome.tune = {
	standingCos = 0.7071, -- a kubb whose long axis is within 45 degrees of vertical stands on an end
	movedEps = 0.002,     -- m; a piece whose center moved more than this has moved
	turnedEps = 0.02,     -- rad of yaw (or tilt) change that also counts as moved
	onTopLying = 0.08,    -- m; a lying kubb's center higher than this rests on something
	                      -- (on the ground it is 0.035, flat on a lying kubb 0.105)
	onTopStanding = 0.11, -- m; the same for a kubb on an end (0.075 on the ground)
	onTopReach = 0.25,    -- m; the piece it rests on is the nearest within this
}

-- ---------- poses ----------

-- The engine pose of a body pose (any frame; the result is in the same
-- frame): standing when the long axis (column 3) is within 45 degrees of
-- vertical; angle is the yaw of the square when standing, else the long
-- axis direction. Returns the pose and the center height z.
function outcome.poseOf(x, y, z, qw, qx, qy, qz)
	local r11, _, r13, r21, _, r23, _, _, r33 = quat.toMatrix(qw, qx, qy, qz)
	local standing = r33 >= outcome.tune.standingCos or r33 <= -outcome.tune.standingCos
	local angle
	if standing then angle = atan(r21, r11) else angle = atan(r23, r13) end
	return { x = x, y = y, standing = standing, angle = angle }, z
end

-- The body orientation of an engine pose: standing upright turned by angle,
-- or lying on a face with the long axis along angle.
function outcome.quatOf(pose)
	local a = pose.angle or 0
	if pose.standing then return cos(a / 2), 0, 0, sin(a / 2) end
	local tw_, tx, ty, tz = quat.fromAxisAngle(1, 0, 0, -pi / 2)       -- local z -> +y, a face down
	local zw, zx, zy, zz = quat.fromAxisAngle(0, 0, 1, a - pi / 2)    -- +y -> the axis direction
	return quat.mul(zw, zx, zy, zz, tw_, tx, ty, tz)
end

-- ---------- the engine's pitch as physics pieces ----------

local function piece(id, kind, role, half, pose, side)
	local v = frame.pose(side, pose)
	local qw, qx, qy, qz = outcome.quatOf(v)
	return { id = id, kind = kind, role = role, half = half, pose = pose,
		x = v.x, y = v.y, qw = qw, qx = qx, qy = qy, qz = qz, toppled = not v.standing }
end

-- Every piece the engine has on the pitch (kubbs in id order, then the king),
-- in `side`'s view frame.
function outcome.pieces(g, side)
	local out = {}
	for _, k in ipairs(g:onPitch()) do
		out[#out + 1] = piece(k.id, "kubb", k.kind, k.half, k.pose, side)
	end
	out[#out + 1] = piece("king", "king", "king", nil, g.king.pose, side)
	return out
end

-- ---------- results back to outcome records ----------

-- Did this body move from where its piece started?
local function movedFrom(p, rb)
	local t = outcome.tune
	local dx, dy = rb.x - p.x, rb.y - p.y
	if dx * dx + dy * dy > t.movedEps * t.movedEps then return true end
	-- turned or tilted: compare the rotation (|dot| of the quaternions)
	local d = rb.qw * p.qw + rb.qx * p.qx + rb.qy * p.qy + rb.qz * p.qz
	if d < 0 then d = -d end
	return d < cos(t.turnedEps / 2)
end

-- The world-frame pose of a body result (view frame) for `side`.
local function worldPose(side, rb)
	local p, z = outcome.poseOf(rb.x, rb.y, rb.z, rb.qw, rb.qx, rb.qy, rb.qz)
	return frame.pose(side, p), z
end

-- moved = { [id] = world pose } of every piece that moved.
local function movedPoses(res, pieces, side)
	local moved = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(pieces) do
		local rb = res.bodies[p.id]
		if rb and movedFrom(p, rb) then moved[p.id] = (worldPose(side, rb)) end
	end
	return moved
end

local function byId(pieces)
	local m = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(pieces) do m[p.id] = p end
	return m
end

-- The baton outcome. `res` is tw.world.result of a world built from
-- `pieces` (outcome.pieces for `side`), `illegal` the swing's verdict
-- (a helicopter).
--   toppled      every kubb and the king that toppled (world.result)
--   kingToppled
--   moved        rest pose (world frame) of every piece that moved
--   ownHalfHit   field kubbs in the thrower's own half that anything touched
--                (in practice the baton: they stand far from everything else)
function outcome.baton(res, pieces, side, illegal)
	local o = { illegal = illegal and true or false, toppled = {}, kingToppled = res.kingToppled and true or false,
		moved = movedPoses(res, pieces, side), ownHalfHit = {} }
	for i, id in ipairs(res.toppled) do o.toppled[i] = id end
	local info = byId(pieces)
	for _, id in ipairs(res.touched) do
		local p = info[id]
		if p and p.role == "field" and p.half == side then o.ownHalfHit[#o.ownHalfHit + 1] = id end
	end
	table.sort(o.ownHalfHit)
	return o
end

-- The piece a kubb body rests on: when its center sits clearly above the
-- ground, the nearest other piece where it ended (nil otherwise).
local function restingOn(res, pieces, rb, id, standing, z, extraId)
	local t = outcome.tune
	if (standing and z <= t.onTopStanding) or (not standing and z <= t.onTopLying) then return nil end
	local best, bd = nil, t.onTopReach
	for _, p in ipairs(pieces) do
		local b = res.bodies[p.id]
		if b and p.id ~= id then
			local dx, dy = b.x - rb.x, b.y - rb.y
			local d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
			if d < bd then best, bd = p.id, d end
		end
	end
	-- the thrown kubb is not one of `pieces` (it is the projectile body)
	local b = extraId and extraId ~= id and res.bodies[extraId]
	if b then
		local dx, dy = b.x - rb.x, b.y - rb.y
		if sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) < bd then best = extraId end
	end
	return best
end

-- The kubb-toss outcome for kubb `kubbId` (the projectile body, id kubbId).
--   rest         its rest pose (world frame); onTop = the id of the piece it
--                rests on when its center sits clearly above the ground
--   moved        rest poses of every other piece that moved; a field kubb
--                left resting on another gets onTop too (the engine lowers
--                it when the round is judged, II.D.6)
--   kingToppled
--   ownHalfHit   pieces in the thrower's own half that anything touched
-- Every kubb thrown this turn is one of `pieces` (outcome.pieces), in or
-- out, so a kubb may rest on any of them.
function outcome.toss(res, pieces, side, kubbId)
	local rb = assert(res.bodies[kubbId], "no body " .. tostring(kubbId))
	local rest, z = worldPose(side, rb)
	local on = restingOn(res, pieces, rb, kubbId, rest.standing, z)
	if on then rest.onTop, rest.standing = on, false end
	local o = { rest = rest, moved = {}, kingToppled = res.kingToppled and true or false, ownHalfHit = {} }
	for _, p in ipairs(pieces) do
		local b = res.bodies[p.id]
		if b and p.id ~= kubbId and movedFrom(p, b) then
			local pose, pz = worldPose(side, b)
			if p.role == "field" then
				local under = restingOn(res, pieces, b, p.id, pose.standing, pz, kubbId)
				if under then pose.onTop, pose.standing = under, false end
			end
			o.moved[p.id] = pose
		end
	end
	local info = byId(pieces)
	for _, id in ipairs(res.touched) do
		local p = info[id]
		if p and p.role ~= "king" and p.half == side then o.ownHalfHit[#o.ownHalfHit + 1] = id end
	end
	table.sort(o.ownHalfHit)
	return o
end

tw.outcome = outcome
core/pitch:
-- Pitch constants and half/bounds tests (DESIGN.md section 2, Rules V4.0 I.B).
-- Pure Lua: no playdate.*. World meters: x across (-2.5 to 2.5), y downfield
-- (0 = Team A's baseline, 8 = Team B's), centerline at y = 4.
import "core/tw"

local floor, abs = math.floor, math.abs

local pitch = {
	halfWidth = 2.5,        -- sidelines at x = -2.5 and 2.5
	length = 8,
	center = 4,             -- centerline y
	kubbLong = 0.15,        -- kubb 7 x 7 x 15 cm
	kubbSide = 0.07,
	kingSide = 0.09,        -- king 9 x 9 x 30 cm
	batonLength = 0.30,     -- punishment kubbs keep one baton length from king and stakes
	stakeRadius = 0.0095,   -- m: a 3/4 inch stake (Jamie, 2026-11-14); a small circle for obstruction
	baseline = { A = 0, B = 8 },
	-- Six stakes: the four corners and the two ends of the centerline.
	stakes = {
		{ x = -2.5, y = 0 }, { x = 2.5, y = 0 },
		{ x = -2.5, y = 4 }, { x = 2.5, y = 4 },
		{ x = -2.5, y = 8 }, { x = 2.5, y = 8 },
	},
	-- Base kubb x positions on each baseline (as drawn in stage 1).
	baseX = { -2, -1, 0, 1, 2 },
	king = { x = 0, y = 4 },
}

function pitch.other(side)
	return side == "A" and "B" or "A"
end

-- Is the point (a piece's center) inside `side`'s half? Lines count as in
-- (a center on the line is 50% in, which is in: II.C.6).
function pitch.inHalf(side, x, y)
	if abs(x) > pitch.halfWidth then return false end
	if side == "A" then return y >= 0 and y <= pitch.center end
	return y >= pitch.center and y <= pitch.length
end

-- Is the point on the pitch at all (either half)?
function pitch.onPitch(x, y)
	return abs(x) <= pitch.halfWidth and y >= 0 and y <= pitch.length
end

-- Distance of y from `side`'s own baseline.
function pitch.fromBaseline(side, y)
	return abs(y - pitch.baseline[side])
end

-- The `nA` number: whole meters from the attacker's own baseline, rounded
-- down, 0 to 4 (DESIGN.md section 7).
function pitch.advantageMeters(side, lineY)
	local m = floor(pitch.fromBaseline(side, lineY) + 1e-9)
	if m < 0 then m = 0 elseif m > 4 then m = 4 end
	return m
end

tw.pitch = pitch
core/playback:
-- Compute ahead and play back (DESIGN 5). The physics runs at a fixed step
-- (world.tune.dt) as far ahead of the screen as the frame budget allows and
-- records every body's pose every frameDt of simulated time. The scene shows
-- any time between two recorded frames (playback.poseAt interpolates), at a
-- speed playback.pace keeps steady: slower than real time when the physics
-- cannot keep up, so the picture slows smoothly instead of stopping and
-- starting. Pure Lua: the clock is passed in.
--
-- Storage: one flat number array per body, 7 numbers per frame
-- (x, y, z, qw, qx, qy, qz), starting at the first frame the body was awake.
-- Before that the body sits at its starting pose. A body woken late costs
-- nothing until then; a standing kubb nobody touches costs nothing at all.
--
--   local pb = playback.new(w, 1 / 50)
--   each frame: playback.advance(pb, budgetSeconds, clock)
--               if pb.frame < pb.frames then pb.frame = pb.frame + 1 end
--               playback.pose(pb, i, pb.frame) for each body index i
--   pb.done and pb.frame == pb.frames: the throw is over
import "core/tw"
import "core/world"

local world = tw.world
local sqrt, floor = math.sqrt, math.floor

local playback = {}

-- The calm: below these speeds (every awake body, m/s and rad/s) nothing on
-- screen visibly moves; the throw only waits for the sleep timer
-- (world.tune.sleepTime) or a last slow roll. pb.calmFrom is the first
-- frame of the calm stretch that runs to the newest recorded frame (nil when
-- the newest frame is not calm). The scene holds the picture there and
-- gives the physics the whole frame (scenes/throw).
playback.calm = { lin = 0.05, ang = 0.5 }

local function record(pb)
	local w = pb.w
	local f = pb.frames
	local calm = true
	local l2, a2 = pb.calmLin2, pb.calmAng2
	for i = 1, w.n do
		local b = w.bodies[i]
		local r = pb.rec[i]
		if not r then
			r = { start = -1, data = {}, x = b.x, y = b.y, z = b.z, qw = b.qw, qx = b.qx, qy = b.qy, qz = b.qz }
			pb.rec[i] = r
		end
		if r.start < 0 and b.everAwake then r.start = f end
		if r.start >= 0 then
			local d, k = r.data, (f - r.start) * 7
			d[k + 1], d[k + 2], d[k + 3] = b.x, b.y, b.z
			d[k + 4], d[k + 5], d[k + 6], d[k + 7] = b.qw, b.qx, b.qy, b.qz
			if calm and b.awake then
				local vx, vy, vz, wx, wy, wz = b.vx, b.vy, b.vz, b.wx, b.wy, b.wz
				if vx * vx + vy * vy + vz * vz > l2 or wx * wx + wy * wy + wz * wz > a2 then calm = false end
			end
		end
	end
	if not calm then pb.calmFrom = nil
	elseif not pb.calmFrom then pb.calmFrom = f end
end

-- A playback of world w (already built and launched) at frameDt per frame.
function playback.new(w, frameDt)
	local pb = {
		w = w,
