-- every loop over the other bodies (a thrown baton spends about half its
-- steps like this). The test is conservative: it bounds the speeds after
-- the forces from above and keeps loneSlack (m) in hand for rounding.
world.loneFlight = true
local LONE_SLACK <const> = 0.001
local COS_END <const> = 0.866   -- cos 30 degrees: within this of upright is "on an end"

local function loneRefresh(w)
	local bodies = w.bodies
	local lone, count, top = false, 0, -1e9
	for i = 1, w.n do
		local b = bodies[i]
		if b.awake then
			count = count + 1
			lone = b
		else
			local h = b.z + b.radius
			if h > top then top = h end
		end
	end
	w.lone = (count == 1) and lone or false
	w.loneTop = top
	w.loneEpoch = epoch
end

-- One step of the lone body b, or false if it might touch something.
local function loneStep(w, b, t, P)
	local dt, g = t.dt, t.g
	local vx, vy, vz, wx, wy, wz = b.vx, b.vy, b.vz, b.wx, b.wy, b.wz
	local r = b.radius
	-- after the forces: |v| grows by at most g dt; the gyroscopic step turns
	-- the spin and changes its size by far less than half
	local avz = vz < 0 and -vz or vz
	local spin = sqrt(wx * wx + wy * wy + wz * wz) * 1.5 * r
	local low = b.z - r - t.margin - LONE_SLACK
	-- the ground: every point is above the ground contact margin
	if low <= (avz + g * dt + spin) * dt then return false end
	-- the pairs: higher than every other body's bounding sphere by the reach
	if low - w.loneTop <= (sqrt(vx * vx + vy * vy + vz * vz) + g * dt + spin) * dt then return false end
	local pc, pt
	if P then pc = P.clock; pt = pc() end
	-- 1. forces
	w.awakeCount = 1
	b.vz = vz - g * dt
	if b == w.projectile and not w.firstContact then
		-- the air's drag (airDrag, written out)
		local k = b.dragK
		local rx, ry, rz = w.windX - b.vx, w.windY - b.vy, -b.vz
		local kd = k * dt * sqrt(rx * rx + ry * ry + rz * rz)
		b.vx, b.vy, b.vz = b.vx + kd * rx, b.vy + kd * ry, b.vz + kd * rz
	end
	-- the turn: a drill in flight takes the air's turn and the gyroscopic
	-- term in substeps as it moves (flightTurn); anything else here
	local drillTurn = b.aeroK and b == w.projectile and not w.firstContact
	if not drillTurn and t.gyro then gyro(b, dt) end
	b.groundImpulse = 0
	b.plough = 0   -- in the air: as the full step does for a body off the ground
	-- 2-4. no contacts
	C.n = 0
	w.contacts = 0
	nRec = 0
	-- 5. integrate (no contact: the trapezoid move, as world.step's stage 5)
	local h = 0.5 * dt
	b.x, b.y, b.z = b.x + (vx + b.vx) * h, b.y + (vy + b.vy) * h, b.z + (vz + b.vz) * h
	if drillTurn then
		flightTurn(w, b, dt, t.flightTurns, t.gyro)
	else
		local qw, qx, qy, qz = b.qw, b.qx, b.qy, b.qz
		wx, wy, wz = b.wx, b.wy, b.wz
		local dw = -(wx * qx + wy * qy + wz * qz)
		local dx = wx * qw + wy * qz - wz * qy
		local dy = wy * qw + wz * qx - wx * qz
		local dz = wz * qw + wx * qy - wy * qx
		qw, qx, qy, qz = qw + h * dw, qx + h * dx, qy + h * dy, qz + h * dz
		local qn = sqrt(qw * qw + qx * qx + qy * qy + qz * qz)
		if qn < 1e-12 then
			qw, qx, qy, qz = 1, 0, 0, 0
		else
			qn = 1 / qn
			qw, qx, qy, qz = qw * qn, qx * qn, qy * qn, qz * qn
		end
		b.qw, b.qx, b.qy, b.qz = qw, qx, qy, qz
		local xx, yy, zz = qx * qx, qy * qy, qz * qz
		local xy, xz, yz = qx * qy, qx * qz, qy * qz
		local xw, yw, zw = qw * qx, qw * qy, qw * qz
		local r11, r12, r13 = 1 - 2 * (yy + zz), 2 * (xy - zw), 2 * (xz + yw)
		local r21, r22, r23 = 2 * (xy + zw), 1 - 2 * (xx + zz), 2 * (yz - xw)
		local r31, r32, r33 = 2 * (xz - yw), 2 * (yz + xw), 1 - 2 * (xx + yy)
		b.r11, b.r12, b.r13, b.r21, b.r22, b.r23, b.r31, b.r32, b.r33 = r11, r12, r13, r21, r22, r23, r31, r32, r33
		local ia, ic, ie = b.iIx, b.iIy, b.iIz
		b.i11 = r11 * r11 * ia + r12 * r12 * ic + r13 * r13 * ie
		b.i12 = r11 * r21 * ia + r12 * r22 * ic + r13 * r23 * ie
		b.i13 = r11 * r31 * ia + r12 * r32 * ic + r13 * r33 * ie
		b.i22 = r21 * r21 * ia + r22 * r22 * ic + r23 * r23 * ie
		b.i23 = r21 * r31 * ia + r22 * r32 * ic + r23 * r33 * ie
		b.i33 = r31 * r31 * ia + r32 * r32 * ic + r33 * r33 * ie
	end
	-- 6-8. nothing to relax, bounce or store; the tail for b (no ground
	-- impulse: no rolling resistance, and it cannot fall asleep)
	w.time = w.time + dt
	w.steps = w.steps + 1
	w.loneStep = w.steps
	if b.dig > 0 then
		b.dig = b.dig * exp(-dt / w.surface.digTime)
		if b.dig < 1e-5 then b.dig = 0 end
	end
	local sinTopple = sin(rad(t.toppleDeg))
	local r33 = b.r33
	if b.shape == 1 and not b.toppled and r33 <= sinTopple and r33 >= -sinTopple then b.toppled = true; b.toppleT = w.time end
	local x, y = b.x, b.y
	local half, len, om = t.pitchHalfWidth, t.pitchLength, t.outMargin
	if x > half + om or x < -(half + om) or y < -om or y > len + om then b.leftPitch = true end
	b.sleepTime = 0
	if P then P.lone = P.lone + pc() - pt end
	return true
end

function world.step(w)
	local t = world.tune
	local P = world.prof
	if world.loneFlight then
		if w.loneEpoch ~= epoch then loneRefresh(w) end
		local b = w.lone
		if b and loneStep(w, b, t, P) then return w end
	end
	local dt = t.dt
	local invDt = 1 / dt
	local surf = w.surface
	local biteFade = 1 - dt / (surf.biteTime or 1)
	local bodies, nb = w.bodies, w.n
	local stamp = w.steps
	local pc, pt
	if P then pc = P.clock; pt = pc() end
	local g = t.g

	-- 1. forces
	local awakeCount = 0
	local useGyro = t.gyro
	local inAir = not w.firstContact
	local proj = w.projectile
	for i = 1, nb do
		local b = bodies[i]
		if b.awake then
			awakeCount = awakeCount + 1
			OVX[i], OVY[i], OVZ[i] = b.vx, b.vy, b.vz
			b.vz = b.vz - g * dt
			if inAir and b == proj then
				-- the air's drag (airDrag, written out)
				local k = b.dragK
				local rx, ry, rz = w.windX - b.vx, w.windY - b.vy, -b.vz
				local kd = k * dt * sqrt(rx * rx + ry * ry + rz * rz)
				b.vx, b.vy, b.vz = b.vx + kd * rx, b.vy + kd * ry, b.vz + kd * rz
			end
			-- a drill in flight takes the air's turn and the gyroscopic term
			-- in substeps as it moves (stage 5, flightTurn)
			if useGyro and not (inAir and b == proj and b.aeroK) then gyro(b, dt) end
			b.groundImpulse = 0
		end
	end
	w.awakeCount = awakeCount

	if P then local now = pc(); P.forces = P.forces + now - pt; pt = now end
	-- 2. contacts: pairs, then the ground
	C.n = 0
	-- per body: position, radius, awake and the speed bound of any of its
	-- points (for the speculative margin)
	for i = 1, nb do
		local b = bodies[i]
		BX[i], BY[i], BZ[i], BR[i] = b.x, b.y, b.z, b.radius
		local aw = b.awake
		AW[i] = aw
		if aw then
			local vx, vy, vz, wx, wy, wz = b.vx, b.vy, b.vz, b.wx, b.wy, b.wz
			SPD[i] = sqrt(vx * vx + vy * vy + vz * vz) + sqrt(wx * wx + wy * wy + wz * wz) * b.radius
		else
			SPD[i] = 0
		end
	end
	-- NXT[k]: the first awake body at k or after (nb + 1: none), so a
	-- sleeping body's pairs jump from one awake partner to the next
	local nxt = nb + 1
	for k = nb, 1, -1 do
		if AW[k] then nxt = k end
		NXT[k] = nxt
	end
	local tmargin = t.margin
	local wakeLin2, wakeAng2 = t.wakeLin * t.wakeLin, t.wakeAng * t.wakeAng
	local nWoke = 0
	for i = 1, nb do
		local sa = SPD[i]
		local ax, ay, az, ar = BX[i], BY[i], BZ[i], BR[i]
		local j = i + 1
		while j <= nb do
			if not AW[i] then j = NXT[j] end
			if j > nb then break end
			do
				local margin = tmargin + (sa + SPD[j]) * dt
				local dx, dy, dz = ax - BX[j], ay - BY[j], az - BZ[j]
				local reach = ar + BR[j] + margin
				if dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz < reach * reach then
					local a, b = bodies[i], bodies[j]
					local before = C.n
					if P then P.narrow = P.narrow + 1 end
					if a.shape == 1 then
						if b.shape == 1 then boxBox(a, b, margin)
						else capsuleBox(b, a, margin) end
					else
						if b.shape == 1 then capsuleBox(a, b, margin)
						else capsuleCapsule(a, b, margin) end
					end
					if C.n > before then
						-- Pieces carried from an earlier throw participate even in a slow
						-- nudge. Once disturbed, retain the sleep hysteresis for resting stacks.
						local o, s = nil, 0
						if not a.awake and not a.static then
							if not a.everAwake or b.vx * b.vx + b.vy * b.vy + b.vz * b.vz > wakeLin2
								or b.wx * b.wx + b.wy * b.wy + b.wz * b.wz > wakeAng2
								or b.wokeStep == stamp then o, s = a, i end
						elseif not b.awake and not b.static then
							if not b.everAwake or a.vx * a.vx + a.vy * a.vy + a.vz * a.vz > wakeLin2
								or a.wx * a.wx + a.wy * a.wy + a.wz * a.wz > wakeAng2
								or a.wokeStep == stamp then o, s = b, j end
						end
						if o then
							epoch = epoch + 1
							o.awake = true
							o.everAwake = true
							o.sleepTime = 0
							o.vz = o.vz - g * dt
							o.groundImpulse = 0
							AW[s] = true
							local vx, vy, vz, wx, wy, wz = o.vx, o.vy, o.vz, o.wx, o.wy, o.wz
							SPD[s] = sqrt(vx * vx + vy * vy + vz * vz) + sqrt(wx * wx + wy * wy + wz * wz) * o.radius
							for k = s, 1, -1 do
								if NXT[k] > s then NXT[k] = s else break end
							end
							-- the group it rests against wakes with it (below)
							o.wokeStep = stamp
							nWoke = nWoke + 1
							WK[nWoke] = s
							WLO[nWoke] = (s == i) and j or s
							WT[s] = i * (nb + 1) + j
							WPOS[s] = nWoke
						end
					end
				end
			end
			j = j + 1
		end
	end
	-- A body woken this step wakes every sleeper it touches, and so on through
	-- the group (Jamie, 2026-11-15: a baton bounced off four field kubbs
	-- standing in a tight row). A sleeper is immovable to the solver, so a
	-- kubb woken by a blow and leaning on a sleeping neighbour stood braced
	-- against a wall for that step: the blow went into the wall and was gone,
	-- and the neighbour woke a step later to nothing. The loop above wakes
	-- the pairs it still comes to (wokeStep); these are the pairs it had
	-- already passed while both slept. Two bodies both woken this step, or a
	-- woken body and a stake, can also be a pair the loop passed while neither
	-- was awake (a baton wakes two kubbs that touch each other): their contact
	-- is made here too, once, so they do not sink into each other for a step
	-- (Codex on the web game's sync). WT is where the pair loop was when a
	-- body woke (past its end for one woken here): a pair it came to before
	-- both of those was skipped. WPOS is a body's place in the queue; the
	-- earlier of two woken bodies makes their contact. Nothing runs here in a
	-- step that wakes nobody.
	if nWoke > 0 then
		local q = 1
		while q <= nWoke do
			local s, lo = WK[q], WLO[q]
			local o = bodies[s]
			local ts = WT[s]
			for k = 1, nb do
				if k ~= s and (AW[k] or bodies[k].static) then
					-- awake already, or a stake: only the contact, nobody wakes
					local c = bodies[k]
					local pt = (k < s) and (k * (nb + 1) + s) or (s * (nb + 1) + k)
					local skipped = ts > pt
					if skipped and not c.static then
						skipped = c.wokeStep == stamp and WT[k] > pt and WPOS[k] > q
					end
					if skipped then
						local margin = tmargin + (SPD[s] + SPD[k]) * dt
						local dx, dy, dz = BX[s] - BX[k], BY[s] - BY[k], BZ[s] - BZ[k]
						local reach = BR[s] + BR[k] + margin
						if dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz < reach * reach then
							local a, b = o, c
							if k < s then a, b = c, o end
							if P then P.narrow = P.narrow + 1 end
							if a.shape == 1 then
								if b.shape == 1 then boxBox(a, b, margin)
								else capsuleBox(b, a, margin) end
							else
								if b.shape == 1 then capsuleBox(a, b, margin)
								else capsuleCapsule(a, b, margin) end
							end
						end
					end
				elseif k ~= s and k < lo then
					local c = bodies[k]
					do
						local margin = tmargin + SPD[s] * dt
						local dx, dy, dz = BX[s] - BX[k], BY[s] - BY[k], BZ[s] - BZ[k]
						local reach = BR[s] + BR[k] + margin
						if dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz < reach * reach then
							local a, b = o, c
							if k < s then a, b = c, o end
							local before = C.n
							if P then P.narrow = P.narrow + 1 end
							if a.shape == 1 then
								if b.shape == 1 then boxBox(a, b, margin)
								else capsuleBox(b, a, margin) end
							else
								if b.shape == 1 then capsuleBox(a, b, margin)
								else capsuleCapsule(a, b, margin) end
							end
							if C.n > before then
								epoch = epoch + 1
								c.awake = true
								c.everAwake = true
								c.sleepTime = 0
								c.vz = c.vz - g * dt
								c.groundImpulse = 0
								c.wokeStep = stamp
								AW[k] = true
								local vx, vy, vz, wx, wy, wz = c.vx, c.vy, c.vz, c.wx, c.wy, c.wz
								SPD[k] = sqrt(vx * vx + vy * vy + vz * vz) + sqrt(wx * wx + wy * wy + wz * wz) * c.radius
								nWoke = nWoke + 1
								WK[nWoke] = k
								WLO[nWoke] = nb + 1
								WT[k] = (nb + 1) * (nb + 1)
								WPOS[k] = nWoke
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			q = q + 1
		end
	end
	if P then local now = pc(); P.pairs = P.pairs + now - pt; pt = now end
	local nPair = C.n
	for i = 1, nb do
		local b = bodies[i]
		if b.awake then
			local nvz = -b.vz
			if nvz < 0 then nvz = 0 end
			local wx, wy, wz = b.wx, b.wy, b.wz
			local margin = tmargin + nvz * dt + sqrt(wx * wx + wy * wy + wz * wz) * b.radius * dt
			if b.shape == 1 then groundBox(b, margin) else groundCapsule(b, margin) end
		end
	end
	if P then local now = pc(); P.ground = P.ground + now - pt; pt = now end
	local n = C.n
	w.contacts = n

	-- 3. prepare: one record per contact with an awake body
	local slop, pushRate, maxPush = t.slop, t.pushRate, t.maxPush
	local warmF, pairMu, pairE = t.warm, t.pairMu, t.pairE
	local warm = false
	local m = 0
	for i = 1, n do
		local a, b = cA[i], cB[i]
		local nx, ny, nz = cNx[i], cNy[i], cNz[i]
		if not a.awake then
			-- A is asleep: if B is awake, make B the dynamic side
			if b and b.awake then
				a, b = b, a
				nx, ny, nz = -nx, -ny, -nz
			else
				a = nil
			end
		end
		if a and b and not b.awake then b = false end
		if a then
			m = m + 1
			local r = REC[m]
			if not r then r = {}; REC[m] = r end
			r[K_A], r[K_B], r[K_IDX] = a, b, i
			a.cStep = stamp
			if b then b.cStep = stamp end
			local px, py, pz = cPx[i], cPy[i], cPz[i]
			local ax, ay, az = a.x, a.y, a.z
			local rax, ray, raz = px - ax, py - ay, pz - az
			local ima = a.im
			local i11, i12, i13, i22, i23, i33 = a.i11, a.i12, a.i13, a.i22, a.i23, a.i33
			local avx, avy, avz, awx, awy, awz = a.vx, a.vy, a.vz, a.wx, a.wy, a.wz
			local sep = cSep[i]
			local bias, relax
			if sep > 0 then
				bias, relax = -sep * invDt, -sep * invDt
			elseif sep < -slop then
				bias = pushRate * (-sep - slop) * invDt
				if bias > maxPush then bias = maxPush end
				relax = 0
			else
				bias, relax = 0, 0
			end
			r[K_BIAS], r[K_RELAX] = bias, relax
			r[K_LT1], r[K_LT2] = 0, 0
			r[K_LNMAX] = 0
			if i > nPair then
				-- the ground: n = +z, t1 = +x, t2 = +y. (ra x d) and I^-1 (ra x d)
				-- with the zero terms left out.
				r[K_KIND] = 1
				r[K_NX], r[K_NY], r[K_NZ] = 0, 0, 1
				r[K_T1X], r[K_T1Y], r[K_T1Z], r[K_T2X], r[K_T2Y], r[K_T2Z] = 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0
				-- n: j = (ray, -rax, 0)
				local jx, jy = ray, -rax
				local wx, wy, wz = i11 * jx + i12 * jy, i12 * jx + i22 * jy, i13 * jx + i23 * jy
				r[K_ANX], r[K_ANY], r[K_ANZ], r[K_WANX], r[K_WANY], r[K_WANZ] = jx, jy, 0, wx, wy, wz
				local kn = ima + (jx * wx + jy * wy)
				-- t1: j = (0, raz, -ray)
				jy = raz
				local jz = -ray
				wx, wy, wz = i12 * jy + i13 * jz, i22 * jy + i23 * jz, i23 * jy + i33 * jz
				r[K_A1X], r[K_A1Y], r[K_A1Z], r[K_WA1X], r[K_WA1Y], r[K_WA1Z] = 0, jy, jz, wx, wy, wz
				local k1 = ima + (jy * wy + jz * wz)
				-- t2: j = (-raz, 0, rax)
				jx, jz = -raz, rax
				wx, wy, wz = i11 * jx + i13 * jz, i12 * jx + i23 * jz, i13 * jx + i33 * jz
				r[K_A2X], r[K_A2Y], r[K_A2Z], r[K_WA2X], r[K_WA2Y], r[K_WA2Z] = jx, 0, jz, wx, wy, wz
				local k2 = ima + (jx * wx + jz * wz)
				local mn = 1 / kn
				r[K_MN], r[K_MT1], r[K_MT2] = mn, 1 / k1, 1 / k2
				local anx, any = r[K_ANX], r[K_ANY]
				local v0 = avz + awx * anx + awy * any
				r[K_V0] = v0
				if v0 < -t.restitutionSpeed then a.impact = stamp end
				-- surface friction and bounce, dig, warm start
				local k = cSlot[i]
				local mu, e = surf.mu, surf.e
				local dig, bite
				local biteVar = 0
				local sx, sy = 0, 0
				local ln, l1, l2 = 0, 0, 0
				if a.gStamp[k] == stamp - 1 then
					dig = a.gDig[k]
					-- the bite weakens as the edge works the turf loose
					if a.gN[k] > 0 then bite = a.gBite[k] * biteFade end
					ln, l1, l2 = a.gN[k] * warmF, a.gT1[k] * warmF, a.gT2[k] * warmF
				else
					-- a new contact: how steeply and how fast did it arrive?
					dig = 0
					-- the ground texture: this patch's values (a hash of the
					-- patch and the throw's seed; five numbers in -1..1)
					local tex = surf.texture
					local u1, u2, u3, u4, u5 = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
					if tex then
						-- (math.floor: a true integer; // leaves a float, which the
						-- device's 32-bit Lua will not take into & and >>)
						local cx, cy = floor(px / tex.cell), floor(py / tex.cell)
						local hh = (cx * 0x1B873593 + cy * 0x5BD1E995 + w.groundSeed) & 0xffffffff
						hh = ((hh ~ (hh >> 15)) * 0x2C1B3C6D) & 0xffffffff
						hh = ((hh ~ (hh >> 12)) * 0x297A2D39) & 0xffffffff
						hh = hh ~ (hh >> 15)
						local h2 = ((hh * 0x85EBCA6B) & 0xffffffff) ~ (hh >> 13)
						u1, u2, u3 = (hh & 1023) / 511.5 - 1, ((hh >> 10) & 1023) / 511.5 - 1, ((hh >> 20) & 1023) / 511.5 - 1
						u4, u5 = (h2 & 1023) / 511.5 - 1, ((h2 >> 10) & 1023) / 511.5 - 1
						biteVar = u3
						a.gMf[k], a.gEf[k] = 1 + tex.muVar * u1, 1 + tex.eVar * u2
						-- a bump: the patch is tilted a few degrees (slope up to bump
						-- each way), and a landing faster than bumpSpeed meets it: its
						-- push that step is along the tilted normal (below), so it is
						-- turned, and nothing is added (the ground stays the plane z = 0)
						-- (the slope is scaled by how steeply it comes in: a low
						-- skidding drill barely feels it, a baton dropping end first does)
						if v0 < -tex.bumpSpeed then
							local vt1 = avx + awy * raz - awz * ray
							local vt2 = avy + awz * rax - awx * raz
							local steep = -v0 / sqrt(v0 * v0 + vt1 * vt1 + vt2 * vt2)
							steep = tex.bump * steep * steep
							sx, sy = steep * u4, steep * u5
						end
					else
						a.gMf[k], a.gEf[k] = 1, 1
					end
					if v0 < -surf.digSpeed and surf.dig > 0 then
						local vt1 = avx + awy * raz - awz * ray
						local vt2 = avy + awz * rax - awx * raz
						local steep = -v0 / sqrt(v0 * v0 + vt1 * vt1 + vt2 * vt2)
						local ramp = (-v0 - surf.digSpeed) / surf.digRamp
						if ramp > 1 then ramp = 1 end
						dig = surf.dig * steep * ramp * pointed(a)
						if tex then dig = dig * (1 + tex.digVar * u3) end
						local lever = surf.digLever * min(1, dig)
						if lever > a.dig then a.dig = lever end
					end
				end
				if not bite then
					-- the turf's bite: an edge or corner that strikes the turf cuts
					-- into it and is held sideways by the turf around it, not only by
					-- sliding friction (an extra friction coefficient), until it works
					-- loose: it catches a spinning kubb's edge and turns the kubb about
					-- it, where a hard floor lets the edge skate. Judged like the dig,
					-- by the edge's own arrival (v0, spin included) and how steep it
					-- is (an edge skimming in cuts the turf less), when the contact
					-- first presses (one made ahead of the touch waits for it).
					bite = 0
					if surf.bite and v0 < -surf.digSpeed then
						local vt1 = avx + awy * raz - awz * ray
						local vt2 = avy + awz * rax - awx * raz
						local steep = -v0 / sqrt(v0 * v0 + vt1 * vt1 + vt2 * vt2)
						local ramp = (-v0 - surf.digSpeed) / surf.digRamp
						if ramp > 1 then ramp = 1 end
						bite = surf.bite * ramp * pointed(a) * steep
						if surf.texture then bite = bite * (1 + surf.texture.digVar * biteVar) end
					end
				end
				a.gDig[k], a.gBite[k] = dig, bite
				r[K_MU] = mu * (1 + dig) * a.gMf[k] + bite
				local ef = 1 - dig
				if ef < 0 then ef = 0 end
				r[K_E] = e * ef * a.gEf[k]
				r[K_LN], r[K_LT1], r[K_LT2] = ln, l1, l2
				-- (the warm start, last step's impulses, is applied once every
				-- contact is built, below)
				if ln > 0 or l1 ~= 0 or l2 ~= 0 then
					warm = true
				elseif sx ~= 0 or sy ~= 0 then
					-- a landing on a tilted patch (new, so nothing to warm start): this
					-- step's contact takes the patch's normal, as a contact with a
					-- static body does (kind 4: solved as kind 3, stored as the ground)
					r[K_KIND] = 4
					local l = 1 / sqrt(sx * sx + sy * sy + 1)
					local nx, ny, nz = -sx * l, -sy * l, l
					r[K_NX], r[K_NY], r[K_NZ] = nx, ny, nz
					-- tangents (nx is small: t1 = (0, nz, -ny), t2 = n x t1)
					l = 1 / sqrt(nz * nz + ny * ny)
					local t1x, t1y, t1z = 0, nz * l, -ny * l
					local t2x, t2y, t2z = ny * t1z - nz * t1y, nz * t1x - nx * t1z, nx * t1y - ny * t1x
					r[K_T1X], r[K_T1Y], r[K_T1Z], r[K_T2X], r[K_T2Y], r[K_T2Z] = t1x, t1y, t1z, t2x, t2y, t2z
					local jx, jy, jz = ray * nz - raz * ny, raz * nx - rax * nz, rax * ny - ray * nx
					local wx = i11 * jx + i12 * jy + i13 * jz
					local wy = i12 * jx + i22 * jy + i23 * jz
					local wz = i13 * jx + i23 * jy + i33 * jz
					r[K_ANX], r[K_ANY], r[K_ANZ], r[K_WANX], r[K_WANY], r[K_WANZ] = jx, jy, jz, wx, wy, wz
					local kn = ima + (jx * wx + jy * wy + jz * wz)
					jx, jy, jz = ray * t1z - raz * t1y, raz * t1x - rax * t1z, rax * t1y - ray * t1x
					wx = i11 * jx + i12 * jy + i13 * jz
					wy = i12 * jx + i22 * jy + i23 * jz
					wz = i13 * jx + i23 * jy + i33 * jz
					r[K_A1X], r[K_A1Y], r[K_A1Z], r[K_WA1X], r[K_WA1Y], r[K_WA1Z] = jx, jy, jz, wx, wy, wz
					local k1 = ima + (jx * wx + jy * wy + jz * wz)
					jx, jy, jz = ray * t2z - raz * t2y, raz * t2x - rax * t2z, rax * t2y - ray * t2x
					wx = i11 * jx + i12 * jy + i13 * jz
					wy = i12 * jx + i22 * jy + i23 * jz
					wz = i13 * jx + i23 * jy + i33 * jz
					r[K_A2X], r[K_A2Y], r[K_A2Z], r[K_WA2X], r[K_WA2Y], r[K_WA2Z] = jx, jy, jz, wx, wy, wz
					local k2 = ima + (jx * wx + jy * wy + jz * wz)
					r[K_MN], r[K_MT1], r[K_MT2] = 1 / kn, 1 / k1, 1 / k2
					r[K_V0] = avx * nx + avy * ny + avz * nz + awx * r[K_ANX] + awy * r[K_ANY] + awz * r[K_ANZ]
				end
			else
				r[K_NX], r[K_NY], r[K_NZ] = nx, ny, nz
				-- tangents
				local t1x, t1y, t1z
				if nx < 0.57 and nx > -0.57 then
					t1x, t1y, t1z = 0, nz, -ny
				else
					t1x, t1y, t1z = nz, 0, -nx
				end
				local l = 1 / sqrt(t1x * t1x + t1y * t1y + t1z * t1z)
				t1x, t1y, t1z = t1x * l, t1y * l, t1z * l
				local t2x, t2y, t2z = ny * t1z - nz * t1y, nz * t1x - nx * t1z, nx * t1y - ny * t1x
				r[K_T1X], r[K_T1Y], r[K_T1Z], r[K_T2X], r[K_T2Y], r[K_T2Z] = t1x, t1y, t1z, t2x, t2y, t2z
				-- A's angular terms for n, t1, t2
				local jx, jy, jz = ray * nz - raz * ny, raz * nx - rax * nz, rax * ny - ray * nx
				local wx = i11 * jx + i12 * jy + i13 * jz
				local wy = i12 * jx + i22 * jy + i23 * jz
				local wz = i13 * jx + i23 * jy + i33 * jz
				r[K_ANX], r[K_ANY], r[K_ANZ], r[K_WANX], r[K_WANY], r[K_WANZ] = jx, jy, jz, wx, wy, wz
				local kn = ima + (jx * wx + jy * wy + jz * wz)
				jx, jy, jz = ray * t1z - raz * t1y, raz * t1x - rax * t1z, rax * t1y - ray * t1x
				wx = i11 * jx + i12 * jy + i13 * jz
				wy = i12 * jx + i22 * jy + i23 * jz
				wz = i13 * jx + i23 * jy + i33 * jz
				r[K_A1X], r[K_A1Y], r[K_A1Z], r[K_WA1X], r[K_WA1Y], r[K_WA1Z] = jx, jy, jz, wx, wy, wz
				local k1 = ima + (jx * wx + jy * wy + jz * wz)
				jx, jy, jz = ray * t2z - raz * t2y, raz * t2x - rax * t2z, rax * t2y - ray * t2x
				wx = i11 * jx + i12 * jy + i13 * jz
				wy = i12 * jx + i22 * jy + i23 * jz
				wz = i13 * jx + i23 * jy + i33 * jz
				r[K_A2X], r[K_A2Y], r[K_A2Z], r[K_WA2X], r[K_WA2Y], r[K_WA2Z] = jx, jy, jz, wx, wy, wz
				local k2 = ima + (jx * wx + jy * wy + jz * wz)
				local v0 = avx * nx + avy * ny + avz * nz
					+ awx * r[K_ANX] + awy * r[K_ANY] + awz * r[K_ANZ]
				if b then
					r[K_KIND] = 2
					local imb = b.im
					local j11, j12, j13, j22, j23, j33 = b.i11, b.i12, b.i13, b.i22, b.i23, b.i33
					-- B's arm reaches B's own surface: P is on A, and a contact made
					-- ahead of the touch (sep > 0) meets B sep along the normal
					-- short of it. (Along n it moves no normal impulse's torque, only
					-- friction's: the baton's drag down a kubb's face, levered from
					-- the baton's side of the gap, held the kubb back from tipping.)
					local rbx, rby, rbz = px - nx * sep - b.x, py - ny * sep - b.y, pz - nz * sep - b.z
					kn, k1, k2 = kn + imb, k1 + imb, k2 + imb
					jx, jy, jz = rby * nz - rbz * ny, rbz * nx - rbx * nz, rbx * ny - rby * nx
					wx = j11 * jx + j12 * jy + j13 * jz
					wy = j12 * jx + j22 * jy + j23 * jz
					wz = j13 * jx + j23 * jy + j33 * jz
					r[K_BNX], r[K_BNY], r[K_BNZ], r[K_WBNX], r[K_WBNY], r[K_WBNZ] = jx, jy, jz, wx, wy, wz
					kn = kn + (jx * wx + jy * wy + jz * wz)
					jx, jy, jz = rby * t1z - rbz * t1y, rbz * t1x - rbx * t1z, rbx * t1y - rby * t1x
					wx = j11 * jx + j12 * jy + j13 * jz
					wy = j12 * jx + j22 * jy + j23 * jz
					wz = j13 * jx + j23 * jy + j33 * jz
					r[K_B1X], r[K_B1Y], r[K_B1Z], r[K_WB1X], r[K_WB1Y], r[K_WB1Z] = jx, jy, jz, wx, wy, wz
					k1 = k1 + (jx * wx + jy * wy + jz * wz)
					jx, jy, jz = rby * t2z - rbz * t2y, rbz * t2x - rbx * t2z, rbx * t2y - rby * t2x
					wx = j11 * jx + j12 * jy + j13 * jz
					wy = j12 * jx + j22 * jy + j23 * jz
					wz = j13 * jx + j23 * jy + j33 * jz
					r[K_B2X], r[K_B2Y], r[K_B2Z], r[K_WB2X], r[K_WB2Y], r[K_WB2Z] = jx, jy, jz, wx, wy, wz
					k2 = k2 + (jx * wx + jy * wy + jz * wz)
					v0 = v0 - (b.vx * nx + b.vy * ny + b.vz * nz)
						- (b.wx * r[K_BNX] + b.wy * r[K_BNY] + b.wz * r[K_BNZ])
				else
					r[K_KIND] = 3
				end
				r[K_MN], r[K_MT1], r[K_MT2] = 1 / kn, 1 / k1, 1 / k2
				r[K_V0] = v0
				r[K_MU], r[K_E] = pairMu, pairE
				r[K_LN] = 0
			end
		end
	end
	nRec = m
	-- warm start the ground contacts (n = +z, t1 = +x, t2 = +y), after every
	-- contact has taken its approach speed (v0) from the velocities the step
	-- began with: applied as each was built, a piece's later corners read its
	-- speed with its earlier corners' warm start in it, and after a hard
	-- landing (last step's impulses, the bounce's among them, are large) a
	-- corner at rest read an approach of metres a second and was given a
	-- bounce off it (docs/notes/physics.md, "Physics", "The bounce reaches the row")
	if warm then
		for i = 1, m do
			local r = REC[i]
			if r[K_KIND] == 1 then
				local ln, l1, l2 = r[K_LN], r[K_LT1], r[K_LT2]
				if ln > 0 or l1 ~= 0 or l2 ~= 0 then
					local a = r[K_A]
					local ima = a.im
					a.vx, a.vy, a.vz = a.vx + ima * l1, a.vy + ima * l2, a.vz + ima * ln
					a.wx = a.wx + ln * r[K_WANX] + l1 * r[K_WA1X] + l2 * r[K_WA2X]
					a.wy = a.wy + ln * r[K_WANY] + l1 * r[K_WA1Y] + l2 * r[K_WA2Y]
					a.wz = a.wz + ln * r[K_WANZ] + l1 * r[K_WA1Z] + l2 * r[K_WA2Z]
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if P then local now = pc(); P.prepare = P.prepare + now - pt; pt = now end
	-- 4. solve with the push bias
	for _ = 1, t.iterations do solve(K_BIAS, REC, m) end

	if P then local now = pc(); P.solve = P.solve + now - pt; pt = now end
	-- 5. integrate positions (quaternion step, normalize, rotation matrix and
	-- world inverse inertia: quat.integrate and body.updateDerived written out).
	-- A body with no contact this step moves by the mean of its velocity
	-- before and after the forces (the trapezoid: exact for gravity, and what
	-- flight.carry's midpoint steps do), so a throw flies as far as the aim
	-- says; the semi-implicit move (the velocity after) dropped g dt t / 2 and
	-- came down 2 to 3 cm short. A body in contact moves by its solved
	-- velocity, so a piece at rest stays put.
	local h = 0.5 * dt
	for i = 1, nb do
		local b = bodies[i]
		if b.awake then
			if b.cStep == stamp then
				b.x, b.y, b.z = b.x + b.vx * dt, b.y + b.vy * dt, b.z + b.vz * dt
			else
				b.x, b.y, b.z = b.x + (OVX[i] + b.vx) * h, b.y + (OVY[i] + b.vy) * h, b.z + (OVZ[i] + b.vz) * h
			end
			if inAir and b == proj and b.aeroK and b.cStep ~= stamp then
				-- the thrown piece in flight: its turn in substeps (flightTurn)
				flightTurn(w, b, dt, t.flightTurns, useGyro)
			else
				local qw, qx, qy, qz = b.qw, b.qx, b.qy, b.qz
				local wx, wy, wz = b.wx, b.wy, b.wz
				local dw = -(wx * qx + wy * qy + wz * qz)
				local dx = wx * qw + wy * qz - wz * qy
				local dy = wy * qw + wz * qx - wx * qz
				local dz = wz * qw + wx * qy - wy * qx
				qw, qx, qy, qz = qw + h * dw, qx + h * dx, qy + h * dy, qz + h * dz
				local qn = sqrt(qw * qw + qx * qx + qy * qy + qz * qz)
				if qn < 1e-12 then
					qw, qx, qy, qz = 1, 0, 0, 0
				else
					qn = 1 / qn
					qw, qx, qy, qz = qw * qn, qx * qn, qy * qn, qz * qn
				end
				b.qw, b.qx, b.qy, b.qz = qw, qx, qy, qz
				local xx, yy, zz = qx * qx, qy * qy, qz * qz
				local xy, xz, yz = qx * qy, qx * qz, qy * qz
				local xw, yw, zw = qw * qx, qw * qy, qw * qz
				local r11, r12, r13 = 1 - 2 * (yy + zz), 2 * (xy - zw), 2 * (xz + yw)
				local r21, r22, r23 = 2 * (xy + zw), 1 - 2 * (xx + zz), 2 * (yz - xw)
				local r31, r32, r33 = 2 * (xz - yw), 2 * (yz + xw), 1 - 2 * (xx + yy)
				b.r11, b.r12, b.r13, b.r21, b.r22, b.r23, b.r31, b.r32, b.r33 = r11, r12, r13, r21, r22, r23, r31, r32, r33
				local ia, ic, ie = b.iIx, b.iIy, b.iIz
				b.i11 = r11 * r11 * ia + r12 * r12 * ic + r13 * r13 * ie
				b.i12 = r11 * r21 * ia + r12 * r22 * ic + r13 * r23 * ie
				b.i13 = r11 * r31 * ia + r12 * r32 * ic + r13 * r33 * ie
				b.i22 = r21 * r21 * ia + r22 * r22 * ic + r23 * r23 * ie
				b.i23 = r21 * r31 * ia + r22 * r32 * ic + r23 * r33 * ie
				b.i33 = r31 * r31 * ia + r32 * r32 * ic + r33 * r33 * ie
			end
		end
	end

	if P then local now = pc(); P.integrate = P.integrate + now - pt; pt = now end
	-- 6. relax: remove the push-apart speed
	for _ = 1, t.relaxIterations do solve(K_RELAX, REC, m) end

	if P then local now = pc(); P.relax = P.relax + now - pt; pt = now end
	-- 7. restitution, the bounce of each contact that arrived faster than
	-- restitutionSpeed and pressed this step: the target is -e times its
	-- approach speed before the solve (v0). (Several passes: a box landing
	-- flat has four corners, and one pass in order over them tips it and
	-- overshoots the bounce.) A bounce between two pieces is solved together
	-- with every other contact of those pieces that pressed this step (their
	-- footing on the ground, a neighbour), held to the target they had in the
	-- relax pass: applied alone, a baton's bounce off a standing kubb drove
	-- the kubb into the ground and the ground threw it up the next step.
	-- Friction is solved in these passes too, capped at mu times the
	-- contact's whole normal impulse (the push, the relax and the bounce):
	-- in the bias passes a speculative contact's impulse only takes the
	-- approach speed past the gap still to close, so a landing kept 0.6 to
	-- 0.9 of its ground speed, and how much depended on where the step fell
	-- (docs/notes/physics.md, "Physics", "Friction in the bounce").
	-- The bounce reaches the whole group of awake pieces pressed together,
	-- not only the pieces that bounce: a baton striking the front of a row
	-- of touching kubbs strikes the row, and with the bounce cut off at the
	-- front kubb's own contacts the second kubb was free in these passes, so
	-- the front two took the blow as a light pair, met the third a step later
	-- and stopped (docs/notes/physics.md, "Physics", "The bounce reaches the row"). When
	-- it reaches past the pieces that bounce (a row), the passes run until
	-- the impulses settle (restitutionTol), up to restitutionMaxIterations:
	-- each pass carries the push one kubb further, and four left it short
	-- of the far kubbs. Any other bounce keeps restitutionIterations: run to
	-- the limit there, a sliding contact's friction and its push fed each
	-- other pass after pass (a spinning baton's corner swung between all of
	-- its bounce and none), and the fuzz's energy rises went from 5 to 24.
	local rs = t.restitutionSpeed
	local any, pair, row = false, false, false
	for i = 1, m do
		local r = REC[i]
		if r[K_V0] < -rs and r[K_LNMAX] > 0 and r[K_E] > 0 then
			any = true
			local kind = r[K_KIND]
			if kind ~= 1 then
				pair = true
				r[K_A].bounceStep = stamp
				if kind == 2 then r[K_B].bounceStep = stamp end
			end
		end
	end
	if pair then
		-- spread the mark through every pressing contact between two awake
		-- pieces (a row of n needs n passes; usually one finds nothing new)
		local grew = true
		while grew do
			grew = false
			for i = 1, m do
				local r = REC[i]
				if r[K_KIND] == 2 and r[K_LNMAX] > 0 then
					local a, b = r[K_A], r[K_B]
					if a.bounceStep == stamp then
						if b.bounceStep ~= stamp then
							b.bounceStep = stamp; b.rowStep = stamp; grew = true; row = true
						end
					elseif b.bounceStep == stamp then
						a.bounceStep = stamp; a.rowStep = stamp; grew = true; row = true
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if row then
			-- the islands that grew: spread rowStep from the pieces the bounce
			-- reached through the same contacts, so only their contacts get the
			-- extra passes (a bounce elsewhere in the step keeps its four)
			grew = true
			while grew do
				grew = false
				for i = 1, m do
					local r = REC[i]
					if r[K_KIND] == 2 and r[K_LNMAX] > 0 then
						local a, b = r[K_A], r[K_B]
						if a.rowStep == stamp then
							if b.rowStep ~= stamp then b.rowStep = stamp; grew = true end
						elseif b.rowStep == stamp then
							a.rowStep = stamp; grew = true
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if any then
		local nb = 0
		for i = 1, m do
			local r = REC[i]
			local v0 = r[K_V0]
			local a, kind = r[K_A], r[K_KIND]
			if v0 < -rs and r[K_LNMAX] > 0 and r[K_E] > 0 then
				nb = nb + 1
				BOUNCE[nb] = r
				r[K_REST] = -r[K_E] * v0
			elseif pair and r[K_LNMAX] > 0 and (a.bounceStep == stamp
				or (kind == 2 and r[K_B].bounceStep == stamp)) then
				nb = nb + 1
				BOUNCE[nb] = r
				r[K_REST] = r[K_RELAX]
			end
		end
		local tol, least, most = t.restitutionTol, t.restitutionIterations, t.restitutionMaxIterations
		if not row then most = least end
		local passes = 0
		-- (restitutionIterations 0 turns the bounce off: a diagnostic, docs/notes/physics.md)
		while least > 0 do
			local dm = solve(K_REST, BOUNCE, nb)
			passes = passes + 1
			if passes >= most or (passes >= least and dm < tol) then break end
			if passes == least and row then
				-- past restitutionIterations only the rows' contacts go on
				local k = 0
				for i = 1, nb do
					local r = BOUNCE[i]
					if r[K_A].rowStep == stamp or (r[K_KIND] == 2 and r[K_B].rowStep == stamp) then
						k = k + 1
						BOUNCE[k] = r
					end
				end
				nb = k
			end
		end
		w.bouncePasses = w.bouncePasses + passes
	end

	if P then local now = pc(); P.restitution = P.restitution + now - pt; pt = now end
	-- 8. store ground impulses; touches
	local proj = w.projectile
	for i = 1, m do
		local r = REC[i]
		local idx = r[K_IDX]
		local kind = r[K_KIND]
		if kind == 1 or kind == 4 then
			local a = r[K_A]
			local k = cSlot[idx]
			local ln = r[K_LN]
			local l1, l2 = r[K_LT1], r[K_LT2]
			if kind == 4 then
				-- (its friction in the ground's x and y, for next step's warm start)
				l1, l2 = l1 * r[K_T1X] + l2 * r[K_T2X], l1 * r[K_T1Y] + l2 * r[K_T2Y]
			end
			a.gStamp[k], a.gN[k], a.gT1[k], a.gT2[k] = stamp, ln, l1, l2
			a.groundImpulse = a.groundImpulse + ln
			if w.onContact and a == proj and r[K_LNMAX] > 0 then
				w.onContact(w.time, a, nil, r[K_LNMAX])
			end
			if r[K_LNMAX] > 0 and a == proj and not w.firstContact then
				noteContact(w, a, nil, cPx[idx], cPy[idx], cPz[idx])
			end
		elseif r[K_LNMAX] > 0 then
			-- what holds a piece up, for its sleep: a sleeping or static piece,
			-- or an awake one (propBy); and an awake piece it presses on is a
			-- mate, whose sleep timer it waits for (the sleep test below)
			local a = r[K_A]
			if kind == 3 then
				a.restStep = stamp
			else
				local b = r[K_B]
				a.propStep, a.propBy = stamp, b
				b.propStep, b.propBy = stamp, a
				local ta, tb = a.sleepTime, b.sleepTime
				if a.mateStep ~= stamp then a.mateStep, a.mateMin = stamp, tb
				elseif tb < a.mateMin then a.mateMin = tb end
				if b.mateStep ~= stamp then b.mateStep, b.mateMin = stamp, ta
				elseif ta < b.mateMin then b.mateMin = ta end
			end
			local other = cB[idx]
			local first = cA[idx]
			if w.onContact then w.onContact(w.time, first, other, r[K_LNMAX]) end
			first.touched, other.touched = true, true
			-- the first moment each body is struck (render/burst: the burst and
			-- knock come at the impact); one test a contact, no arithmetic
			if not first.touchT then first.touchT = w.time end
			if not other.touchT then other.touchT = w.time end
			if proj and not w.firstHit and (first == proj or other == proj) then
				noteContact(w, proj, (first == proj) and other or first, cPx[idx], cPy[idx], cPz[idx])
			end
		end
	end

	if P then local now = pc(); P.store = P.store + now - pt; pt = now end
	-- rolling resistance and dig, then sleep and bookkeeping
	w.time = w.time + dt
	w.steps = stamp + 1
	local sinTopple = sin(rad(t.toppleDeg))
	local half, len, om = t.pitchHalfWidth, t.pitchLength, t.outMargin
	local sleepLin2, sleepAng2, sleepTime = t.sleepLin * t.sleepLin, t.sleepAng * t.sleepAng, t.sleepTime
	for i = 1, nb do
		local b = bodies[i]
		if b.awake then
			local gi = b.groundImpulse
			if gi <= 0 then b.plough = 0 end   -- off the ground: the ploughed snow is left behind
			if gi > 0 then
				-- the ground's push this step, as the turf feels it: all of it,
				-- except in a step where a contact struck (faster than
				-- restitutionSpeed), when only the weight's share: the strike is
				-- taken by the contacts and the dig, and one hard step must not
				-- stop a turn or a slide the plug lets go
				local load = gi
				if b.impact == stamp then
					local wt = b.m * t.g * dt
					if load > wt then load = wt end
				end
				if b.shape == 2 then
					-- a baton: its spin taken in two parts, each held by an angular
					-- impulse (lever times the ground's impulse), never past stopping
					-- that part: its end-over-end turn by the plug (dig) and
					-- batonTurnHold of the rolling resistance (surf.roll), its roll
					-- about the long axis by the plug and all of it. As one vector
					-- (rollResist) a spin with any part along the long axis, where
					-- the baton turns most easily, read as nearly stopped, and a
					-- baton landing on an end lost all of its spin in that step and
					-- went on without turning (Tyler's play test, 2026-11-15:
					-- "gliding"; tools/batonprobe.lua)
					local ux, uy, uz = b.r13, b.r23, b.r33
					local wx, wy, wz = b.wx, b.wy, b.wz
					local wu = wx * ux + wy * uy + wz * uz
					local px, py, pz = wx - wu * ux, wy - wu * uy, wz - wu * uz
					local i11, i12, i13, i22, i23, i33 = b.i11, b.i12, b.i13, b.i22, b.i23, b.i33
					-- (rolling resistance is the turf giving under the ground's push,
					-- `load` above: a landing's turn loss is the plug's)
					local gr = load
					local L = b.dig * gi + t.batonTurnHold * surf.roll * gr
					local p2 = px * px + py * py + pz * pz
					if L > 0 and p2 > 1e-12 then
						local pn = sqrt(p2)
						local ex, ey, ez = px / pn, py / pn, pz / pn
						local ix = i11 * ex + i12 * ey + i13 * ez
						local iy = i12 * ex + i22 * ey + i23 * ez
						local iz = i13 * ex + i23 * ey + i33 * ez
						local stop = pn / (ex * ix + ey * iy + ez * iz)
						if L > stop then L = stop end
						wx, wy, wz = wx - L * ix, wy - L * iy, wz - L * iz
					end
					L = b.dig * gi + surf.roll * gr
					if L > 0 and (wu > 1e-9 or wu < -1e-9) then
						local ix = i11 * ux + i12 * uy + i13 * uz
						local iy = i12 * ux + i22 * uy + i23 * uz
						local iz = i13 * ux + i23 * uy + i33 * uz
						local stop = wu / (ux * ix + uy * iy + uz * iz)
						if stop < 0 then stop = -stop end
						if L > stop then L = stop end
						if wu < 0 then L = -L end
						wx, wy, wz = wx - L * ix, wy - L * iy, wz - L * iz
					end
					b.wx, b.wy, b.wz = wx, wy, wz
				else
					rollResist(b, b.dig, gi)
				end
				local tex = surf.texture
				if tex then
					local r33 = b.r33
					if r33 < 0 then r33 = -r33 end
					local vx, vy = b.vx, b.vy
					local v2 = vx * vx + vy * vy
					if v2 > 1e-8 then
						if r33 > COS_END then
							-- a piece standing on an end and sliding on snow (a kubb, the
							-- king, a baton): its foot sinks into the snow and ploughs it,
							-- a resistance at the foot against the slip of the point under
							-- its centre, no more than footMu times the ground's push this
							-- step (Coulomb, like the corners' friction) and never past
							-- stopping the slip, so it slows the piece and tips it the way
							-- it is going. Elsewhere the friction at the foot alone tips a
							-- piece sliding on an end (a baton's trip, a spin added with
							-- nothing pushed back, went 2026-11-16)
							local fm = tex.footMu
							if fm then
								local h = b.z
								local wx, wy = b.wx, b.wy
								local sx, sy = vx - h * wy, vy + h * wx
								local s2 = sx * sx + sy * sy
								if s2 > tex.footSpeed * tex.footSpeed then
									local im = b.im
									local jx = -sx / (im + h * h * b.i22)
									local jy = -sy / (im + h * h * b.i11)
									local j2 = jx * jx + jy * jy
									local cap = fm * gi
									if j2 > cap * cap then
										local f = cap / sqrt(j2)
										jx, jy = jx * f, jy * f
									end
									-- r = (0, 0, -h): r x J = (h jy, -h jx, 0)
									local tx, ty = h * jy, -h * jx
									b.vx, b.vy = vx + im * jx, vy + im * jy
									b.wx = wx + b.i11 * tx + b.i12 * ty
									b.wy = wy + b.i12 * tx + b.i22 * ty
									b.wz = b.wz + b.i13 * tx + b.i23 * ty
								end
							end
						elseif b.shape == 2 or r33 < 0.5 then
							-- a baton or a lying piece on grass: the blades hold it,
							-- harder once it is slow, so it stops instead of creeping
							-- (in snow, harder the farther it has ploughed)
							-- (in proportion to how hard it presses: its full weight on
							-- the ground gives the rates in full, a baton propped on a
							-- kubb with one end in the grass less; a harder push, a
							-- landing or a pivot, is the corners' friction's, not more)
							local f = tex.drag
							if v2 < tex.gripSpeed * tex.gripSpeed then f = f + tex.grip end
							local pl = tex.plough
							if pl then
								local d = b.plough + sqrt(v2) * dt
								b.plough = d
								f = f + pl * d
							end
							local share = load / (b.m * t.g * dt)
							if share > 1 then share = 1 end
							f = 1 - f * share * dt
							if f < 0 then f = 0 end
							b.vx, b.vy = vx * f, vy * f
							b.wx, b.wy, b.wz = b.wx * f, b.wy * f, b.wz * f
						end
					end
				end
			end
			if b.dig > 0 then
				b.dig = b.dig * exp(-dt / surf.digTime)
				if b.dig < 1e-5 then b.dig = 0 end
			end
			local r33 = b.r33
			if b.shape == 1 and not b.toppled and r33 <= sinTopple and r33 >= -sinTopple then b.toppled = true; b.toppleT = w.time end
			local x, y = b.x, b.y
			if x > half + om or x < -(half + om) or y < -om or y > len + om then b.leftPitch = true end
			local vx, vy, vz, wx, wy, wz = b.vx, b.vy, b.vz, b.wx, b.wy, b.wz
			-- held up: by the ground, by a sleeping or static piece, or by an
			-- awake piece that is itself held up that way (a kubb lying on a
			-- kubb never touches the ground; Physics fuzz, 2026-11-16)
			local held = gi > 0 or b.restStep == stamp
			if not held and b.propStep == stamp then
				local p = b.propBy
				held = not p.awake or p.groundImpulse > 0 or p.restStep == stamp
			end
			if vx * vx + vy * vy + vz * vz < sleepLin2 and wx * wx + wy * wy + wz * wz < sleepAng2 and held then
				local st = b.sleepTime + dt
				b.sleepTime = st
				-- an awake piece it presses on that is still settling holds it
				-- awake until both are ready, so they sleep in the same step: one
				-- that slept first left the other its weight's worth of warm
				-- started push from the ground, which kicked it and woke the
				-- sleeper again (a leaner woke 20 times, 1:14364)
				local ready = st >= sleepTime
				if ready and b.mateStep == stamp and b.mateMin > 0
					and b.mateMin + dt < sleepTime then ready = false end
				if ready then
					epoch = epoch + 1
					b.awake = false
					b.vx, b.vy, b.vz, b.wx, b.wy, b.wz = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
					b.dig = 0
					-- the leaner rule: a piece that comes to rest propped on another is
					-- down if it would fall with the prop taken away
					if b.shape == 1 and not b.toppled and body.wouldFall(b) then b.toppled = true; b.toppleT = w.time end
				end
			else
				b.sleepTime = 0
			end
		end
	end
	if P then local now = pc(); P.tail = P.tail + now - pt end
	return w
end


-- Everything asleep (or the throw ran past tune.maxTime).
function world.isAtRest(w)
	if w.time >= world.tune.maxTime then return true end
	-- the body found awake last time is the likely one (the projectile is
	-- added last, so the plain scan would walk past every sleeper first)
	local bodies = w.bodies
	local h = w.awakeHint
	if h and bodies[h] and bodies[h].awake then return false end
	for i = 1, w.n do
		if bodies[i].awake then
			w.awakeHint = i
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

-- Step until at rest or for at most `seconds` more.
function world.run(w, seconds)
	local stop = w.time + (seconds or world.tune.maxTime)
	while not world.isAtRest(w) and w.time < stop - 1e-9 do world.step(w) end
	return w
end

-- Is the center outside the pitch (beyond tune.outMargin)?
function world.outside(x, y)
	local t = world.tune
	return abs(x) > t.pitchHalfWidth + t.outMargin or y < -t.outMargin or y > t.pitchLength + t.outMargin
end

-- The outcome of the throw:
--   time, steps           simulated time and steps
--   touched               ids of bodies something touched (the projectile included)
--   stakesTouched         ids of stakes something touched (stake1 .. stake6, core/pitch order)
--   toppled               ids of kubbs and kings that toppled in this throw
--   kingToppled           true if a king toppled
--   outNotToppled         ids of kubbs that ended outside the pitch without toppling
--   bodies[id]            {kind, x, y, z, qw, qx, qy, qz, toppled, touched, out, leftPitch}
--   firstContact, firstHit  the projectile's first contact (any) and first body hit
function world.result(w)
	local r = {
		time = w.time, steps = w.steps,
		touched = {}, toppled = {}, outNotToppled = {}, kingToppled = false,
		stakesTouched = {},
		bodies = {},
		firstContact = w.firstContact, firstHit = w.firstHit,
	}
	for i = 1, w.n do
		local b = w.bodies[i]
		-- a piece still moving when the throw ran out of time gets the leaner rule here
		if b.shape == 1 and not b.static and not b.toppled and body.wouldFall(b) then b.toppled = true; b.toppleT = w.time end
		local out = world.outside(b.x, b.y)
		r.bodies[b.id] = {
			kind = b.kind, x = b.x, y = b.y, z = b.z, qw = b.qw, qx = b.qx, qy = b.qy, qz = b.qz,
			toppled = b.toppled, touched = b.touched, out = out, leftPitch = b.leftPitch,
		}
		if b.touched then
			if b.static then r.stakesTouched[#r.stakesTouched + 1] = b.id
			else r.touched[#r.touched + 1] = b.id end
		end
		if b.shape == 1 and b.toppled and not b.wasToppled and b ~= w.projectile then
			r.toppled[#r.toppled + 1] = b.id
			if b.kind == "king" then r.kingToppled = true end
		end
		if b.shape == 1 and out and not b.toppled and b ~= w.projectile then
			r.outNotToppled[#r.outNotToppled + 1] = b.id
		end
	end
	return r
end

-- Total energy (kinetic + potential) of all moving bodies, J.
function world.energy(w)
	local e = 0
	for i = 1, w.n do
		local b = w.bodies[i]
		if not b.static then e = e + body.energy(b, world.tune.g) end
	end
	return e
end

tw.world = world
room/api:
-- The room's calls behind the engine's one door (docs/ROOM.md "The calls"):
-- kubbCall("room.<name>", argsJson) -> '{"value": ...}'. Every argument is a named field
-- of one JSON object; the result is always an object with one key, `value` (null where
-- the JavaScript returns undefined or null: a reducer's "change nothing"), so a document
-- that happens to hold a key named `error` is never mistaken for a failure. Arguments are
-- read with json.decode(text, true): nulls, empty objects and empty arrays come back as
-- they were sent, and the result is written by the engine's deterministic encoder.
-- Needs no session, tune or match: a client may call these before or without `new`.
import "core/tw"
import "version"
import "session/json"
import "room/js"
import "room/lobby"
import "room/seats"
import "room/sync"

local json, js, lobby, seats, sync = tw.web.json, tw.room.js, tw.room.lobby, tw.room.seats, tw.room.sync
local object, NULL = json.object, json.null

local R = {}

-- Every constant a client needs, as the JavaScript exports them, and the engine's own.
function R.constants()
	local options = {}
	for i, row in ipairs(lobby.MATCH_OPTIONS) do
		local choices = {}
		for j, c in ipairs(row[3]) do choices[j] = { c[1], c[2] } end
		options[i] = { row[1], row[2], choices }
	end
	local defaults = object {}
	for k, v in pairs(lobby.OPTION_DEFAULTS) do defaults[k] = v end
	return object {
		DOC_VERSION = lobby.DOC_VERSION, TEAM_MAX = lobby.TEAM_MAX, SEATS = lobby.SEATS,
		SIDES = { "A", "B" }, NAME_MAX = lobby.NAME_MAX, OPTION_DEFAULTS = defaults,
		MATCH_OPTIONS = options, LEVELS = { "beginner", "club", "pro" }, LOG_BUDGET = lobby.LOG_BUDGET,
		REPLAY_VERSION = lobby.REPLAY_VERSION, CLIENT = sync.CLIENT, WITH_BYTES = sync.WITH_BYTES,
		ENGINE = lobby.ENGINE,
	}
end

-- lobby.js
function R.cleanOptions(a) return lobby.cleanOptions(a.options) end
function R.optionLabel(a) return lobby.optionLabel(a.key, a.value) end
function R.cleanName(a) return lobby.cleanName(a.name) end
function R.lobbyOf(a) return lobby.lobbyOf(a.doc) end
function R.sideOf(a) return lobby.sideOf(a.doc, a.id) end
function R.joinTeam(a) return lobby.joinTeam(a.doc, a.id, a.side) end
function R.setOptions(a) return lobby.setOptions(a.doc, a.options) end
function R.setAccess(a) return lobby.setAccess(a.doc, a.open) end
function R.openListing(a) return lobby.openListing(a.doc, a.members, a.over) end
function R.pruneTeams(a) return lobby.pruneTeams(a.doc, a.present) end
function R.lineup(a) return lobby.lineup(a.doc, a.members) end
function R.matchOptions(a) return lobby.matchOptions(a.doc, a.lineup, a.seed, a.start) end
function R.startCheck(a) return lobby.startCheck(a.players, a.members, a.host, js.truthy(a.lenient)) end
function R.startMatch(a)
	return lobby.startMatch(a.doc, { snap = a.snap, hash = a.hash, players = a.players, cpu = a.cpu, host = a.host,
		setup = a.setup, members = a.members, lenient = js.truthy(a.lenient) })
end
function R.commitAction(a)
	return lobby.commitAction(a.doc, { n = a.n, seq = a.seq, snap = a.snap, hash = a.hash, action = a.action,
		over = a.over })
end
function R.replayOf(a) return lobby.replayOf(a.match) end
function R.isReplay(a) return lobby.isReplay(a.replay) end
function R.backToLobby(a) return lobby.backToLobby(a.doc, a.n) end
function R.mayPlay(a) return lobby.mayPlay(a.engine, a.match, js.truthy(a.lenient)) end
-- seats.js
function R.teamIds(a) return seats.teamIds(a.ctx, a.side) end
function R.actorsFor(a) return seats.actorsFor(a.need, a.ctx) end
function R.mayAct(a) return seats.mayAct(a.need, a.ctx, a.me) end
function R.shownActor(a) return seats.shownActor(a.need, a.ctx) end
function R.controlFor(a) return seats.controlFor(a.ctx, a.me) end
function R.sameControl(a) return seats.sameControl(a.a, a.b) end
function R.playingSide(a) return seats.playingSide(a.ctx, a.me) end
function R.nextHost(a) return seats.nextHost(a.members, a.host) end
-- sync.js
function R.decide(a) return sync.decide(a["local"], a.doc, a.with, a.mine) end
function R.rider(a) return sync.rider(a.n, a.seq, a.action, a.bytes, a.client, a.engine) end
function R.asciiSize(a) return js.asciiSize(a.value) end

local room = {}
room.calls = R

-- One call: its name (without "room.") and its argument text; returns the result text.
function room.call(name, argText)
	local f = R[name]
	if not f then error("unknown call room." .. tostring(name), 0) end
	local a = (argText and argText ~= "") and json.decode(argText, true) or object {}
	if not json.isObject(a) then
		if json.isArray(a) and next(a) == nil then a = object {} else error("room." .. name .. ": the argument is not an object", 0) end
	end
	local v = f(a)
	if v == nil then v = NULL end
	return json.encode(object { value = v })
end

tw.room = tw.room or {}
tw.room.api = room
room/js:
-- What the room's logic needs of JavaScript's semantics, so room/lobby, room/seats and
-- room/sync decide exactly as the web's src/net modules do on the same JSON (docs/ROOM.md
-- "Values"). Pure Lua 5.4.
--
-- A value read by json.decode(text, true) maps onto JavaScript's: nil is undefined (a
-- missing key), json.null is null, a table marked as an object is an object and any other
-- table an array. On top of that:
--   * truthy(v): JavaScript's truthiness (false, 0, NaN, "", null and undefined are false);
--   * same(a, b): ===, for the values a document holds (tables by identity);
--   * get(t, k): t?.[k] for an object or array; nil for anything else;
--   * text(v): JSON.stringify(v) with object keys sorted (numbers printed as JavaScript
--     prints them: 3 for 3.0, 1e-7, 1e+21), the canonical text a test compares;
--   * asciiSize(v): the web's asciiSize, JSON.stringify(v) with every character above
--     U+007E counted as 6 bytes: the room's size limits (the web's docs/ROOMS.md section 3).
import "core/tw"
import "session/json"

local json = tw.web.json
local NULL = json.null
local fmt, concat, sort, mtype = string.format, table.concat, table.sort, math.type
local floor, huge = math.floor, math.huge

local js = {}

function js.isNull(v) return rawequal(v, NULL) end

function js.truthy(v)
	if v == nil or v == false or rawequal(v, NULL) then return false end
	if type(v) == "number" then return v == v and v ~= 0 end
	if type(v) == "string" then return v ~= "" end
	return true
end

-- a === b for JSON values: numbers by value (3 === 3.0), strings by content, tables by
-- identity, null only to null and undefined only to undefined.
function js.same(a, b)
	if type(a) == "number" and type(b) == "number" then return a == b end
	return rawequal(a, b)
end

-- typeof v === "object" && v !== null (arrays too).
function js.isTable(v) return type(v) == "table" and not rawequal(v, NULL) end

function js.isArray(v) return json.isArray(v) end
function js.isObject(v) return json.isObject(v) end

-- t?.[k]: nil unless t is an object or an array.
function js.get(t, k)
	if type(t) ~= "table" or rawequal(t, NULL) then return nil end
	return t[k]
end

-- Number.isInteger(v)
function js.isInteger(v)
	return type(v) == "number" and v == v and v ~= huge and v ~= -huge and floor(v) == v
end

-- An integral number as a Lua integer where it fits (so it is written 3, not 3.0).
function js.int(v)
	return math.tointeger(v) or v
end

-- Array.prototype.includes, by ===.
function js.includes(list, v)
	if not js.isTable(list) then return false end
	for _, x in ipairs(list) do if js.same(x, v) then return true end end
	return false
end

-- Number(v) for the values a document holds (ToNumber; objects give NaN).
function js.toNumber(v)
	local t = type(v)
	if t == "number" then return v end
	if v == nil then return 0 / 0 end
	if rawequal(v, NULL) then return 0 end
	if t == "boolean" then return v and 1 or 0 end
	if t == "string" then
		local s = v:match("^[%s]*(.-)[%s]*$")
		if s == "" then return 0 end
		if s == "Infinity" or s == "+Infinity" then return huge end
		if s == "-Infinity" then return -huge end
		if s:find("^[-+]?%d*%.?%d*[eE]?[-+]?%d*$") or s:find("^0[xXoObB]%x+$") then
			local n = tonumber(s)
			if n then return n end
		end
		return 0 / 0
	end
	return 0 / 0
end

-- v + 1 and v - 1 as JavaScript computes them (a string + 1 is the string with "1" on).
function js.plus1(v)
	if type(v) == "number" then return v + 1 end
	if type(v) == "string" then return v .. "1" end
	return js.toNumber(v) + 1
end
function js.minus1(v)
	if type(v) == "number" then return v - 1 end
	return js.toNumber(v) - 1
end

-- a < b (numbers, or two strings compared by their characters).
function js.less(a, b)
	if type(a) == "string" and type(b) == "string" then return a < b end
	return js.toNumber(a) < js.toNumber(b)
end

-- ---------- JSON.stringify ----------

-- A number as JavaScript's Number.prototype.toString prints it (ECMA-262 Number::toString):
-- the shortest digits that read back as the same double, in plain notation from 1e-6 up
-- to 1e21, else with an exponent. NaN and the infinities are null in JSON.
local function jsNumber(v)
	if mtype(v) == "integer" then
		if v > -9007199254740992 and v < 9007199254740992 then return fmt("%d", v) end
		v = v + 0.0
	end
	if v ~= v or v == huge or v == -huge then return "null" end
	if v == 0 then return "0" end
	local sign = ""
	if v < 0 then sign, v = "-", -v end
	local s
	for p = 0, 16 do
		s = fmt("%." .. p .. "e", v)
		if tonumber(s) == v then break end
	end
	local m, e = s:match("^([%d%.]+)e([-+]%d+)$")
	local digits = m:gsub("%.", ""):gsub("0+$", "")
	if digits == "" then digits = "0" end
	local k, n = #digits, tonumber(e) + 1
	local out
	if k <= n and n <= 21 then
		out = digits .. string.rep("0", n - k)
	elseif 0 < n and n <= 21 then
		out = digits:sub(1, n) .. "." .. digits:sub(n + 1)
	elseif -6 < n and n <= 0 then
		out = "0." .. string.rep("0", -n) .. digits
	else
		local x = n - 1
		local ex = (x < 0) and ("-" .. -x) or ("+" .. x)
		if k == 1 then out = digits .. "e" .. ex
		else out = digits:sub(1, 1) .. "." .. digits:sub(2) .. "e" .. ex end
	end
	return sign .. out
end
js.number = jsNumber

-- A string as JSON.stringify quotes it: \" \\ \b \f \n \r \t, \u00xx for the other
-- control characters, everything else (DEL and non-ASCII included) as it is.
local SHORT = { ['"'] = '\\"', ["\\"] = "\\\\", ["\b"] = "\\b", ["\f"] = "\\f", ["\n"] = "\\n",
	["\r"] = "\\r", ["\t"] = "\\t" }
local function jsString(s)
	return '"' .. s:gsub('[\0-\31"\\]', function(c) return SHORT[c] or fmt("\\u%04x", c:byte()) end) .. '"'
end
js.string = jsString

local function textTo(v, out, n)
	local t = type(v)
	if v == nil or rawequal(v, NULL) then n = n + 1; out[n] = "null"
	elseif t == "boolean" then n = n + 1; out[n] = v and "true" or "false"
	elseif t == "number" then n = n + 1; out[n] = jsNumber(v)
	elseif t == "string" then n = n + 1; out[n] = jsString(v)
	elseif t == "table" then
		if json.isArray(v) then
			n = n + 1; out[n] = "["
			for i = 1, #v do
				if i > 1 then n = n + 1; out[n] = "," end
				n = textTo(v[i], out, n)
			end
			n = n + 1; out[n] = "]"
		else
			local keys = {}
			for k in pairs(v) do
				if type(k) ~= "string" then error("js: a " .. type(k) .. " key", 0) end
				keys[#keys + 1] = k
			end
			sort(keys)
			n = n + 1; out[n] = "{"
			for i, k in ipairs(keys) do
				if i > 1 then n = n + 1; out[n] = "," end
				n = n + 1; out[n] = jsString(k) .. ":"
				n = textTo(v[k], out, n)
			end
			n = n + 1; out[n] = "}"
		end
	else
		error("js: a " .. t, 0)
	end
	return n
end

-- JSON.stringify(v), keys sorted.
function js.text(v)
	local out = {}
	textTo(v, out, 0)
	return concat(out)
end

-- The web's asciiSize(v) (src/net/sync.js): the characters of JSON.stringify(v), each
-- above U+007E counted 6. The order of keys does not change it.
function js.asciiSize(v)
	local s = js.text(v)
	local n = 0
	for _, cp in utf8.codes(s, true) do n = n + ((cp > 0x7e) and 6 or 1) end
	return n
end

tw.room = tw.room or {}
tw.room.js = js
room/lobby:
-- A shared pitch's document and its reducers (docs/ROOM.md): the web's src/net/lobby.js
-- in Lua, so every client (the web, the iPhone app) writes the room's document the same
-- way. Pure: no clock, no randomness (the host passes its seed and start time in).
--
-- Each reducer takes the room's current document (json.decode(text, true)) and returns
-- the whole new document, or nil to change nothing (the room client then writes nothing).
-- The functions keep the JavaScript names and decide exactly as the JavaScript does on the
-- same JSON, with these differences, each deliberate (docs/ROOM.md "Differences"):
--   * lobbyOf keeps top-level keys it does not know, so a newer client's fields survive
--     an older client's write (the JavaScript drops them);
--   * startMatch writes match.engine, this engine's major.minor, and refuses while a
--     player's engine (their `me.engine`) differs from the host's (startCheck);
--   * replayOf carries match.engine when the match has one;
--   * cleanName never leaves half a character: where the JavaScript's 16-unit cut
--     splits a character beyond U+FFFF, the whole character goes.
import "core/tw"
import "version"
import "session/json"
import "room/js"

local json, js = tw.web.json, tw.room.js
local NULL, object = json.null, json.object
local truthy, same, get, includes = js.truthy, js.same, js.get, js.includes

local lobby = {}

lobby.DOC_VERSION = 1
lobby.TEAM_MAX = 6
-- An open game's places, as the home page's list shows them: both teams full.
lobby.SEATS = 2 * lobby.TEAM_MAX
lobby.SIDES = { "A", "B" }
lobby.NAME_MAX = 16
lobby.LEVELS = { "beginner", "club", "pro" }
-- The most the document may grow to while it carries a replay's log (the room's limit is
-- 256 KB): about 600 actions.
lobby.LOG_BUDGET = 248 * 1024
lobby.REPLAY_VERSION = 1

local OPTION_KEYS = { "surface", "opening", "raising", "wind", "set" }
lobby.OPTION_DEFAULTS = { surface = "grass", opening = "2-4-6", raising = "hand", wind = "off", set = "classic" }

-- The match options the host sets: { key, label, { { value, label }, ... } }, as on the
-- web's solo options card. (Each player's throw level is their own.)
lobby.MATCH_OPTIONS = {
	{ "surface", "Surface", { { "grass", "Grass" }, { "sand", "Sand" }, { "snow", "Snow" } } },
	{ "opening", "Opening", { { "2-4-6", "2-4-6" }, { "six", "Six batons" } } },
	{ "raising", "Raising", { { "hand", "By hand" }, { "auto", "Automatic" } } },
	{ "wind", "Wind", { { "off", "Off" }, { "light", "Light" }, { "strong", "Strong" } } },
	{ "set", "Kubbs", { { "classic", "Classic" }, { "usa", "USA" }, { "sweden", "Sweden" },
		{ "minnesota", "Minnesota" }, { "wisconsin", "Wisconsin" } } },
}

local OPTION_VALUES = {}
for _, row in ipairs(lobby.MATCH_OPTIONS) do
	local vs = {}
	for i, c in ipairs(row[3]) do vs[i] = c[1] end
	OPTION_VALUES[row[1]] = vs
end

-- ---------- the engine's version ----------

-- "major.minor" of a version string ("0.3.1", "0.3", "0.3.1+web"), or nil.
function lobby.majorMinor(v)
	if type(v) ~= "string" then return nil end
	local a, b = v:match("^(%d+)%.(%d+)")
	if not a then return nil end
	return (math.tointeger(tonumber(a)) or a) .. "." .. (math.tointeger(tonumber(b)) or b)
end

-- This engine's major.minor: what START writes as match.engine (docs/VERSIONING.md
-- "Playing together": peers share a match only when these are equal).
lobby.ENGINE = lobby.majorMinor(tw.engine.version)

-- May a member whose engine is `engine` (their me.engine) play `match` (its
-- match.engine)? Major.minor equal. When either is unknown (a web client from before
-- the engine was named, or a match such a client started) it may only when `lenient`.
-- Returns { ok, why = nil | "unknown" | "differs", engine, match }.
function lobby.mayPlay(engine, match, lenient)
	local mine = lobby.majorMinor(engine)
	local theirs = lobby.majorMinor(get(match, "engine"))
	local why = nil
	if engine == nil or rawequal(engine, NULL) or get(match, "engine") == nil or js.isNull(get(match, "engine")) then
		why = (not lenient) and "unknown" or nil
	elseif not mine or not theirs or mine ~= theirs then
		why = "differs"
	end
	return object { ok = why == nil, why = why or NULL, engine = mine or NULL, match = theirs or NULL }
end

-- The lobby-level rule for START: every player but the host (who runs this engine) must
-- name an engine (me.engine) whose major.minor is this engine's. A player without one
-- (an older web client) passes only when `lenient`. `players` is the lineup's, `members`
-- the room's [{ id, me }]. Returns { ok, engine, differ = [ids], unknown = [ids] }.
function lobby.startCheck(players, members, host, lenient)
	local byId = {}
	if js.isTable(members) then
		for _, m in ipairs(members) do
			local id = get(m, "id")
			if id ~= nil then byId[id] = m end
		end
	end
	local differ, unknown = {}, {}
	for _, s in ipairs(lobby.SIDES) do
		local list = get(players, s)
		if js.isTable(list) then
			for _, p in ipairs(list) do
				local id = get(p, "id")
				if not same(id, host) then
					local e = get(get(byId[id], "me"), "engine")
					if e == nil or js.isNull(e) then
						unknown[#unknown + 1] = id
					elseif lobby.majorMinor(e) ~= lobby.ENGINE then
						differ[#differ + 1] = id
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return object { ok = #differ == 0 and (lenient and true or #unknown == 0), engine = lobby.ENGINE,
		differ = differ, unknown = unknown }
end

-- ---------- options and names ----------

-- Only known keys with known values; the rest take the defaults.
function lobby.cleanOptions(o)
	local out = object {}
	for _, k in ipairs(OPTION_KEYS) do
		local v = get(o, k)
		out[k] = includes(OPTION_VALUES[k], v) and v or lobby.OPTION_DEFAULTS[k]
	end
	return out
end

function lobby.optionLabel(key, value)
	for _, row in ipairs(lobby.MATCH_OPTIONS) do
		if same(row[1], key) then
			for _, c in ipairs(row[3]) do if same(c[1], value) then return c[2] end end
		end
	end
	if value == nil then return "undefined" end
	if js.isNull(value) then return "null" end
	if type(value) == "number" then return js.number(value) end
	if type(value) == "boolean" then return tostring(value) end
	if type(value) == "string" then return value end
	return js.text(value)
end

-- JavaScript's \s (and so String.prototype.trim's set).
local SPACE = { [0x09] = true, [0x0a] = true, [0x0b] = true, [0x0c] = true, [0x0d] = true, [0x20] = true,
	[0xa0] = true, [0x1680] = true, [0x2028] = true, [0x2029] = true, [0x202f] = true, [0x205f] = true,
	[0x3000] = true, [0xfeff] = true }
for cp = 0x2000, 0x200a do SPACE[cp] = true end

-- A member's name: runs of white space made one space, trimmed, at most NAME_MAX UTF-16
-- units (JavaScript's slice) without splitting a character. "" for anything but a string.
function lobby.cleanName(name)
	if type(name) ~= "string" then return "" end
	local cps = {}
	local inSpace = false
	for _, cp in utf8.codes(name, true) do
		if SPACE[cp] then
			if not inSpace then cps[#cps + 1] = 0x20 end
			inSpace = true
		else
			cps[#cps + 1] = cp
			inSpace = false
		end
	end
	local i, j = 1, #cps
	while i <= j and cps[i] == 0x20 do i = i + 1 end
	while j >= i and cps[j] == 0x20 do j = j - 1 end
	local out, units = {}, 0
	for k = i, j do
		local u = (cps[k] > 0xffff) and 2 or 1
		if units + u > lobby.NAME_MAX then break end
		units = units + u
		out[#out + 1] = utf8.char(cps[k])
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

-- ---------- the document ----------

local KNOWN = { v = true, teams = true, options = true, open = true, started = true, n = true, match = true }

-- The document as it stands, or a fresh lobby (a room's document is null until someone
-- writes it; an expired room comes back empty too). Unlike the JavaScript, top-level keys
-- it does not know are kept as they are.
function lobby.lobbyOf(doc)
	local d = js.isTable(doc) and doc or {}
	local l = object {}
	if js.isObject(d) then
		for k, v in pairs(d) do
			if type(k) == "string" and not KNOWN[k] then l[k] = v end
		end
	end
	local teams = object { A = {}, B = {} }
	local dt = get(d, "teams")
	for _, s in ipairs(lobby.SIDES) do
		local t = get(dt, s)
		if js.isArray(t) then
			local keep = {}
			for _, x in ipairs(t) do if type(x) == "string" then keep[#keep + 1] = x end end
			teams[s] = keep
		end
	end
	l.v = lobby.DOC_VERSION
	l.teams = teams
	l.options = lobby.cleanOptions(get(d, "options"))
	l.open = get(d, "open") == true
	l.started = truthy(get(d, "started"))
	local n = get(d, "n")
	l.n = js.isInteger(n) and js.int(n) or 0
	local m = get(d, "match")
	l.match = (truthy(m) and js.isTable(m)) and m or NULL
	return l
end

-- Which side a member is on in the lobby, or nil (watching).
function lobby.sideOf(doc, id)
	local l = lobby.lobbyOf(doc)
	for _, s in ipairs(lobby.SIDES) do if includes(l.teams[s], id) then return s end end
	return nil
end

local function without(list, id)
	local out = {}
	for _, x in ipairs(list) do if not same(x, id) then out[#out + 1] = x end end
	return out
end

-- Put member `id` on `side` ("A" | "B"), or take them off both (json.null: sit out and
-- watch). Only between matches; a full side refuses. A missing side (nil) refuses, as
-- the JavaScript's undefined does.
function lobby.joinTeam(doc, id, side)
	local l = lobby.lobbyOf(doc)
	if l.started then return nil end
	if not js.isNull(side) and not includes(lobby.SIDES, side) then return nil end
	local on = truthy(side)
	if on and includes(l.teams[side], id) then return nil end
	if on and #l.teams[side] >= lobby.TEAM_MAX then return nil end
	local was = includes(l.teams.A, id) or includes(l.teams.B, id)
	if not on and not was then return nil end
	for _, s in ipairs(lobby.SIDES) do l.teams[s] = without(l.teams[s], id) end
	if on then l.teams[side][#l.teams[side] + 1] = id end
	return l
end

-- The host's match options (merged; unknown values ignored).
function lobby.setOptions(doc, options)
	local l = lobby.lobbyOf(doc)
	if l.started then return nil end
	local next, changed = object {}, false
	for _, k in ipairs(OPTION_KEYS) do
		local v = get(options, k)
		if truthy(options) and includes(OPTION_VALUES[k], v) then next[k] = v else next[k] = l.options[k] end
		if next[k] ~= l.options[k] then changed = true end
	end
	if truthy(doc) and not changed then return nil end
	l.options = next
	return l
end

-- The host's choice: open (anyone may join from the home page's list) or invite only.
-- Between matches or during one.
function lobby.setAccess(doc, open)
	local l = lobby.lobbyOf(doc)
	if truthy(doc) and l.open == truthy(open) then return nil end
	l.open = truthy(open)
	return l
end

-- What the host tells the room server about an open pitch, for the home page's list, or
-- nil while it is invite only. `members`: the room's members; `over`: the match on
-- screen has ended.
function lobby.openListing(doc, members, over)
	local l = lobby.lobbyOf(doc)
	if not l.open then return nil end
	local here = 0
	for _, m in ipairs(members or {}) do if get(m, "connected") ~= false then here = here + 1 end end
	return object {
		players = math.min(here, lobby.SEATS),
		seats = lobby.SEATS,
		state = (not l.started) and "waiting" or (truthy(over) and "over" or "playing"),
	}
end

-- Forget members who left the room for good (`present`: the ids still in it). Between
-- matches only; the match keeps its own players.
function lobby.pruneTeams(doc, present)
	local l = lobby.lobbyOf(doc)
	if l.started then return nil end
	local changed = false
	for _, s in ipairs(lobby.SIDES) do
		local t = {}
		for _, x in ipairs(l.teams[s]) do if includes(present, x) then t[#t + 1] = x end end
		if #t ~= #l.teams[s] then changed = true end
		l.teams[s] = t
	end
	return changed and l or nil
end

-- Who plays: the lobby's teams with each member's name, the computer on an empty side.
-- `members`: the room's [{ id, me }]; members no longer in the room are left out.
-- Returns { players, cpu } or nil when nobody is on a team.
function lobby.lineup(doc, members)
	local l = lobby.lobbyOf(doc)
	local byId = {}
	for _, m in ipairs(members or {}) do
		-- a Map keyed by id: the last member with an id wins
		local id = get(m, "id")
		if id ~= nil then byId[id] = m end
	end
	local players = object { A = {}, B = {} }
	for _, s in ipairs(lobby.SIDES) do
		for _, id in ipairs(l.teams[s]) do
			local m = byId[id]
			if m then
				local me = get(m, "me")
				local name = lobby.cleanName(get(me, "name"))
				if name == "" then name = "Player " .. (#players[s] + 1) end
				players[s][#players[s] + 1] = object { id = id, name = name, level = get(me, "level") }
			end
		end
	end
	if #players.A == 0 and #players.B == 0 then return nil end
	local cpu = (#players.A == 0) and "A" or ((#players.B == 0) and "B" or NULL)
	return object { players = players, cpu = cpu }
end

-- The engine's newMatch options for a lineup: teams with each player's key = the member
-- id, so a throw maps back to a member. `seed` and `start` are the host's (a random seed,
-- its local time): this module has no clock and no randomness.
function lobby.matchOptions(doc, lu, seed, start)
	local l = lobby.lobbyOf(doc)
	local players, cpu = get(lu, "players"), get(lu, "cpu")
	local function team(s)
		if same(s, cpu) then
			return object { name = "Computer", players = { object { name = "Computer" } } }
		end
		local ps = get(players, s)
		local list = {}
		for i, p in ipairs(ps) do
			local level = get(p, "level")
			list[i] = object { name = get(p, "name"), key = get(p, "id"),
				level = includes(lobby.LEVELS, level) and level or "club" }
		end
		return object { name = (#ps == 1) and get(ps[1], "name") or ("Team " .. s), players = list }
	end
	local o = object {
		seed = seed,
		start = start,
		teams = object { A = team("A"), B = team("B") },
		cpu = truthy(cpu) and cpu or {},
		first = "A",
	}
	for _, k in ipairs(OPTION_KEYS) do o[k] = l.options[k] end
	return o
end

-- START: the match begins with the host's first snapshot. `setup` (the newMatch options)
-- starts the replay's log. Writes match.engine (this engine's major.minor) and refuses
-- (nil) unless startCheck(players, members, host, lenient) passes.
function lobby.startMatch(doc, a)
	local l = lobby.lobbyOf(doc)
	if l.started then return nil end
	if not lobby.startCheck(a.players, a.members, a.host, a.lenient).ok then return nil end
	local n = l.n + 1
	l.started = true
	l.n = n
	local function strip(list)
		local out = {}
		for i, p in ipairs(list) do out[i] = object { id = get(p, "id"), name = get(p, "name") } end
		return out
	end
	local m = object {
		n = n,
		seq = 0,
		snap = a.snap,
		hash = a.hash,
		players = object { A = strip(get(a.players, "A")), B = strip(get(a.players, "B")) },
		cpu = truthy(a.cpu) and a.cpu or NULL,
		host = a.host,
		engine = lobby.ENGINE,
	}
	if truthy(a.setup) and js.isTable(a.setup) then
		m.setup, m.h0, m.log = a.setup, a.hash, {}
	end
	l.match = m
	return l
end

local function copy(t)
	local o = object {}
	for k, v in pairs(t) do o[k] = v end
	return o
end

-- An action committed: the snapshot after it, as action number `seq` of match `n`.
-- Refused (nil) unless it follows the document's own last action: the compare-and-set's
-- loser drops its action and adopts. `action` goes on the replay's log with the hash after
-- it; `over` when it ended the match. A log that cannot stay whole (no action, a gap, or
-- the document past LOG_BUDGET) is dropped: that match has no replay.
function lobby.commitAction(doc, a)
	local l = lobby.lobbyOf(doc)
	local m = l.match
	if not l.started or not truthy(m) or not same(get(m, "n"), a.n) or not same(get(m, "seq"), js.minus1(a.seq)) then
		return nil
	end
	local nm = copy(m)
	nm.seq, nm.snap, nm.hash = a.seq, a.snap, a.hash
	local log = get(m, "log")
	if js.isArray(log) then
		if truthy(a.action) and #log == js.minus1(a.seq) then
			local nl = {}
			for i, e in ipairs(log) do nl[i] = e end
			nl[#nl + 1] = object { a = a.action, h = a.hash }
			nm.log = nl
		else
			nm.log = NULL
		end
	end
	if truthy(a.over) then nm.over = true end
	l.match = nm
	if truthy(nm.log) and js.asciiSize(l) > lobby.LOG_BUDGET then nm.log = NULL end
	return l
end

-- A match's replay, when it has one: it has ended and its log is whole. { v, n, setup,
-- h0, log, snap, hash, players, cpu } (and engine, when the match names one), or nil.
function lobby.replayOf(match)
	local m = match
	if not js.isTable(m) or get(m, "over") ~= true then return nil end
	if not truthy(m.setup) or not js.isTable(m.setup) or type(m.snap) ~= "string" then return nil end
	if not js.isArray(m.log) or not same(#m.log, m.seq) then return nil end
	local h0, cpu = m.h0, m.cpu
	if h0 == nil then h0 = NULL end
	if cpu == nil then cpu = NULL end
	return object {
		v = lobby.REPLAY_VERSION, n = m.n, setup = m.setup, h0 = h0, log = m.log, snap = m.snap,
		hash = m.hash, players = m.players, cpu = cpu, engine = m.engine,
	}
end

-- The same check for a replay that came from elsewhere (the room's kept copy).
function lobby.isReplay(r)
	if not truthy(r) or not js.isTable(r) then return false end
	if not same(get(r, "v"), lobby.REPLAY_VERSION) then return false end
	local setup = get(r, "setup")
	if not ((truthy(setup) and js.isTable(setup)) or type(get(r, "start")) == "string") then return false end
	local log = get(r, "log")
	if not js.isArray(log) then return false end
	for _, e in ipairs(log) do
		if not truthy(e) then return false end
		local x = get(e, "a")
		if not (js.isTable(x) and truthy(x)) then return false end
	end
	return type(get(r, "snap")) == "string"
end

-- REMATCH: back to the lobby with the same teams (the old match is dropped from the
-- document; its replay was kept by the room when it ended).
function lobby.backToLobby(doc, n)
	local l = lobby.lobbyOf(doc)
	if not l.started or (n ~= nil and not js.isNull(n) and not same(l.n, n)) then return nil end
	l.started = false
	l.match = NULL
	return l
end

tw.room = tw.room or {}
tw.room.lobby = lobby
room/seats:
-- Who acts in a shared match (docs/ROOM.md "Who acts"): the web's src/net/seats.js in
-- Lua. Pure.
--
-- ctx = {
--   players:   { A: [{ id, name }], B: [...] }   the match's players (doc.match.players)
--   cpu:       "A" | "B" | null                  the computer's side
--   host:      memberId                          the room's host now
--   connected: [memberId, ...]                   the members connected now (a Set in JS)
-- }
--
-- - A throw is for the member whose player the engine names (need.setup.thrower.key). If
--   they are not connected, the first connected member of that team in throwing order
--   takes it (it is still that player's throw on the sheet); failing that, the host.
-- - A raise or a punishment kubb is for any connected member of the defending team
--   (need.side), else the host. The room's compare-and-set settles two at once.
-- - The computer's throws are the host's client's (cpu: true), and only its.
import "core/tw"
import "session/json"
import "room/js"

local json, js = tw.web.json, tw.room.js
local object = json.object
local truthy, same, get, includes = js.truthy, js.same, js.get, js.includes

local seats = {}

local function isConnected(ctx, id)
	return truthy(id) and includes(get(ctx, "connected"), id)
end

function seats.teamIds(ctx, side)
	local list = get(get(ctx, "players"), side)
	if not truthy(list) then list = {} end
	local out = {}
	for i, p in ipairs(list) do out[i] = get(p, "id") end
	return out
end

local function hostOnly(ctx)
	local h = get(ctx, "host")
	return truthy(h) and { h } or {}
end

-- The members who may act for `need` now (a list; empty for nobody).
function seats.actorsFor(need, ctx)
	if not truthy(need) or same(get(need, "kind"), "over") or truthy(get(need, "practice")) then return {} end
	local side, kind = get(need, "side"), get(need, "kind")
	if same(kind, "throw") then
		if truthy(get(need, "cpu")) or same(side, get(ctx, "cpu")) then return hostOnly(ctx) end
		local owner = get(get(get(need, "setup"), "thrower"), "key")
		if isConnected(ctx, owner) then return { owner } end
		for _, id in ipairs(seats.teamIds(ctx, side)) do
			if isConnected(ctx, id) then return { id } end
		end
		return hostOnly(ctx)
	end
	if same(kind, "raise") or same(kind, "punish") then
		local mates = {}
		for _, id in ipairs(seats.teamIds(ctx, side)) do
			if isConnected(ctx, id) then mates[#mates + 1] = id end
		end
		if #mates > 0 then return mates end
		return hostOnly(ctx)
	end
	return {}
end

-- May member `me` act for `need`? Never for the computer's throw: the engine throws it
-- by itself in the client with control.cpu.
