function seats.mayAct(need, ctx, me)
	if not truthy(need) or truthy(get(need, "cpu")) then return false end
	return includes(seats.actorsFor(need, ctx), me)
end

-- The member shown as the one acting (the first who may), or "cpu", or nil.
function seats.shownActor(need, ctx)
	if not truthy(need) then return nil end
	if same(get(need, "kind"), "throw") and (truthy(get(need, "cpu")) or same(get(need, "side"), get(ctx, "cpu"))) then
		return "cpu"
	end
	local first = seats.actorsFor(need, ctx)[1]
	return truthy(first) and first or nil
end

-- The engine's control for this client (setControl): the human sides it may ever act
-- for (its own team's, and every human side when it is the host, who stands in for
-- anyone), and the computer when it is the host. mayAct decides need by need.
function seats.controlFor(ctx, me)
	local sides = {}
	local host = get(ctx, "host")
	for _, s in ipairs { "A", "B" } do
		if not same(s, get(ctx, "cpu")) then
			if same(me, host) or includes(seats.teamIds(ctx, s), me) then sides[#sides + 1] = s end
		end
	end
	return object { sides = sides, cpu = same(me, host) }
end

function seats.sameControl(a, b)
	if not truthy(a) or not truthy(b) then return false end
	if not same(get(a, "cpu"), get(b, "cpu")) then return false end
	local sa, sb = get(a, "sides"), get(b, "sides")
	if not js.isTable(sa) or not js.isTable(sb) or #sa ~= #sb then return false end
	for i = 1, #sa do if not same(sa[i], sb[i]) then return false end end
	return true
end

-- The side member `me` plays for in this match, or nil (watching).
function seats.playingSide(ctx, me)
	for _, s in ipairs { "A", "B" } do
		if includes(seats.teamIds(ctx, s), me) then return s end
	end
	return nil
end

-- The next host when the host has gone: the room lets only the earliest-joined connected
-- member claim (the web's docs/ROOMS.md 2.4), so that is who tries. members: the room's
-- list in joined order. nil while the host is here.
function seats.nextHost(members, host)
	local h
	for _, m in ipairs(members or {}) do
		if same(get(m, "id"), host) then h = m; break end
	end
	if truthy(h) and truthy(get(h, "connected")) then return nil end
	for _, m in ipairs(members or {}) do
		if truthy(get(m, "connected")) and not same(get(m, "id"), host) then return get(m, "id") end
	end
	return nil
end

tw.room = tw.room or {}
tw.room.seats = seats
room/sync:
-- How a client keeps its match in step with the room (docs/ROOM.md "Staying in step"):
-- the web's src/net/sync.js in Lua. Pure.
--
-- The acting client applies its action, then commits the snapshot after it as action
-- `seq` with the action riding along (`with`). Every other client gets the new document
-- with `with`, applies the same action to watch the same throw, and then checks its hash
-- against the committed one. A gap, a missing `with`, a refused action or a different
-- hash: it adopts the committed snapshot instead.
import "core/tw"
import "session/json"
import "room/js"

local json, js = tw.web.json, tw.room.js
local object = json.object
local truthy, same, get = js.truthy, js.same, js.get

local sync = {}

-- The client name the web puts in a rider's `c` (the web's docs/ROOMS.md section 7). Another
-- client passes its own (`ios`).
sync.CLIENT = "web"
-- The room's limit on `with` (the web's docs/ROOMS.md section 3): the default for rider's bytes.
sync.WITH_BYTES = 4096

-- What to do with a document version that arrived.
--   loc = { n, seq }  the match number and the last action number this client holds
--                     (applied or queued to apply)
--   doc the room's document; w its `with` (or nil); mine: our own write
-- Returns one of:
--   { kind = "lobby" }                       no match running
--   { kind = "start", match }                another match than ours: take it
--   { kind = "same", match }                 the version we hold: compare hashes
--   { kind = "old" }                         older than what we hold
--   { kind = "apply", match, action }        the next action: apply and verify
--   { kind = "adopt", match, why }           take the snapshot as it is ("own", "gap",
--                                            "no-action")
function sync.decide(loc, doc, w, mine)
	local m = nil
	if truthy(doc) and truthy(get(doc, "started")) then m = get(doc, "match") end
	if not truthy(m) or type(get(m, "snap")) ~= "string" then return object { kind = "lobby" } end
	local ln, ls = get(loc, "n"), get(loc, "seq")
	if not same(m.n, ln) then return object { kind = "start", match = m } end
	if same(m.seq, ls) then return object { kind = "same", match = m } end
	if js.less(m.seq, ls) then return object { kind = "old" } end
	if truthy(mine) then return object { kind = "adopt", match = m, why = "own" } end
	if not same(m.seq, js.plus1(ls)) then return object { kind = "adopt", match = m, why = "gap" } end
	if not truthy(w) or not same(get(w, "n"), m.n) or not same(get(w, "seq"), m.seq) or not truthy(get(w, "a")) then
		return object { kind = "adopt", match = m, why = "no-action" }
	end
	return object { kind = "apply", match = m, action = get(w, "a") }
end

-- The `with` for an action, or nil when it would not fit the room's limit (`bytes`, as
-- ASCII JSON, default 4096): then the others just adopt the snapshot. `c` names the
-- client that committed it (default "web"); `e`, when given, the engine's version (the
-- web sends neither yet; the web's docs/ROOMS.md section 7). The recorder keeps them with the
-- action; other clients ignore them.
function sync.rider(n, seq, action, bytes, client, engine)
	local w = object { n = n, seq = seq, a = action, c = (client == nil) and sync.CLIENT or client, e = engine }
	if bytes == nil then bytes = sync.WITH_BYTES end
	local limit = (type(bytes) == "number" and bytes or js.toNumber(bytes)) - 64
	return (js.asciiSize(w) <= limit) and w or nil
end

sync.asciiSize = js.asciiSize

tw.room = tw.room or {}
tw.room.sync = sync
session/api:
-- The one door from JavaScript (docs/SESSION.md "The API"): kubbCall(method,
-- argsJson) -> resultJson. One session per Lua state. Every call is
-- protected: a Lua error comes back as {"error": "..."}, which src/engine
-- throws as a JavaScript Error. snapshot returns the snapshot text itself;
-- restore takes it as its argument. "room.<name>" calls are the room's (room/api.lua).
import "core/tw"
import "version"
import "session/json"
import "session/session"
import "session/wide"
import "session/replay"
import "room/api"

local json, session, wide, replay = tw.web.json, tw.web.session, tw.web.wide, tw.web.replay

local api = {}
local S = nil

local function need()
	assert(S, "no session: call new or restore first")
	return S
end

-- A replay (session/replay.lua) while one is loaded: its session is S, and nothing may
-- act in it (every call that would change the match but the replay's own is refused).
local R = nil

local function act()
	assert(not R, "a replay is read only")
	return need()
end

local M = {}

-- The wide view (session/wide.lua): while it is on, the calls that hand JS a
-- camera hand it the wide one, and what is in Team B's view frame comes out
-- in the world frame. It belongs to this Lua state, not to a session: a new
-- match or a restore keeps it.
local wideBox, wideCam = nil, nil
local WIDE = { view = true, aim = true, frame = true, showAt = true, apply = true, recording = true,
	showAim = true, setTarget = true, nudgeTarget = true, setStance = true, stepArc = true, setArc = true,
	stepSide = true, freshPlan = true, setLevel = true, setDrill = true, reset = true, setSurface = true,
	new = true, restore = true, replayLoad = true, replayStep = true, replayBack = true, replayRewind = true }

-- { box = { left, top, right, bottom } } turns it on (frame px; kind "side"
-- or "end" to choose the framing, else by the box's shape), {} turns it off.
-- Returns { camera, kind, farPx } (farPx: the smallest base kubb's height in
-- frame px) or {}.
function M.setWide(a)
	if a and a.box then
		local b = a.box
		wideBox = { left = b.left + 0, top = b.top + 0, right = b.right + 0, bottom = b.bottom + 0 }
		wideCam = wide.camera(wideBox, a.kind)
		return { camera = wideCam, kind = wideCam.kind, farPx = wide.smallest(wideCam) }
	end
	wideBox, wideCam = nil, nil
	return json.object()
end

local function wideOut(method, r)
	if not wideCam or not S or not WIDE[method] or type(r) ~= "table" then return r end
	if method == "showAt" then return wide.out(r, wideCam, S.recSide, S.recSide) end
	if method == "recording" then
		return (r.timeline and wide.recording(S.recSide, r)) or r
	end
	return wide.out(r, wideCam, S.frameSide, S.recSide)
end

-- ---------- the host, at start-up ----------
-- engineVersion: { version } (version.lua). useTune { name }: the host's tune
-- (tune/<name>.lua), once per Lua state, before the first new or restore; returns
-- { tune }. setClient { label }: the client label written into game files ("web
-- 0.4.2"; default "kubb-engine <version>"); returns { client }.
function M.engineVersion() return { version = tw.engine.version } end
function M.useTune(a) return { tune = session.useTune(a and a.name) } end
function M.setClient(a) return { client = session.setClient(a and a.label) } end

function M.new(a) R = nil; S = session.new(a or {}); return S:view() end
function M.restore(text, raw) R = nil; S = session.restore(raw); return S:view() end
function M.restorePractice(a) R = nil; S = session.restorePractice(a.checkpoint); return S:view() end
function M.view() return need():view() end
-- The view in the thrower's frame even while the wide view is on: what a report
-- records, so tools/reports.mjs can compare it with a replay (not in WIDE).
function M.frameView() return need():view() end
function M.need() return need():need() end
function M.aim() local s = need(); return { aim = s:aimView(), camera = s.ts.aimCam } end
function M.frame(a) return need():frame(a or {}) end
function M.showAt(a) return need():showAt(a and a.t or 0) or json.object() end
function M.setTarget(a) return need():setTarget(a.x, a.y, a.snap) end
function M.nudgeTarget(a) return need():nudgeTarget(a.dx, a.dy) end
function M.setStance(a) return need():setStance(a and a.x, a and a.y) end
function M.stepArc(a) return need():stepArc(a and a.step) end
function M.setArc(a) return need():setArc(a.deg) end
function M.stepSide(a) return need():stepSide(a and a.step) end
function M.freshPlan() return need():freshPlan() end
function M.setLevel(a) return need():setLevel(a and a.level) end
function M.setDrill(a) return need():setDrill(a and a.on) end
function M.reset() return need():reset() end
function M.setSurface(a) return need():setSurface(a and a.surface) end
function M.setControl(a) return act():setControl(a) end
function M.aimState() return need():aimState() end
function M.showAim(a) return need():showAim(a) or json.object() end
function M.apply(a) return act():apply(a) end
function M.checkPunish(a) return need():checkPunish(a.x, a.y) end
function M.hash() local text = need():snapshot(); return { hash = session.fnv(text), bytes = #text } end
-- ---------- a replay (session/replay.lua) ----------
-- replayLoad { setup, h0, log } sets the match out again from its options; the view,
-- with `replay` = its info. replayStep plays the next action ({ ok, recording?, need,
-- action, replay }); replayBack goes to the start of the previous turn and
-- replayRewind to the start of the match (the view, with `replay`).
local function withInfo(r)
	r.replay = R:info()
	return r
end
function M.replayLoad(a)
	R = nil
	R = replay.new(a)
	S = R.s
	return withInfo(S:view())
end
local function needReplay()
	assert(R, "no replay: call replayLoad first")
	return R
end
function M.replayStep()
	local r = needReplay():step()
	S = R.s
	return withInfo(r)
end
function M.replayBack()
	needReplay():back()
	S = R.s
	return withInfo(S:view())
end
function M.replayRewind()
	needReplay():rewind()
	S = R.s
	return withInfo(S:view())
end
function M.replayInfo()
	local r = needReplay():info()
	r.held = S.ts.mode == "cpuhold"
	return r
end
function M.replayEnd() R = nil; return json.object() end

-- Frozen rest poses in the frame of the reported throw, including pieces
-- picked up for the following turn. Avoid serializing the playback tracks.
function M.reportThrow()
	local s = need()
	local rec = s.recording
	if not rec then return json.object() end
	local items = {}
	for i, it in ipairs(rec.items) do
		local b = s.ts.last.res.bodies[it.id]
		items[i] = { id = it.id, kind = it.kind, team = it.team, x = b.x, y = b.y, z = b.z,
			qw = b.qw, qx = b.qx, qy = b.qy, qz = b.qz, toppled = b.toppled }
	end
	return { seq = rec.seq, items = items, result = rec.result, practiceBefore = s.practiceBefore }
end

function M.recording() return need().recording or json.object() end
function M.sheet() return need():sheet() or json.object() end

local function call(method, arg)
	if method == "snapshot" then return need():snapshot() end
	-- the room's pure calls (room/api.lua, docs/ROOM.md): "room.<name>"
	if type(method) == "string" and method:sub(1, 5) == "room." then return tw.room.api.call(method:sub(6), arg) end
	local f = M[method]
	if not f then error("unknown call " .. tostring(method), 0) end
	local a = nil
	if method == "restore" then return json.encode(wideOut(method, f(nil, arg))) end
	if arg and arg ~= "" then a = json.decode(arg) end
	local r = wideOut(method, f(a))
	if r == nil then r = json.object() end
	return json.encode(r)
end

function kubbCall(method, arg)
	local ok, r = pcall(call, method, arg)
	if ok then return r end
	return json.encode { error = tostring(r) }
end

api.call = call
tw.web.api = api
session/json:
-- JSON in and out for the web session (docs/SESSION.md "Determinism"). Pure Lua 5.4.
--
-- What the session hands JavaScript and what it keeps in a snapshot goes
-- through here, so it is exact and the same in every browser:
--   * object keys are written sorted, so the same table is always the same
--     text (the snapshot hash depends on it);
--   * a Lua integer is written without a point ("3") and a float always with
--     one or an exponent ("3.0", "0.1", "1e-07"): json.decode gives back an
--     integer for the first and a float for the others, so a snapshot comes
--     back with every number of the same Lua type it had (Lua 5.4 keeps
--     integers and floats apart: 3 // 2 and string.format of them differ);
--   * a float is written with the fewest digits (15, 16 or 17) that read back
--     as exactly the same double, so nothing drifts through a round trip;
--   * an empty table is written as [] (json.object() marks one that must be
--     {}), a table with keys 1..n as an array, any other as an object (string
--     keys only: anything else is an error, as core/save's plain rule is).
-- json.raw(text) puts text into the output as it is (the recording's pose
-- arrays, already formatted).
--
-- The room's documents (room/, docs/ROOM.md) need what a JavaScript client wrote to come
-- back as it was: json.decode(text, true) keeps every object an object (an empty one too,
-- marked as json.object() marks it) and every null a null (json.null, which encodes as
-- null), where the plain decode drops nulls and reads {} as an empty table, written [].
-- The session never decodes that way, so its texts and hashes are unchanged.
import "core/tw"

local json = {}

local fmt, concat, sort, mtype = string.format, table.concat, table.sort, math.type

local RAW = {}      -- metatable of json.raw values
local OBJECT = {}   -- metatable of tables always written as objects
local NULL = setmetatable({}, { __name = "json.null", __tostring = function() return "null" end })

function json.raw(text) return setmetatable({ text }, RAW) end
function json.object(t) return setmetatable(t or {}, OBJECT) end

-- JSON's null, kept apart from a missing key (nil) by json.decode(text, true).
json.null = NULL
function json.isNull(v) return rawequal(v, NULL) end

-- An array: a table that is not json.null, not marked as an object, and is empty or has
-- exactly the keys 1..n (what json.encode writes as an array).
function json.isArray(v)
	if type(v) ~= "table" or rawequal(v, NULL) then return false end
	local mt = getmetatable(v)
	if mt == OBJECT or mt == RAW then return false end
	local len, n = #v, 0
	for _ in pairs(v) do n = n + 1 end
	return n == len
end

-- An object: a table that is not json.null and not an array.
function json.isObject(v)
	return type(v) == "table" and not rawequal(v, NULL) and getmetatable(v) ~= RAW and not json.isArray(v)
end

-- A float as the shortest text that reads back as the same double.
local function float(v)
	if v ~= v then error("json: NaN", 0) end
	if v == math.huge then return "1e999" end
	if v == -math.huge then return "-1e999" end
	local s
	for p = 15, 17 do
		s = fmt("%." .. p .. "g", v)
		if tonumber(s) == v then break end
	end
	if not s:find("[%.eEn]") then s = s .. ".0" end
	return s
end
json.float = float

local ESC = { ['"'] = '\\"', ["\\"] = "\\\\", ["\b"] = "\\b", ["\f"] = "\\f", ["\n"] = "\\n",
	["\r"] = "\\r", ["\t"] = "\\t" }
local function str(s)
	return '"' .. s:gsub('[%c"\\]', function(c) return ESC[c] or fmt("\\u%04x", c:byte()) end) .. '"'
end

local encodeTo
encodeTo = function(v, out, n, path)
	local t = type(v)
	if v == nil or rawequal(v, NULL) then n = n + 1; out[n] = "null"
	elseif t == "boolean" then n = n + 1; out[n] = v and "true" or "false"
	elseif t == "number" then
		n = n + 1
		out[n] = (mtype(v) == "integer") and fmt("%d", v) or float(v)
	elseif t == "string" then n = n + 1; out[n] = str(v)
	elseif t == "table" then
		local mt = getmetatable(v)
		if mt == RAW then n = n + 1; out[n] = v[1]; return n end
		local len = #v
		local keys = {}
		for k in pairs(v) do keys[#keys + 1] = k end
		if mt ~= OBJECT and (len > 0 and #keys == len or #keys == 0) then
			n = n + 1; out[n] = "["
			for i = 1, len do
				if i > 1 then n = n + 1; out[n] = "," end
				n = encodeTo(v[i], out, n, path)
			end
			n = n + 1; out[n] = "]"
		else
			for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
				if type(k) ~= "string" then error("json: a " .. type(k) .. " key at " .. path, 0) end
			end
			sort(keys)
			n = n + 1; out[n] = "{"
			for i, k in ipairs(keys) do
				if i > 1 then n = n + 1; out[n] = "," end
				n = n + 1; out[n] = str(k) .. ":"
				n = encodeTo(v[k], out, n, path .. "." .. k)
			end
			n = n + 1; out[n] = "}"
		end
	else
		error("json: a " .. t .. " at " .. path, 0)
	end
	return n
end

function json.encode(v)
	local out = {}
	encodeTo(v, out, 0, "")
	return concat(out)
end

-- ---------- decoding ----------

local byte, sub, find, char = string.byte, string.sub, string.find, utf8.char

local function fail(s, i, what) error(fmt("json: %s at %d", what, i), 0) end

local function skip(s, i)
	local _, e = find(s, "^[ \t\r\n]*", i)
	return e + 1
end

local value

local function decodeString(s, i)
	-- i is just after the opening quote
	local parts, n = {}, 0
	local j = i
	while true do
		local c = byte(s, j)
		if not c then fail(s, j, "unterminated string") end
		if c == 34 then
			n = n + 1; parts[n] = sub(s, i, j - 1)
			return concat(parts), j + 1
		elseif c == 92 then
			n = n + 1; parts[n] = sub(s, i, j - 1)
			local e = sub(s, j + 1, j + 1)
			if e == "u" then
				local cp = tonumber(sub(s, j + 2, j + 5), 16)
				if not cp then fail(s, j, "bad \\u escape") end
				j = j + 6
				if cp >= 0xD800 and cp <= 0xDBFF and sub(s, j, j + 1) == "\\u" then
					local lo = tonumber(sub(s, j + 2, j + 5), 16)
					if lo and lo >= 0xDC00 and lo <= 0xDFFF then
						cp = 0x10000 + (cp - 0xD800) * 0x400 + (lo - 0xDC00)
						j = j + 6
					end
				end
				n = n + 1; parts[n] = char(cp)
			else
				local m = ({ ['"'] = '"', ["\\"] = "\\", ["/"] = "/", b = "\b", f = "\f", n = "\n", r = "\r", t = "\t" })[e]
				if not m then fail(s, j, "bad escape") end
				n = n + 1; parts[n] = m
				j = j + 2
			end
			i = j
		else
			j = j + 1
		end
	end
end

value = function(s, i, keep)
	i = skip(s, i)
	local c = sub(s, i, i)
	if c == "{" then
		local t = keep and setmetatable({}, OBJECT) or {}
		i = skip(s, i + 1)
		if sub(s, i, i) == "}" then return t, i + 1 end
		while true do
			if sub(s, i, i) ~= '"' then fail(s, i, "expected a key") end
			local k
			k, i = decodeString(s, i + 1)
			i = skip(s, i)
			if sub(s, i, i) ~= ":" then fail(s, i, "expected :") end
			local v
			v, i = value(s, i + 1, keep)
			t[k] = v
			i = skip(s, i)
			local d = sub(s, i, i)
			if d == "}" then return t, i + 1 end
			if d ~= "," then fail(s, i, "expected , or }") end
			i = skip(s, i + 1)
		end
	elseif c == "[" then
		local t, n = {}, 0
		i = skip(s, i + 1)
		if sub(s, i, i) == "]" then return t, i + 1 end
		while true do
			local v
			v, i = value(s, i, keep)
			n = n + 1
			t[n] = v
			i = skip(s, i)
			local d = sub(s, i, i)
			if d == "]" then return t, i + 1 end
			if d ~= "," then fail(s, i, "expected , or ]") end
			i = i + 1
		end
	elseif c == '"' then
		return decodeString(s, i + 1)
	elseif c == "t" and sub(s, i, i + 3) == "true" then return true, i + 4
	elseif c == "f" and sub(s, i, i + 4) == "false" then return false, i + 5
	elseif c == "n" and sub(s, i, i + 3) == "null" then return keep and NULL or nil, i + 4
	else
		local _, e = find(s, "^-?%d+%.?%d*[eE]?[-+]?%d*", i)
		if not e then fail(s, i, "unexpected character") end
		local text = sub(s, i, e)
		local v = tonumber(text)
		if v == nil then fail(s, i, "bad number") end
		-- a number with a point or an exponent is a float even when it is whole
		-- (tonumber already gives a float for those; adding 0.0 would turn -0.0
		-- into 0.0 and a snapshot would not come back to the same text)
		if find(text, "[%.eE]") and mtype(v) == "integer" then v = v + 0.0 end
		return v, e + 1
	end
end

-- Decode JSON text. null in an object leaves the key out; in an array it
-- leaves a hole (the session never sends one). With keep, null is json.null and
-- every object is marked as one (json.object), so the text comes back as it was.
function json.decode(s, keep)
	if type(s) ~= "string" then error("json: not a string", 0) end
	local v, i = value(s, 1, keep and true or nil)
	i = skip(s, i)
	if i <= #s then fail(s, i, "trailing text") end
	return v
end

tw.web = tw.web or {}
tw.web.json = json
session/replay:
-- A finished match played again (docs/CLIENT.md "Replays"; Jamie, 2026-11-16: "When a
-- game is finished playing on a pitch I'd like the URL to allow people to come and watch
-- a replay of the match."). Not a video: the match is set out again from its options and
-- every committed action goes through this engine in order, the same throws with the
-- same physics. The pitch's document keeps what it needs (src/net/lobby.js): the
-- newMatch options, the hash at the start, and each action with the hash after it.
--
--   local r = replay.new { setup = <newMatch options>, h0 = "<hash>", log = { { a = action, h = "<hash>" }, ... } }
--   replay.new { start = "<snapshot>", h0 = ..., log = ... } sets out from the match's first
--   snapshot instead: a match kept after it was played, from its recorded start
--   (tools/backfill-replay.mjs), whose document had no options.
--   r:step()   the next action: { ok, recording?, need, action }
--   r:back()   to the start of the previous turn (from the snapshot kept there)
--   r:info()   { i, total, turn, thrown, throws, differs, done }
--
-- The session it plays in belongs to nobody: no side and not the computer, so nothing in
-- it can act but the log (session/api refuses every action while a replay is loaded).
-- A hash that disagrees (an old match after a physics change) or an action this engine
-- refuses marks the replay `differs` and it goes on: a refused action is passed over.
import "core/tw"
import "session/session"

local session = tw.web.session

local replay = {}

local Replay = {}
Replay.__index = Replay

replay.NOBODY = { sides = {}, cpu = false }

local function copy(v)
	if type(v) ~= "table" then return v end
	local out = {}
	for k, x in pairs(v) do out[k] = copy(x) end
	return out
end

function replay.new(d)
	assert(type(d) == "table" and (type(d.setup) == "table" or type(d.start) == "string")
		and type(d.log) == "table", "a replay needs its setup (or its start) and its log")
	local r = setmetatable({}, Replay)
	r.setup, r.h0, r.log = d.setup, d.h0, d.log
	r.total = #d.log
	r.throws = 0
	for _, e in ipairs(d.log) do
		assert(type(e) == "table" and type(e.a) == "table", "a log entry is { a, h }")
		if e.a.type == "throw" then r.throws = r.throws + 1 end
	end
	r.differs = false
	r.marks = {}
	if type(d.start) == "string" then
		r.s = session.restore(d.start, replay.NOBODY)
	else
		local o = copy(r.setup)
		o.mode = "match"
		r.s = session.new(o)
	end
	r.s:setControl(replay.NOBODY)
	if r.h0 ~= nil and r.s:hash() ~= r.h0 then r.differs = true end
	r.i, r.thrown = 0, 0
	r:mark()
	return r
end

function Replay:turn()
	return self.s.m.game.turn
end

-- A turn's start, kept the first time the replay gets there: where BACK goes.
function Replay:mark()
	local last = self.marks[#self.marks]
	if last and (self.i <= last.i or self:turn() == last.turn) then return end
	self.marks[#self.marks + 1] = { i = self.i, thrown = self.thrown, turn = self:turn(), snap = self.s:snapshot() }
end

function Replay:done()
	return self.i >= self.total
end

-- The next action in the log, through this engine.
function Replay:step()
	if self:done() then return { ok = false, done = true, need = self.s:need() } end
	local e = self.log[self.i + 1]
	local ok, out = pcall(self.s.apply, self.s, e.a)
	self.i = self.i + 1
	if e.a.type == "throw" then self.thrown = self.thrown + 1 end
	local good = ok and type(out) == "table" and out.ok ~= false
	if not good then
		self.differs = true
	elseif e.h ~= nil and self.s:hash() ~= e.h then
		self.differs = true
	end
	self:mark()
	return { ok = good, recording = good and out.recording or nil, need = self.s:need(), action = e.a }
end

-- Back to the start of the previous turn: the turn before the one the replay is in, or
-- the start of the match from the first turn.
function Replay:back()
	local cur = 1
	for k = #self.marks, 1, -1 do
		if self.marks[k].i <= self.i then cur = k; break end
	end
	local m = self.marks[math.max(1, cur - 1)]
	self.s = session.restore(m.snap, replay.NOBODY)
	self.i, self.thrown = m.i, m.thrown
	return m
end

-- From the very start again.
function Replay:rewind()
	local m = self.marks[1]
	self.s = session.restore(m.snap, replay.NOBODY)
	self.i, self.thrown = m.i, m.thrown
end

function Replay:info()
	return { i = self.i, total = self.total, turn = self:turn(), thrown = self.thrown, throws = self.throws,
		differs = self.differs, done = self:done() }
end

tw.web.replay = replay
session/session:
-- The web session (docs/SESSION.md): a practice pitch or a match, behind a
-- few coarse calls. Pure Lua 5.4 over the vendored core.
--
-- This is the Playdate's scenes/match.lua and scenes/settle.lua with the
-- screen taken out (../../playdate-kubb), over session/throw (its throw
-- scene). What the Playdate showed as cards, rails and flags is returned as
-- data; what it read from the d-pad and the crank comes in as calls.
--
-- Sharing (DESIGN 4.3): the state that matters is the match (core/save),
-- the session's options, a throw counter and the aim memory carried from
-- one throw to the next. Every random draw is a fresh core/autothrow rng
-- seeded from the match seed, a purpose and a counter held in that state:
--   the computer's throw   mix(seed, 1, throws)
--   the wind of a turn     mix(seed, 2, turn)
--   the gust of a throw    mix(seed, 3, throws)
-- so a session restored from a snapshot draws exactly what the original
-- would have. (The Playdate keeps one rng per purpose running instead; the
-- draws are the same kind, not the same numbers.)
import "core/tw"
import "core/match"
import "core/cards"
import "core/save"
import "core/autothrow"
import "core/wind"
import "core/raising"
import "core/frame"
import "core/pitch"
import "core/world"
import "core/quat"
import "core/swing"
import "core/throwplan"
import "core/camera"
import "core/names"
import "core/notation"
import "core/gamefile"
import "version"
import "session/json"
import "session/throw"

local cmatch, cards, save, autothrow, wind = tw.match, tw.cards, tw.save, tw.autothrow, tw.wind
local raising, frame, pitch, quat, swing, plan = tw.raising, tw.frame, tw.pitch, tw.quat, tw.swing, tw.plan
local camera, outcome, debris = tw.camera, tw.outcome, tw.debris
local notation, gamefile = tw.notation, tw.gamefile
local json, throw = tw.web.json, tw.web.throw

local fmt, upper = string.format, string.upper
local floor, max, min, sqrt = math.floor, math.max, math.min, math.sqrt

local session = {}
session.version = tw.engine.version
session.snapshotVersion = 1

-- ---------- what the host sets at start-up ----------

-- The client label written into every game file the session makes ("Scored by"):
-- what the host is and its version, like "web 0.4.2". Not in the snapshot, so it
-- never changes a hash.
session.client = "kubb-engine " .. tw.engine.version

function session.setClient(label)
	assert(type(label) == "string" and #label >= 1 and #label <= 40 and label:match("^[%w%.%-%+ ]+$")
		and not label:match("^ ") and not label:match(" $"),
		"setClient: a label of 1 to 40 letters, digits, spaces, dots, hyphens or pluses, like \"web 0.4.2\"")
	session.client = label
	return label
end

-- The host's tune: tune/<name>.lua, its values for the core's tune tables (put in
-- once, here) and the session's dial and throw tables. One per Lua state, chosen
-- before the first new or restore; it cannot change after.
session.tuneName = nil

function session.useTune(name)
	assert(type(name) == "string" and name:match("^[a-z][a-z0-9]*$"), "useTune: a tune name, like \"pointer\"")
	if session.tuneName then
		assert(session.tuneName == name, "the tune is already " .. session.tuneName .. "; it cannot change")
		return name
	end
	import("tune/" .. name)
	local t = tw.tune and tw.tune[name]
	assert(t, "no tune " .. name)
	t.apply()
	tw.web.tune = t
	session.tuneName = name
	return name
end

local function needTune()
	assert(session.tuneName, "no tune: call useTune first")
end

-- ---------- words ----------

-- render/hud.lua hud.short, line for line: the match's ruling (m.text) as
-- the result flag's words.
local SHORT = {
	{ "^king down early", "KING TOO EARLY: GAME OVER" }, { "^king down", "KING DOWN" }, { "^resigned", "RESIGNED" },
	{ "^missed the king", "KING STANDS" }, { "^missed", "MISS" }, { "^helicopter", "HELICOPTER: DOESN'T COUNT" },
	{ "^own%-half kubb hit", "OWN HALF HIT: PUT BACK" }, { "^own half hit", "OWN HALF HIT: KUBB OUT" },
	{ "^kubb in for now", "IN FOR NOW" }, { "^kubb out for now", "OUT FOR NOW" },
	{ "^kubb in", "IN" }, { "^all in", "ALL IN" }, { "^kubb out: rethrown", "OUT: THROW AGAIN" },
	{ "^(%d+) out: rethrown", "%1 OUT: THROW AGAIN" }, { "^out twice", "OUT TWICE: PUNISHMENT" },
	{ "^(%d+) punishment", "%1 PUNISHMENT KUBBS" }, { "^on a kubb", "ON A KUBB: LOWERED" }, { "rescue", "RESCUE" },
}
function session.short(s)
	if not s then return nil end
	local first = s:match("^[^;]*")
	for _, r in ipairs(SHORT) do
		if first:find(r[1]) then return (first:gsub("^.*$", function(m) return (m:gsub(r[1] .. ".*$", r[2])) end)) end
	end
	if first:find("down$") then
		local n = 0
		for c in first:gmatch("(%d*) ?[fb]%a+ kubbs?") do n = n + (c == "" and 1 or tonumber(c)) end
		if n > 0 then return n .. " DOWN" end
	end
	return first:upper():sub(1, 12)
end

-- scenes/settle.lua whyLabel.
local WHY = {
	["not in the half"] = "NOT IN THE HALF",
	["closer than a baton length to the king"] = "TOO NEAR THE KING",
	["closer than a baton length to a stake"] = "TOO NEAR A STAKE",
}
local function whyLabel(why)
	if not why then return nil end
	if WHY[why] then return WHY[why] end
	if why:find("^overlaps") then return "ON A KUBB" end
	return upper(why)
end

-- ---------- numbers and randomness ----------

local function mix(seed, purpose, n)
	return ((seed * 0x9E3779B1) ~ (purpose * 0x85EBCA6B) ~ (n * 0xC2B2AE35)) & 0x7fffffff
end
session.mix = mix

local function rngFor(s, purpose, n)
	return autothrow.rng(mix(s.seed, purpose, n))
end

-- A number from JSON as a float (JavaScript writes 3.0 as 3).
local function F(v)
	if v == nil then return nil end
	return v + 0.0
end
-- A number from JSON as an integer.
local function I(v)
	if v == nil then return nil end
	return math.tointeger(v) or floor(v + 0.5)
end

local function fnv(text)
	local h = 0x811c9dc5
	for i = 1, #text do
		h = ((h ~ text:byte(i)) * 0x01000193) & 0xffffffff
	end
	return fmt("%08x", h)
end
session.fnv = fnv

local function viewPose(side, p)
	if not p then return nil end
	local v = frame.pose(side, p)
	return { x = v.x, y = v.y, standing = v.standing and true or false, angle = v.angle }
end

-- ---------- options ----------

local SURFACES = { grass = "Grass", sand = "Sand", snow = "Snow" }

local function surfaceKey(name)
	name = string.lower(name or "grass")
	if not SURFACES[name] then name = "grass" end
	return name
end

-- The match options, checked and filled in (a plain table: it goes into the snapshot).
local function matchOptions(o)
	local out = {}
	out.surface = surfaceKey(o.surface)
	out.opening = (o.opening == "six") and "six" or "2-4-6"
	out.raising = (o.raising == "auto") and "auto" or "hand"
	local w = o.wind or "off"
	if not wind.levels[w] then w = "off" end
	out.wind = w
	out.set = o.set or "classic"
	out.seed = I(o.seed or 1)
	out.first = (o.first == "B") and "B" or "A"
	local cpu = {}
	local c = o.cpu
	if type(c) == "string" then c = (c == "both") and { "A", "B" } or { c } end
	for _, side in ipairs(c or {}) do
		if side == "A" or side == "B" then cpu[#cpu + 1] = side end
	end
	table.sort(cpu)
	out.cpu = cpu
	out.maxTurns = o.maxTurns and I(o.maxTurns) or nil
	out.start = o.start or { year = 2026, month = 1, day = 1, hour = 12, min = 0 }
	for _, k in ipairs { "year", "month", "day", "hour", "min" } do out.start[k] = I(out.start[k] or 0) end
	out.mode = o.modeName
	-- the teams: { A = { name, players = { { name, level } } }, B = ... }, 1 to 6 players each
	local teams = {}
	for _, side in ipairs { "A", "B" } do
		local t = (o.teams or {})[side] or {}
		local name = t.name or ((#cpu == 1 and cpu[1] == side) and "Computer" or ("Team " .. side))
		local players = {}
		for i, p in ipairs(t.players or {}) do
			if i > 6 then break end
			if type(p) == "string" then p = { name = p } end
			players[#players + 1] = { name = tostring(p.name or ("Player " .. i)), level = p.level, key = p.key }
		end
		if #players == 0 then players[1] = { name = name } end
		teams[side] = { name = name, players = players }
	end
	out.teams = teams
	return out
end

local function isCpu(s, side)
	for _, c in ipairs(s.opts.cpu or {}) do if c == side then return true end end
	return false
end

-- ---------- the session ----------

local Session = {}
Session.__index = Session

-- A new session. o.mode = "practice" | "match"; the rest as matchOptions
-- (match) or { surface, level, set, drill } (practice).
function session.new(o)
	needTune()
	o = o or {}
	local s = setmetatable({}, Session)
	s.kind = (o.mode == "match") and "match" or "practice"
	s.control = { A = true, B = true, cpu = true }
	s.throws = 0
	s.recording = nil
	if s.kind == "practice" then
		s.opts = { surface = surfaceKey(o.surface), level = o.level, set = o.set or "classic" }
		s.ts = throw.new { surface = s.opts.surface, level = o.level, set = s.opts.set, exercise = o.exercise }
		s.phase = "throw"
		if o.exercise == "base" or o.exercise == "pair" or o.exercise == "pile" then
			-- A practice comparison measures the stroke, without the seeded nerves scatter.
			s.ts.nerves = false
		end
		if o.drill or o.exercise == "pile" then throw.setDrill(s.ts, true) end
		if o.exercise == "pile" then throw.setTarget(s.ts, 0, 5.6, false) end
		s.ts.railName = "PRACTICE"
		return s
	end
	s.opts = matchOptions(o)
	s.seed = s.opts.seed
	s.ts = throw.new { surface = s.opts.surface, set = s.opts.set }
	local mode = s.opts.mode
	if not mode then
		local n = #s.opts.cpu
		mode = (n == 2) and "Computer vs Computer" or ((n == 1) and "Vs Computer" or "Pass and Play")
	end
	local teams = {}
	for _, side in ipairs { "A", "B" } do
		local t = s.opts.teams[side]
		local ps = {}
		for i, p in ipairs(t.players) do ps[i] = { name = p.name, level = p.level, key = p.key } end
		teams[side] = { name = t.name, players = ps }
	end
	s.m = cmatch.new { start = s.opts.start, surface = SURFACES[s.opts.surface], opening = s.opts.opening,
		teams = teams, first = s.opts.first, mode = mode }
	s.byHand = s.opts.raising == "hand"
	s.side, s.lastThrower = nil, nil
	s:advance()
	return s
end

-- The aim memory the next throw's set-up reads (throw.prepare): kept in the
-- snapshot as it was before that set-up, so a restore sets the throw up again
-- exactly.
local MEM = { "playerX", "playerY", "stanceSet", "stanceSide", "stanceKind", "markerX", "markerY", "markerSet",
	"markerOnId", "markerSide", "drill", "lastBack", "lastStop" }

local setMem

-- Normalizes the live fields first (floats, booleans: what a restore sets), so
-- the acting browser and a restored one hold the very same values.
local function memOf(ts)
	local m = {}
	for _, k in ipairs(MEM) do m[k] = ts[k] end
	setMem(ts, m)
	for _, k in ipairs(MEM) do m[k] = ts[k] end
	return m
end

function setMem(ts, m)
	for _, k in ipairs(MEM) do ts[k] = m[k] end
	ts.markerX, ts.markerY = F(ts.markerX) or 0, F(ts.markerY) or 0
	ts.playerX, ts.playerY = F(ts.playerX) or 0, F(ts.playerY) or 0
	ts.lastBack, ts.lastStop = F(ts.lastBack), F(ts.lastStop)
	ts.stanceSet, ts.markerSet, ts.drill = ts.stanceSet and true or false, ts.markerSet and true or false,
		ts.drill and true or false
end

-- scenes/settle.lua begin: the next raise or punishment kubb (or done).
local function settleBegin(s)
	local g = s.m.game
	local n = g:need()
	local st = s.settle
	if n.kind == "raise" then
		st.mode, st.side, st.kubb = "raise", n.side, n.kubb
		if not st.raiseTotal then
			st.raiseTotal = 0
			for _, k in ipairs(g:fieldKubbs(n.side)) do
				if not k.pose.standing then st.raiseTotal = st.raiseTotal + 1 end
			end
		end
		return true
	elseif n.kind == "punish" then
		st.mode, st.side, st.kubb = "punish", n.side, n.kubb
		if not st.punishTotal then st.punishTotal = #g.punishQueue end
		return true
	end
	return false
end

-- scenes/match.lua nextThrow: the defender settles by hand, or the next
-- throw is set up (its wind, rail and cards), or the match is over.
function Session:advance()
	local m, opts = self.m, self.opts
	self.pre = { side = self.side, lastThrower = self.lastThrower, mem = memOf(self.ts) }
	if opts.maxTurns and m.game.turn > opts.maxTurns and not cmatch.over(m) then
		cmatch.resign(m)
		self.resignNote = "turn limit"
	end
	if self.resignPending and not cmatch.over(m) and m.game.attacker == self.resignPending
		and m.game:need().kind ~= "raise" and m.game:need().kind ~= "punish" then
		self.resignPending = nil
		cmatch.resign(m)
	end
	self.setup = nil
	self.card = nil
	if self.byHand and not cmatch.over(m) then
		local n = m.game:need()
		if (n.kind == "raise" or n.kind == "punish") and not isCpu(self, n.side) then
			self.phase = "settle"
			self.pitchFromMatch = true
			if not self.settle then
				self.settle = { raised = 0, placed = 0 }
				-- PASS + PLAY: the attacker hands over to the defender first (no
				-- card when the computer plays a side: the player holds it already)
				if #opts.cpu == 0 then self.card = { kind = "settle", settle = cards.settle(m.game) } end
			end
			settleBegin(self)
			return
		end
	end
	self.settle = nil
	local setup = (not cmatch.over(m)) and cmatch.setup(m) or nil
	if not setup then return self:over() end
	self.setup = setup
	self.phase = "throw"
	self.pitchFromMatch = nil -- ts holds the match's pitch from here on
	local ts = self.ts
	throw.prepare(ts, setup)
	self.frameSide = setup.side -- the frame ts is in now (session/wide)
	ts.level = setup.thrower and setup.thrower.level or nil
	ts.watching = isCpu(self, setup.side)
	ts.scripted = false
	-- the wind: a direction and speed for each turn, a gust of it for each throw
	ts.windX, ts.windY, ts.windText = 0, 0, nil
	self.windInfo = nil
	if (wind.levels[opts.wind] or 0) > 0 then
		local turn = m.game.turn
		local dir, speed = wind.turn(rngFor(self, 2, turn), opts.wind)
		local d, sp = wind.gust(rngFor(self, 3, self.throws), dir, speed)
		local wx, wy = wind.vector(d, sp, setup.side)
		ts.windX, ts.windY, ts.windText = wx, wy, wind.text(sp)
		self.windInfo = { x = wx, y = wy, speed = sp, text = ts.windText }
	end
	-- the rail
	local r1, r2
	if setup.kingShot then
		r1 = "KING"
	elseif setup.kind ~= "toss" then
		local field, base = 0, 0
		for _, p in ipairs(setup.pieces) do
			if not p.toppled and p.half ~= setup.side then
				if p.role == "field" then field = field + 1 elseif p.role == "base" then base = base + 1 end
			end
		end
		if field > 0 then r1 = "FIELD " .. field end
		r2 = "BASE " .. base
		if not r1 then r1, r2 = r2, nil end
	end
	self.rail = { r1 = r1, r2 = r2 }
	ts.railName = self:railName(setup)
	-- the cards
	local cpu = isCpu(self, setup.side)
	if setup.side ~= self.side then
		self.side = setup.side
		if not cpu then self.card = { kind = "handoff", handoff = cards.handoff(m, setup) } end
	end
	local th = setup.thrower
	local passes = not cpu and #m.game.teams[setup.side].players > 1
	if not self.card and passes and th and th.id ~= self.lastThrower then
		self.card = { kind = "pass", pass = cards.pass(m, setup) }
	end
	self.lastThrower = th and th.id
	self.cpuAim = nil
end

function Session:railName(setup)
	local name = cmatch.teamName(setup.side, self.m.game)
	if #self.m.game.teams[setup.side].players > 1 and setup.thrower then name = name .. ": " .. setup.thrower.name end
	return upper(name)
end

function Session:over()
	self.phase = "over"
	self.setup = nil
	-- the frame the pitch is shown in: the last throw's (a restored session has none yet)
	self.frameSide = self.frameSide or self.side or "A"
	local finish = self.finish or self.opts.start
	self.overInfo = {
		winner = cards.winner(self.m, finish),
		how = cmatch.howText(self.m),
	}
	local text, name = cmatch.file(self.m, finish, session.client)
	self.overInfo.file = { text = text, name = name }
end

-- The score sheet (docs/CLIENT.md "The score sheet"): the game file as it stands, in
-- Planet Kubb Notation. Mid-match it is the turns so far, with no End, Duration or Win
-- (core/notation writes Win only once there is a winner); once the match is over it is
-- the finished file (Session:over). `shown` is each line as a screen shows it, without
-- the positions on the pitch (core/gamefile.shown); `text` keeps them.
function Session:sheet()
	if self.kind ~= "match" then return nil end
	local text, name
	if self.phase == "over" and self.overInfo and self.overInfo.file then
		text, name = self.overInfo.file.text, self.overInfo.file.name
	else
		local m = self.m
		local levels = {}
		for _, side in ipairs { "A", "B" } do
			for _, e in ipairs(m.lineup and m.lineup[side] or {}) do
				if e.level then levels[#levels + 1] = e.id .. " " .. e.level end
			end
		end
		text = notation.render(m.game, { start = m.start, version = session.client, mode = m.mode,
			levels = levels })
		local start = m.start or self.opts.start
		name = start and notation.filename(start, m.game.teams.A.name, m.game.teams.B.name) or "kubb-game.txt"
	end
	local shown = {}
	for line in text:gmatch("([^\n]*)\n") do shown[#shown + 1] = gamefile.shown(line) end
	return { text = text, name = name, shown = shown, done = self.phase == "over" }
end

-- ---------- what the client asks ----------

local function plainSetup(setup)
	if not setup then return nil end
	return {
		kind = setup.kind, side = setup.side, projectile = setup.projectile, kubb = setup.kubb,
		n = setup.n, of = setup.of, label = setup.label, kingShot = setup.kingShot or false,
		rethrow = setup.rethrow or false, lineY = setup.lineY, forwardY = setup.forwardY, advY = setup.advY,
		targets = setup.targets, batonId = setup.batonId,
		-- key: the lineup's key for the player (on the web, the room member it belongs to)
		thrower = setup.thrower and { id = setup.thrower.id, name = setup.thrower.name,
			level = setup.thrower.level, key = setup.thrower.key } or nil,
		settled = setup.settled,
	}
end

-- The raise: the kubb, its two ends (footprints), the engine's choices, the
-- default choice, the pieces near it (view frame of the defender).
function Session:raiseInfo()
	local g, st = self.m.game, self.settle
	local n = g:need()
	local side = n.side
	local ctx = g:context(side, n.kubb)
	local dec = n.decision
	local default = raising.choose(dec, ctx, g.raisePolicy) or 1
	local choices = {}
	for i, c in ipairs(dec.choices) do
		choices[i] = { which = c.which, pose = viewPose(side, c.pose), displaced = c.displaced or false,
			crowded = c.crowded or false }
	end
	local ends = {}
	local fps = n.pose.standing and {} or raising.footprints(n.pose)
	for i = 1, #fps do
		local e = dec.ends and dec.ends[i]
		local ok = false
		for _, c in ipairs(dec.choices) do if c.which == i then ok = true end end
		ends[i] = { which = i, pose = viewPose(side, fps[i]), inBounds = e and e.inBounds or false,
			obstructedBy = e and e.obstructedBy or nil, ok = ok,
			why = (not ok) and ((e and not e.inBounds) and "THAT END IS OUT" or "THAT END IS BLOCKED") or nil }
	end
	local others = {}
	for _, o in ipairs(ctx.others) do others[#others + 1] = { id = o.id, pose = viewPose(side, o.pose) } end
	return {
		kind = "raise", side = side, kubb = n.kubb, pose = viewPose(side, n.pose), mode = dec.mode,
		choices = choices, ends = ends, default = default, others = others,
		king = viewPose(side, ctx.king),
		n = st.raised + 1, of = max(st.raiseTotal or 0, st.raised + 1),
		team = upper(cmatch.teamName(side, g)),
	}
end

-- The punishment kubb: the default cursor, the keep-out circles, the kubbs
-- on the pitch, the cursor's bounds (view frame of the defender).
function Session:punishInfo()
	local g, st = self.m.game, self.settle
	local n = g:need()
	local side = n.side
	local ctx = g:context(side, n.kubb)
	local p = raising.autoPunishment(ctx)
	local vx, vy = 0, 2
	if p then vx, vy = frame.point(side, p.x, p.y) end
	local hk = pitch.kubbSide / 2
	local keepOut = {}
	for i, stk in ipairs(pitch.stakes) do
		local x, y = frame.point(side, stk.x, stk.y)
		if y >= -0.01 and y <= 4.01 then
			keepOut[#keepOut + 1] = { kind = "stake", id = "stake" .. i, x = x, y = y, r = pitch.batonLength + hk }
		end
	end
	if ctx.king then
		local x, y = frame.point(side, ctx.king.x, ctx.king.y)
		keepOut[#keepOut + 1] = { kind = "king", id = "king", x = x, y = y, r = pitch.batonLength + pitch.kingSide / 2 + hk }
	end
	local others = {}
	for _, o in ipairs(ctx.others) do
		local x, y = frame.point(side, o.pose.x, o.pose.y)
		if y >= -0.2 and y <= 4.2 then others[#others + 1] = { id = o.id, pose = viewPose(side, o.pose) } end
	end
	return {
		kind = "punish", side = side, kubb = n.kubb, cursor = { x = vx, y = vy },
		bounds = { xMin = -2.5 + hk, xMax = 2.5 - hk, yMin = hk, yMax = 4 - hk },
		keepOut = keepOut, others = others,
		n = st.placed + 1, of = max(st.punishTotal or 0, st.placed + 1),
		team = upper(cmatch.teamName(side, g)),
	}
end

-- What happens next: { kind = "throw" | "raise" | "punish" | "over", ... }.
function Session:need()
	if self.kind == "practice" then
		return { kind = "throw", practice = true, drill = self.ts.drill, surface = self.opts.surface,
			level = throw.levelFor(self.ts), set = self.opts.set }
	end
	local out
	if self.phase == "over" then
		local o = self.overInfo
		out = { kind = "over", winner = o.winner, how = o.how, file = o.file, text = self.m.text,
			short = session.short(self.m.text) }
	elseif self.phase == "settle" then
		out = (self.settle.mode == "raise") and self:raiseInfo() or self:punishInfo()
		out.cpu = false
		out["local"] = self.control[out.side] and true or false
	else
		local setup = self.setup
		local cpu = isCpu(self, setup.side)
		out = {
			kind = "throw", side = setup.side, setup = plainSetup(setup), cpu = cpu,
			["local"] = (cpu and self.control.cpu or (not cpu and self.control[setup.side])) and true or false,
			candidates = (not cpu and #self.m.game.teams[setup.side].players > 1) and cmatch.candidates(self.m) or nil,
			wind = self.windInfo,
		}
	end
	out.card = self.card
	out.turn = self.m.game.turn
	out.throws = self.throws
	out.teams = { A = cmatch.teamName("A", self.m.game), B = cmatch.teamName("B", self.m.game) }
	out.standing = { A = cmatch.standing(self.m, "A"), B = cmatch.standing(self.m, "B") }
	out.last = self.m.text and { text = self.m.text, short = session.short(self.m.text) } or nil
	out.resignPending = self.resignPending
	return out
end

-- The aim as drawn: the circle, the stance, the plan, the arc, the rail.
function Session:aimView()
	local ts = self.ts
	local sol = ts.sol
	local arc = nil
	if throw.tune.arc and (ts.drill or ts.projectile ~= "kubb") and not (ts.watching and not ts.cpuTarget) then
		local pts = throw.arcPoints(ts)
		arc = {}
		for i, p in ipairs(pts) do arc[i] = { x = p[1], y = p[2], z = p[3] } end
	end
	local rail = { name = ts.railName }
	if self.kind == "practice" then
		if ts.drill then
			local d = floor((ts.markerY - ts.lineY) * 10 + 0.5)
			rail.r1 = fmt("%d.%d M", d // 10, d % 10)
		else
			local n = 0
			for _, it in ipairs(ts.items) do if it.base and not it.toppled then n = n + 1 end end
			rail.r1 = "BASE " .. n
		end
	elseif self.setup then
		local st = self.setup
		rail.kind, rail.n, rail.of = st.projectile, st.n, st.of
		if ts.drill then
			local d = floor((ts.markerY - ts.lineY) * 10 + 0.5)
			rail.r1 = fmt("%d.%d M", d // 10, d % 10)
		else
			rail.r1, rail.r2 = self.rail.r1, self.rail.r2
		end
	end
	return {
		marker = { x = ts.markerX, y = ts.markerY, r = throw.tune.markerRadius, on = ts.markerOnId,
			set = ts.markerSet, kind = ts.markerKind, shown = not (ts.watching and not ts.cpuTarget) },
		thrower = { x = ts.playerX, y = ts.playerY, swivel = ts.swivel, set = ts.stanceSet },
		plan = {
			release = ts.release, arcSet = ts.arcSet, tilt = ts.tilt, spin = ts.spin,
			level = throw.levelFor(ts), speed = sol.speed, loft = sol.loft, swivel = sol.swivel, dist = sol.dist,
			back = sol.back, powerLo = sol.powerLo, powerHi = sol.powerHi,
			releaseLo = sol.releaseLo, releaseHi = sol.releaseHi,
		},
		arc = arc,
		projectile = ts.projectile, drill = ts.drill,
		lineY = ts.lineY, forwardY = ts.forwardY, advY = ts.advY, advText = ts.advText,
		halfWidth = throw.tune.halfWidth, backMax = throw.tune.backMax,
		rail = rail,
		flag = ts.flagText, restText = ts.restText,
		verdicts = ts.showVerdicts and ts.verdicts or nil,
		wind = ts.windText and { x = ts.windX, y = ts.windY, text = ts.windText } or nil,
		mix = ts.camMix,
		watching = ts.watching or (self.remoteSide and true) or false,
	}
end

-- The minimap: every piece as a dot, the aim line, the advantage line, the wind.
function Session:minimap(items)
	local ts = self.ts
	local dots = {}
	for _, it in ipairs(items or throw.items(ts)) do
		if it.kind ~= "stake" then
			dots[#dots + 1] = { id = it.id, kind = it.kind, x = it.x, y = it.y, toppled = it.toppled, team = it.team }
		end
	end
	return {
		pieces = dots,
		aim = { x0 = ts.playerX, y0 = ts.playerY, x1 = ts.markerX, y1 = ts.markerY },
		advY = ts.advY, lineY = ts.lineY,
		wind = ts.windText and { x = ts.windX, y = ts.windY, text = ts.windText } or nil,
	}
end

-- The match's pitch as it stands, in the frame it is shown in (self.frameSide), for a
-- session restored while no throw is set up (raising, punishment kubbs, the end): its
-- ts.items are throw.new's practice layout, so the pieces come from the match itself, as
-- core/match's setup makes them: the engine's pieces with the exact poses a throw left,
-- and the debris lying on the pitch. A live session keeps showing its last throw's own
-- items (the physical poses, a fallen king's included). The engine keeps no pose for a
-- king that fell and ends the match, so here it lies along its last angle. Display only:
-- nothing here is in the snapshot, and the match is not changed.
function Session:pitchItems()
	local m, side = self.m, self.frameSide
	local pieces = outcome.pieces(m.game, side)
	debris.applyExact(m.debris, pieces, side)
	local how = m.game.how
	if cmatch.over(m) and type(how) == "string" and how:find("^king") then
		for _, k in ipairs(pieces) do
			if k.id == "king" and not k.toppled then
				local v = frame.pose(side, k.pose)
				v.standing = false
				k.qw, k.qx, k.qy, k.qz = outcome.quatOf(v)
				k.z, k.toppled = nil, true -- resting height from the new pose
			end
		end
	end
	return throw.itemsOf(pieces, debris.pieces(m.debris, side))
end

-- Everything the screen needs when nothing is playing back.
function Session:view()
	local ts = self.ts
	local items = (self.pitchFromMatch and self.phase ~= "throw") and self:pitchItems() or throw.items(ts)
	return {
		need = self:need(),
		items = items,
		minimap = self:minimap(items),
		aim = self:aimView(),
		camera = ts.aimCam,
		dial = throw.dial(ts, true),
		surface = ts.surface, set = ts.set,
	}
end

-- ---------- aiming ----------

function Session:canAim()
	return self.phase == "throw" and self.ts.mode == "aim" and not self.ts.watching
end

local function aimOut(s)
	return { aim = s:aimView(), camera = s.ts.aimCam }
end

function Session:setTarget(x, y, snap)
	if not self:canAim() then return aimOut(self) end
	throw.setTarget(self.ts, F(x), F(y), snap)
	return aimOut(self)
end

function Session:nudgeTarget(dx, dy)
	return self:setTarget(self.ts.markerX + (dx or 0), self.ts.markerY + (dy or 0), false)
end

function Session:setStance(x, y)
	if not self:canAim() then return aimOut(self) end
	if x == nil then throw.freeStance(self.ts) else throw.setStance(self.ts, F(x), F(y)) end
	return aimOut(self)
end

function Session:stepArc(step)
	if self:canAim() then throw.stepArc(self.ts, I(step or 1)) end
	return aimOut(self)
end

function Session:setArc(deg)
	if self:canAim() then throw.setArc(self.ts, F(deg)) end
	return aimOut(self)
end

function Session:stepSide(step)
	if self:canAim() then throw.stepSide(self.ts, I(step or 1)) end
	return aimOut(self)
end

function Session:freshPlan()
	if self:canAim() then throw.freshPlan(self.ts) end
	return aimOut(self)
end

function Session:setLevel(level)
	if self.kind == "practice" then
		self.ts.defaultLevel = level
	else
		self.ts.level = level
	end
	self.ts.planDirty = true
	throw.replan(self.ts)
	throw.aimCamera(self.ts)
	return aimOut(self)
end

-- Practice only.
function Session:setDrill(on)
	assert(self.kind == "practice", "setDrill is for practice")
	throw.setDrill(self.ts, on)
	return self:view()
end

function Session:reset()
	assert(self.kind == "practice", "reset is for practice")
	throw.reset(self.ts)
	self.ts.flagText = nil
	return self:view()
end

function Session:setSurface(name)
	assert(self.kind == "practice", "setSurface is for practice")
	self.opts.surface = surfaceKey(name)
	self.ts.surface = self.opts.surface
	self.ts.planDirty = true -- a drill runs on by the ground
	return self:view()
end

-- Which sides this browser plays, and whether it throws for the computer.
function Session:setControl(c)
	c = c or {}
	local sides = c.sides or { "A", "B" }
	self.control = { A = false, B = false, cpu = c.cpu ~= false }
	for _, side in ipairs(sides) do self.control[side] = true end
	if self.ts.straight and self.setup and not self.control[self.setup.side] then
		tw.web.straight.frame(self.ts, { { phase = "cancel" } })
	end
	if self.ts.touch and self.setup and not self.control[self.setup.side] then
		tw.web.touch.frame(self.ts, { { phase = "cancel" } })
	end
	return self:need()
end

-- ---------- the throw ----------

-- The action for a throw with launch L ("how": baton, drill or lob), from
-- where the throw scene stands now.
function Session:throwAction(L, how, info)
	local ts = self.ts
	local a = {
		type = "throw", seq = self.throws, how = how,
		launch = {
			speed = L.speed, loft = L.loft, swivel = L.swivel, tilt = L.tilt or 0, tumble = L.tumble or 0,
			legal = L.legal ~= false,
			noseDown = L.noseDown, rollLand = L.rollLand, spin = L.spin, wobble = L.wobble,
		},
		stance = { x = ts.playerX, y = ts.playerY, set = ts.stanceSet },
		target = { x = ts.markerX, y = ts.markerY, set = ts.markerSet, on = ts.markerOnId },
		scripted = info.scripted or false, input = info.input,
	}
	if info.back then a.swing = { back = info.back, stop = info.stop } end
	if info.verdicts then
		a.verdicts = { powerV = info.verdicts.powerV, releaseV = info.verdicts.releaseV,
			steady = info.verdicts.steady and true or false, sideV = info.verdicts.sideV }
	end
	return a
end

-- A report needs only the practice pitch immediately before its throw. Keep the
-- unrounded bodies in their solver order and the counters used for projectile IDs.
-- The throw action supplies the launch, stance and target. Match snapshots use
-- their own format; this checkpoint is only for replaying one practice throw.
local function practiceCheckpoint(s)
	local ts = s.ts
	return json.encode { items = ts.items, exercise = ts.exercise, surface = ts.surface, set = ts.set, level = throw.levelFor(ts),
		drill = ts.drill, drillSeq = ts.drillSeq, baton = ts.practiceBaton,
		throws = s.throws }
end

function session.restorePractice(text)
	local c = json.decode(text)
	local s = session.new { mode = "practice", surface = c.surface, set = c.set, level = c.level, exercise = c.exercise }
	local ts = s.ts
	ts.items, ts.drillSeq, ts.practiceBaton = c.items, c.drillSeq, c.baton
	s.throws, ts.throws = c.throws, c.throws
	throw.setDrill(ts, c.drill)
	return s
end

-- Run a throw action: the same path for the actor and for every other
-- browser (docs/SESSION.md "Determinism"). Returns the recording.
function Session:applyThrow(a)
	if self.kind == "match" then
		assert(self.phase == "throw", "no throw set up")
		assert(I(a.seq) == self.throws, "throw out of step: seq " .. tostring(a.seq) .. ", expected " .. self.throws)
	end
	local ts = self.ts
	if self.kind == "practice" then self.practiceBefore = practiceCheckpoint(self) end
	-- the frame this throw's recording is in (session/wide)
	self.recSide = self.kind == "match" and self.setup.side or nil
	local st, tg = a.stance or {}, a.target or {}
	ts.playerX, ts.playerY, ts.stanceSet = F(st.x), F(st.y), st.set and true or false
	ts.markerX, ts.markerY, ts.markerSet, ts.markerOnId = F(tg.x), F(tg.y), tg.set and true or false, tg.on
	local l = a.launch
	local L = {
		speed = F(l.speed), loft = F(l.loft), swivel = F(l.swivel), tilt = F(l.tilt or 0), tumble = F(l.tumble or 0),
		legal = l.legal ~= false,
		noseDown = F(l.noseDown), rollLand = F(l.rollLand), spin = F(l.spin), wobble = F(l.wobble),
	}
	local how = a.how
	local verdicts = nil
	if a.verdicts then
		verdicts = { powerV = I(a.verdicts.powerV), releaseV = I(a.verdicts.releaseV), steady = a.verdicts.steady,
			sideV = a.verdicts.sideV and I(a.verdicts.sideV) or nil }
	end
	local sw = a.swing
	local back, stop = sw and F(sw.back), sw and F(sw.stop)
	ts.scripted = a.scripted and true or false
	-- the playback camera starts from the aim camera as every browser has it
	local cpuSide = self.kind == "match" and isCpu(self, self.setup.side)
	ts.watching, ts.cpuTarget = cpuSide, cpuSide
	ts.camMix = 0
	local rec = throw.fire(ts, L, how, { verdicts = verdicts, back = back, stop = stop })
	ts.lastBack, ts.lastStop = back, stop
	ts.verdicts = rec.result.verdicts
	ts.showVerdicts = (not ts.scripted) and verdicts ~= nil
	ts.restText = rec.result.restText
	ts.flagText = rec.result.flag
	self.throws = self.throws + 1
	if a.at then self.finish = a.at end
	if self.kind == "practice" then
		throw.afterRest(ts)
		ts.mode = "aim"
	else
		local m = self.m
		cmatch.resolve(m, ts.result, not rec.result.legal)
		rec.result.ruling = { text = m.text, short = session.short(m.text) }
		ts.flagText = session.short(m.text)
		ts.mode = "aim"
		ts.watching = false
		self:advance()
	end
	rec.input = a.input
	rec.seq = self.throws - 1
	self.recording = rec
	return rec
end

-- ---------- the frame ----------

-- One frame while aiming (docs/SESSION.md "The frame"). inp = { dt, arm,
-- plan, move = {dx, dy}, walk = {dx, dy} }. Returns { dial, camera, aim,
-- event, action, recording, need }.
function Session:frame(inp)
	inp = inp or {}
	local dt = F(inp.dt or 1 / 60)
	if dt <= 0 then dt = 1 / 60 end
	if dt > 0.1 then dt = 0.1 end
	local ts = self.ts
	local out = {}
	if self.phase ~= "throw" then
		out.dial = throw.dial(ts, true)
		return out
	end
	local cpu = self.kind == "match" and isCpu(self, self.setup.side)
	local ev, L, how, info, crossings
	if cpu then
		if ts.mode == "aim" then
			-- the computer's throw: its aim shows (cpuThink), then its arm plays on the dial
			local a = autothrow.choose(self.setup, rngFor(self, 1, self.throws), tw.web.tune.throw.cpuScatter)
			self.cpuAim = a
			throw.cpuBegin(ts, a)
		end
		ev = throw.cpuFrame(ts, dt)
		if ev == "release" then
			if self.control.cpu then
				local a = self.cpuAim
				L, how = throw.cpuLaunch(ts, a)
				ts.playerX, ts.playerY = a.x, a.y
				info = { scripted = true, back = a.swing and a.swing.back, stop = a.swing and a.swing.releaseAngle }
			else
				-- another browser throws for the computer: hold at the release
				ts.mode = "cpuhold"
				ev = nil
			end
		end
	elseif self.kind == "match" and not self.control[self.setup.side] then
		-- someone else's throw: their aim comes in by showAim
		throw.aimCamera(ts)
		out.dial = throw.dial(ts, true)
		out.camera = ts.aimCam
		out.aim = self:aimView()
		return out
	else
		local changed, input
		ev, changed, input = throw.aimFrame(ts, inp)
		crossings, ts.crossings = ts.crossings, nil
		if ev == "release" then
			local r = input == "straight" and ts.strokeResult or ts.swing.result
			ts.strokeResult = nil
			L, how = throw.playerLaunch(ts, r)
			info = { input = input or "pointer", back = r.back, stop = r.releaseAngle, verdicts = L }
		end
	end
	out.event = ev
	if L then
		local action = self:throwAction(L, how, info)
		-- the actor runs the action exactly as every other browser will: through JSON
		action = json.decode(json.encode(action))
		out.action = action
		out.recording = self:applyThrow(action)
		out.need = self:need()
	end
	out.dial = throw.dial(ts, not L)
	out.dial.crossings = crossings
	out.camera = ts.aimCam
	out.aim = self:aimView()
	return out
end

-- The last throw at shown time t.
function Session:showAt(t)
	local r = throw.showAt(self.ts, F(t or 0))
	if not r then return nil end
	r.dial = throw.dial(self.ts, false)
	return r
end

-- ---------- watching ----------

function Session:aimState()
	local ts = self.ts
	local sw = ts.swing
	return {
		seq = self.throws, x = ts.playerX, y = ts.playerY, stanceSet = ts.stanceSet,
		tx = ts.markerX, ty = ts.markerY, markerSet = ts.markerSet, on = ts.markerOnId,
		release = ts.release, arcSet = ts.arcSet, tilt = ts.tilt, spin = ts.spin,
		arm = ts.arm or 0, phase = sw.phase, back = sw.back, mix = ts.camMix,
	}
end

-- Someone else's aim (their aimState): the circle, stance, plan, dial and
-- plan-view mix follow it.
function Session:showAim(a)
	if self.phase ~= "throw" or (a.seq ~= nil and I(a.seq) ~= self.throws) then return nil end
	local ts = self.ts
	ts.playerX, ts.playerY, ts.stanceSet = F(a.x), F(a.y), a.stanceSet and true or false
	ts.markerX, ts.markerY, ts.markerSet, ts.markerOnId = F(a.tx), F(a.ty), a.markerSet and true or false, a.on
	ts.release, ts.arcSet = F(a.release), a.arcSet and true or false
	ts.tilt, ts.spin = a.tilt or 0, a.spin or 0
	ts.camMix = F(a.mix or 0)
	ts.remote = { arm = F(a.arm or 0), phase = a.phase or "idle", back = F(a.back or 0) }
	throw.replan(ts)
	throw.aimCamera(ts)
	return { aim = self:aimView(), camera = ts.aimCam, dial = throw.dial(ts, true) }
end

-- ---------- the match's other actions ----------

function Session:checkPunish(x, y)
	assert(self.phase == "settle" and self.settle.mode == "punish", "no punishment kubb to place")
	local g = self.m.game
	local n = g:need()
	local wx, wy = frame.point(n.side, F(x), F(y))
	local ok, why = raising.punishmentCheck({ x = wx, y = wy, standing = true, angle = 0 }, g:context(n.side, n.kubb))
	return { ok = ok and true or false, why = why, label = whyLabel(why) }
end

-- apply(action): any action, from this browser or another. Returns
-- { ok, recording?, need, error? }.
function Session:apply(a)
	local t = a.type
	if t == "throw" then
		local rec = self:applyThrow(a)
		return { ok = true, recording = rec, need = self:need() }
	end
	assert(self.kind == "match", "only a match takes " .. tostring(t))
	local g = self.m.game
	if t == "raise" then
		assert(self.phase == "settle" and self.settle.mode == "raise", "no kubb to raise")
		local choice = a.choice and I(a.choice) or nil
		local dec = g:need().decision
		assert(choice == nil or dec.choices[choice], "no raising choice " .. tostring(choice))
		g:raise(choice)
		self.settle.raised = self.settle.raised + 1
		self.card = nil
		if not settleBegin(self) then self.settle = nil; self:advance() end
		return { ok = true, need = self:need() }
	elseif t == "punish" then
		assert(self.phase == "settle" and self.settle.mode == "punish", "no punishment kubb to place")
		local n = g:need()
		local wx, wy = frame.point(n.side, F(a.x), F(a.y))
		local ok, why = g:placePunishment({ x = wx, y = wy, standing = true, angle = 0 })
		if not ok then return { ok = false, why = why, label = whyLabel(why), need = self:need() } end
		self.settle.placed = self.settle.placed + 1
		self.card = nil
		if not settleBegin(self) then self.settle = nil; self:advance() end
		return { ok = true, need = self:need() }
	elseif t == "resign" then
		if self.phase == "over" then return { ok = false, why = "over", need = self:need() } end
		local side = a.side or g.attacker
		if a.at then self.finish = a.at end
		if g.attacker == side and self.phase == "throw" then
			cmatch.resign(self.m)
			self:over()
		else
			-- the rules allow a resign only on the team's own turn: it waits for it
			self.resignPending = side
		end
		return { ok = true, need = self:need() }
	elseif t == "thrower" then
		assert(self.phase == "throw", "no throw set up")
		local ok, why = cmatch.changeThrower(self.m, a.id)
		if not ok then return { ok = false, why = why, need = self:need() } end
		local setup = self.setup
		self.lastThrower = setup.thrower.id
		self.ts.level = setup.thrower.level
		self.ts.planDirty = true
		throw.replan(self.ts)
		self.ts.railName = self:railName(setup)
		if self.card and self.card.kind == "handoff" then self.card.handoff = cards.handoff(self.m, setup)
		elseif self.card and self.card.kind == "pass" then self.card.pass = cards.pass(self.m, setup) end
		return { ok = true, need = self:need() }
	end
	error("unknown action " .. tostring(t))
end

-- ---------- snapshot ----------

function Session:snapshotTable()
	assert(self.kind == "match", "only a match has a snapshot")
	local pre = self.pre
	return {
		v = session.snapshotVersion,
		opts = self.opts,
		save = save.pack(self.m, nil),
		throws = self.throws,
		finish = self.finish,
		resignPending = self.resignPending,
		side = pre.side, lastThrower = pre.lastThrower, mem = pre.mem,
		settle = self.settle and { raised = self.settle.raised, placed = self.settle.placed,
			raiseTotal = self.settle.raiseTotal, punishTotal = self.settle.punishTotal } or nil,
	}
end

function Session:snapshot()
	return json.encode(self:snapshotTable())
end

function Session:hash()
	return fnv(self:snapshot())
end

function session.restore(text, control)
	needTune()
	local d = type(text) == "string" and json.decode(text) or text
	assert(type(d) == "table" and d.v == session.snapshotVersion, "not a snapshot of this version")
	local s = setmetatable({}, Session)
	s.kind = "match"
	s.control = { A = true, B = true, cpu = true }
	s.opts = d.opts
	s.opts.cpu = s.opts.cpu or {}
	s.seed = I(d.opts.seed)
	s.throws = I(d.throws)
	s.finish = d.finish
	s.resignPending = d.resignPending
	local m, why = save.unpack(d.save)
	assert(m, why)
	s.m = m
	s.byHand = s.opts.raising == "hand"
	s.ts = throw.new { surface = s.opts.surface, set = s.opts.set }
	setMem(s.ts, d.mem or {})
	s.side, s.lastThrower = d.side, d.lastThrower
	if d.settle then
		s.settle = { raised = I(d.settle.raised), placed = I(d.settle.placed), raiseTotal = I(d.settle.raiseTotal),
			punishTotal = I(d.settle.punishTotal) }
	end
	-- ts holds throw.new's layout until a throw is set up: until then the view draws the
	-- match's pitch (Session:pitchItems) in the frame a live session holds it in, the last
	-- throw's
	s.pitchFromMatch, s.frameSide = true, s.side
	s:advance()
	if control then s:setControl(control) end
	return s
end

tw.web.session = session
session/straight:
-- A straight stroke is spatial: one rail length is 180 backswing degrees.
-- The host supplies ordered positions in rail lengths, relative to the grip.
-- Interpolate where the stroke crossed its starting line, even if the next
-- sample is far into the follow-through. Speed and display rate are immaterial.
import "core/swing"
local straight = {}
local function rounded(x) return math.floor(x * 1024 + 0.5) / 1024 end

function straight.frame(s, points)
	local event
	for _, p in ipairs(points) do
		if p.phase == "down" then
			tw.swing.reset(s.swing)
			s.straight = { x = 0, y = 0, peak = 0 }
			event = nil
		elseif s.straight then
			local g = s.straight
			if p.phase ~= "cancel" then
				local x, y = p.x, p.y
				g.peak = math.max(g.peak, math.min(180, rounded(y * 180)))
				if g.peak >= tw.swing.tune.startBackDeg and g.y > 0 and y <= 0 then
					local cross = rounded(g.x + (x - g.x) * g.y / (g.y - y))
					local offset = math.min(6, math.max(0, math.abs(cross) - 0.08) * 8)
					s.strokeResult = { back = g.peak, releaseAngle = s.release, flickFrac = 1,
						smoothness = 1, shake = 0, pull = 1, how = "straight",
						lineDeg = cross < 0 and -offset or offset }
					s.straight = nil
					return "release"
				end
				if s.swing.onArm then s.swing.onArm(-math.max(0, g.y) * 180, -math.max(0, y) * 180) end
				g.x, g.y = x, y
				s.swing.back, s.swing.arm = g.peak, -y * 180
				s.swing.phase = g.peak >= tw.swing.tune.startBackDeg and "winding" or "idle"
			end
			if p.phase == "cancel" or p.phase == "up" then
				s.straight = nil
				tw.swing.reset(s.swing)
				s.swing.back = 0
				event = "letdown"
			end
		end
	end
	return event
end
tw.web = tw.web or {}
tw.web.straight = straight
session/throw:
-- The throw scene with the screen taken out (docs/SESSION.md). Pure Lua 5.4.
--
-- This is the Playdate's source/scenes/throw.lua (../../playdate-kubb), taken
-- over line for line where it decides something: the aim (target circle,
-- stance, plan, "stay put"), the plan solve, the swing (core/swing fed the
-- dial's angle stream), the launch (core/throwplan), the world run to rest,
-- the verdicts, the result flag, the cameras (first person, plan view,
-- follow, impact, the half circle) and the computer's arm on the clock.
-- What the Playdate drew is returned as data instead. Where the web differs
-- it says so here and in docs/SESSION.md "Differences from the Playdate":
--   * a throw is computed whole at release (playback.finish) and returned as
--     a recording; the camera for any shown time is a pure function of it;
--   * the target circle and the stance are also set by absolute position
--     (the pointer drags them), not only nudged;
--   * the dial is a pointer: its angle stream is turned into crank changes,
--     and lifting the pointer while swinging forward is the release.
--
-- Everything is in the thrower's view frame (core/frame): the throw is from
-- y = lineY (0) toward +y.
import "core/tw"
import "core/camera"
import "core/swing"
import "session/touch"
import "session/straight"
import "core/flight"
import "core/pitch"
import "core/world"
import "core/body"
import "core/playback"
import "core/quat"
import "core/burstpick"
import "core/drill"
import "core/throwplan"
import "session/json"

local camera, swing, flight, pitch = tw.camera, tw.swing, tw.flight, tw.pitch
local phys, playback, quat, burstpick = tw.world, tw.playback, tw.quat, tw.burstpick
local drill, plan, body = tw.drill, tw.plan, tw.body
-- The host's tune (tune/<name>.lua, chosen by session.useTune): read when it is used,
-- not when this file loads, since the host chooses it after loading the engine.
local function wtune() return assert(tw.web.tune, "no tune: call useTune first") end

local abs, sqrt, max, min, floor, rad = math.abs, math.sqrt, math.max, math.min, math.floor, math.rad
local fmt = string.format

local throw = {}

-- scenes/throw.lua's tune, the fields the web uses, with the Playdate's
-- values (the pacing fields of the device's flight are not needed: the
-- throw is computed whole).
throw.tune = {
	walkSpeed = 1.2,      -- m/s along the throwing line (keys held)
	halfWidth = 2.5,      -- the line is 5 m wide (DESIGN 2)
	backMax = 3.0,        -- m the player may step back from the throwing line
	snapRadius = 0.25,    -- m: aimAt (snap) puts the circle onto a standing target this near;
	                      -- a baton's circle this near one is on it (replan: aimed through it)
	keepNear = 1.0,       -- m: a circle moved by hand stays put for the next throw while a live
	                      -- target stands this near it (else it goes onto the nearest target)
	overDeg = 150,        -- backswing degrees past which the clock shows overpowered (11 o'clock)
	cpuSwingTime = 0.6,   -- s the computer's arm takes on the clock before its throw leaves
	cpuBackShare = 0.6,   -- the share of that spent going back
	lineY = 0,            -- the throwing line: the thrower's baseline
	surface = "grass",    -- the practice pitch
	set = "classic",      -- the practice pitch's kubb set (passed through to the renderer)
	focusSpeed = 4,       -- m/s the impact camera's aim point slews toward the first hit
	frameRadius = 1.5,    -- m from the impact point within which the camera keeps the baton in frame
	swingDeg = 180,       -- the impact camera's half circle round the struck piece ...
	swingTime = 0.8,      -- ... over this many s of shown time from its impact
	drillKeep = 10,       -- drilled kubbs kept on the practice pitch; the oldest goes past this
	markerRadius = 0.25,  -- m: the target circle (0.5 m across, DESIGN 4)
	arc = true,           -- the planned arc shows
	arcPoints = 24,       -- points along the arc, release to landing
	arcSkip = 2,          -- the first points (at the hand, under the camera) are left out
	arcFitFrom = 6,       -- the plan view keeps the arc on screen from this point on
}

throw.level = plan.tune.defaultLevel
function throw.levelFor(s)
	return s.level or s.defaultLevel or throw.level
end

-- ---------- pieces ----------

-- How high a piece's centre sits when it rests on the ground with this
-- orientation (scenes/throw.lua restZ, with the physics' own half extents).
local function restZ(kind, qw, qx, qy, qz)
	local k = body.kinds[kind]
	local _, _, _, _, _, _, r31, r32, r33 = quat.toMatrix(qw, qx, qy, qz)
	if k.shape == 1 then
		return abs(r31) * k.hx + abs(r32) * k.hy + abs(r33) * k.hz
	end
	return k.hl * abs(r33) + k.r
end

local function newItem(p)
	local qw, qx, qy, qz = p.qw, p.qx, p.qy, p.qz
	if not qw then
		local yaw = (p.yaw or 0) / 2
		qw, qx, qy, qz = math.cos(yaw), 0, 0, math.sin(yaw)
	end
	return {
		id = p.id, kind = p.kind, x = p.x, y = p.y, z = p.z or restZ(p.kind, qw, qx, qy, qz),
		qw = qw, qx = qx, qy = qy, qz = qz,
		toppled = p.toppled or false, base = p.base, role = p.role, half = p.half,
		debris = p.debris, exact = p.z ~= nil,
	}
end

-- The practice layout: five base kubbs on each baseline and the king.
function throw.defaultLayout(exercise)
	if exercise == "base" then
		return { { id = "b3", kind = "kubb", x = 0, y = 8, base = true } }
	elseif exercise == "pair" then
		return { { id = "front", kind = "kubb", role = "field", x = 0, y = 5 },
			{ id = "rear", kind = "kubb", role = "field", x = 0.09, y = 5.27 } }
	elseif exercise == "pile" then
		local h = math.sqrt(0.5)
		return { { id = "first", kind = "kubb", x = 0, y = 5.6, qw = h, qx = 0, qy = h, qz = 0, toppled = true } }
	end
	local l = {}
	for _, side in ipairs { { "a", 0 }, { "b", 8 } } do
		for i, x in ipairs(pitch.baseX) do
			l[#l + 1] = { id = side[1] .. i, kind = "kubb", x = x, y = side[2], base = side[2] == 8 }
		end
	end
	l[#l + 1] = { id = "king", kind = "king", x = pitch.king.x, y = pitch.king.y }
	return l
end

function throw.standUp(s)
	local items = {}
	for i, p in ipairs(s.layout) do items[i] = newItem(p) end
	s.items = items
	s.practiceBaton = 0
end

local function itemsFrom(pieces, debris)
	local items = {}
	for i, p in ipairs(pieces) do items[i] = newItem(p) end
	for _, p in ipairs(debris or {}) do items[#items + 1] = newItem(p) end
	return items
end

function throw.setPieces(s, pieces, debris)
	s.items = itemsFrom(pieces, debris)
end

local function itemById(s, id)
	if not id then return nil end
	for _, it in ipairs(s.items) do
		if it.id == id then return it end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Live targets for the aim camera and the circle (scenes/throw.lua updateTargets).
local function updateTargets(s)
	local tg, sn = {}, {}
	local ids = s.targetIds
	for _, it in ipairs(s.items) do
		if ids then
			if not it.toppled then
				for j = 1, #ids do
					if ids[j] == it.id then
						tg[#tg + 1] = it
						sn[#sn + 1] = it
						break
					end
				end
			end
		elseif not it.toppled and not it.drilled and it.kind ~= "baton" then
			local king = it.kind == "king"
			local far = it.y > s.lineY + 4
			if far and not king then tg[#tg + 1] = it end
			if far or king then sn[#sn + 1] = it end
		end
	end
	s.targets, s.snaps = tg, sn
end

local function kindOf(it)
	if it.kind == "king" then return "king" end
	if it.role == "field" then return "field" end
	return "base"
end

-- ---------- the aim ----------

local function arcShown(s)
	return throw.tune.arc and (s.drill or s.projectile ~= "kubb")
end

-- The arc's launch (scenes/throw.lua arcLaunch): the flight has the air's
-- drag (flight.carry), so the arc is drawn as the plain parabola from the
-- hand to the same landing in the same time (within 2 to 4 cm of it). A
-- drilled kubb's lands where drill.solveAt puts it: sol.land out, its centre
-- at drill.tune.landZ. A baton's plan already sends its centre through the
-- target (plan.solve: sol.dist out, at sol.aimZ, in sol.flightT); on a piece
-- (replan's s.aimFace) the arc stops where it reaches the piece's near face,
-- a hair above the aim height: the fourth value is the time drawn to.
local function arcLaunch(s)
	local sol = s.sol
	local speed, loft, sw = sol.speed or 0, sol.loft or 32, sol.swivel or 0
	local T, R, z1 = sol.T, sol.land, drill.tune.landZ
	local Tdraw = nil
	if s.projectile ~= "kubb" and sol.flightT and sol.dist then
		T, R, z1 = sol.flightT, sol.dist > 0.1 and sol.dist or 0.1, sol.aimZ or 0
		local face = s.aimFace
		if face and face > 0 and face < R then Tdraw = T * face / R end
	elseif not (s.drill and T and R) then
		local lx, ly
		lx, ly, T = flight.predict(s.playerX, s.playerY, sw, loft, speed)
		lx, ly = lx - s.playerX, ly - s.playerY
		R, z1 = sqrt(lx * lx + ly * ly), 0
	end
	if T <= 0 then return 0, 0, 0, 0 end
	local vh = R / T
	local h, g = flight.tune.handHeight, flight.tune.g
	return vh * math.sin(sw), vh * math.cos(sw), (z1 - h + 0.5 * g * T * T) / T, Tdraw or T
end

-- The planned arc's points (arcSkip..arcPoints), as drawn on the Playdate.
local function arcPoints(s)
	local t = throw.tune
	local vx, vy, vz, T = arcLaunch(s)
	local x0, y0, h, g = s.playerX, s.playerY, flight.tune.handHeight, flight.tune.g
	local out = {}
	for i = t.arcSkip, t.arcPoints do
		local tt = T * i / t.arcPoints
		out[#out + 1] = { x0 + vx * tt, y0 + vy * tt, h + vz * tt - 0.5 * g * tt * tt }
	end
	return out
end
throw.arcPoints = arcPoints
